Special Containment Procedures: Foundation web crawlers are to search the internet for websites hosting instances of SCP-9039 and documentation of SCP-9039 related content. A DDoS (Distributed Denial-of-Service) attack shall be used to target said websites before Foundation Personnel can take down the offending content. All members of the public who perceive auditory content from SCP-9039 are to be housed in a standard humanoid containment cell over the course of a 2 week period. Class B amnestics and a psychological evaluation will then be administered to the witness before they are cleared for return to society. Concerning murders relating to SCP-9039, Foundation front companies are to publish newspapers corroborating an appropriate cover story. Personnel with a background or interest in Criminology are forbidden from SCP-9039 related assignments, with the exception of testing purposes.

The logo of the Perfect Crime Podcast

Description: SCP-9039 refers to a true crime podcast colloquially referred to as "A Perfect Crime Podcast", which covers murders while adding an often inaccurate paranormal tinge. Episodes of the Perfect Crime Podcast have been discovered in numerous websites, with the majority of sightings being on the Parawatch Wiki forums (See addendum 1). Attempts to trace the IP address of the podcast's host have so far been unsuccessful. There is few information available on the host—if such a host even exists—apart from the fact that they are female and have been spotted under the online alias “A_Perfect_Podcast” and variations of such.

SCP-9039 exhibits a cognitohazardous property where certain listeners of the podcast will be marked as targets for murder and end up dying in a homicide in the following 2 week period. There is no known way to tell if a listener has been marked as a target for murder, but victims of SCP-9039 have been exhibited to follow these parameters in most cases:

> Aged in the range of 15-40
> Has an interest in true-crime related content
> Has regularly consumed true-crime content over a time period of the past year or more
> Is a believer in the paranormal

Following the target’s murder, an episode of the SCP-9039 podcast covering their murder will subsequently be posted. Attempts to prevent the murder of SCP-9039 targets have so far resulted in failure.

SCP-9039 first came to the attention of the Foundation following the detection of a thread in the Parawatch Wiki forums promoting an episode of the Perfect Crime Podcast. The vast majority of replies in the the thread consisted of recountings by users explaining their experiences with the podcast, warning unknowing users to ignore the podcast. A test involving a sample of five Class D personnel listening to an episode of SCP-9039 was issued to test the validity of these allegations. In the 2-week period following the tests, 2 of the Class D personnel killed each other during an altercation, another one of the five died while trying to flee during a containment breach, before eventually being killed by an escaped anomaly. The remaining two Class D personnel survived the 2-week period. For the purposes of the test, Foundation personnel were instructed not to intervene in the events of any of the five Class D being murdered unless it posed immediate danger to other personnel.

Following the murder of the Class D personnel, an episode of the SCP-9039 podcast was posted detailing the case. A forensic analysis of an audio transcript concluded that the information contained within the episode was exaggerated albeit mostly accurate. The episode accurately described the life of the Class D personnel before their time at the Foundation, described how the containment breach began, and correctly identified the anomaly as the culprit. Exaggerated information was exhibited in the segment describing the Class D personnel's past criminal life. The episode was located in another Parawatch thread which was swiftly taken down after a single recorded visit. As per protocol, the witness was taken to a standard humanoid containment cell to be kept for a 2 week time period. Over the first week, there were three different attempts on the witness's life by either D Class Personnel or Foundation staff. Thirteen days into the witness's containment, preparations for their amnestication were being prepared by Foundation Doctor █████, who entered a psychotic state of rage before breaking into the witness's cell and strangling them to death with his bare hands. Resuscitation attempts post-incident were unsuccessful. Doctor █████ was interviewed following the incident, who reported no memory of the event, and described a sudden bloodlust overcoming him before ultimately passing out.

Addendum 1: An abridged list of known episodes of the Perfect Crime Podcast. An extended list and audio transcripts can be requested from head of SCP-9039 research, Dr. Squirrel.

Item #: SCP-9040

Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures: SCP-9040 is contained within a 225 m2 flooded chamber outfitted with artificial terrain features1 scaled to SCP-9040-00. One chamber wall is constructed of reinforced glass and adjoins Site-███'s staff common room, permitting continuous passive observation of activity.

To maintain compliance, localized meteorological conditions are simulated via integrated fans and irrigation systems, automated under Program 9040-Wellerman. Biweekly, assigned personnel are to coordinate with SCP-9040-02 to confirm environmental adequacy and negotiate trades if required.

Familiarization with Tables 9040.A–9040.D by assigned personnel is mandatory (see Description).

Description: SCP-9040 is the collective designation for a population of Blattella germanica:2 individually designated SCP-9040-01 through SCP-9040-53. Instances exhibit sapience, fluent vocal speech, anthropomorphic behavior, and significantly extended lifespans. All wear garments consistent with late-18th century European maritime fashion, typically accessorized with sewing needles in place of swords and miniature firecrackers in place of pistols.

SCP-9040-00's colors.

SCP-9040 collectively operate SCP-9040-00: a 1:165 scale museum-quality admiralty model of the HMS Endeavour. Though non-anomalous, it exhibits extensive modifications presumably performed by SCP-9040. Alterations primarily involve functional rigging and equipment, along with branding adapted to SCP-9040.

  • Table.9040.A
  • Table.9040.B
  • Table.9040.C
  • Table.9040.D

These instances are considered operationally significant. Familiarity is mandatory.
Item # Profession aboard SCP-9040-00 Notes
SCP-9040-01 Captain Distinguished by flamboyant garbs and duckling-feathered hat. Fully literate. Demonstrates the highest degree of cooperation with personnel. Willing to continue participation in interviews.
SCP-9040-02 Quartermaster Distinguished by the absence of left antenna. Fully literate. Primary liaison for negotiations. Current cooperative measures are derived from interactions with this instance.

These instances have exhibited traits relevant to containment. Familiarity is recommended.
Item # Profession aboard SCP-9040-00 Notes
SCP-9040-04 Carpenter Semi-literate. Submits requests for materials and resources following structural damage to SCP-9040-00. Displayed attempts at courtship directed toward Dr. Jessica Marta Morthon.
SCP-9040-06 Helmsman Distinguished by abnormally large in size (1.9 cm). Demonstrates overt suspicion toward personnel.
SCP-9040-33 Ordinary Seamen Disliked by the majority of instances, reportedly cheats and lies repeatedly during recreational games. Deemed untrustworthy.
SCP-9040-51 Ordinary Seaman Holds unusually high status among other instances for causing the retreat of Redmaw.

These instances have demonstrated traits that may be of potential research interest.
Item # Profession aboard SCP-9040-00 Notes
SCP-9040-09 Gunner Distinguished by partial prosthetic replacement of posterior right leg with a fragment of a toothpick. Currently the oldest instance.
SCP-9040-21 Able Seaman Sole female instance. Other instances do not appear to acknowledge or recognize this distinction.
SCP-9040-53 Ordinary Seaman Distinguished by ripped garbs and the presence of a sewing needle traversing its cephalic plate. Currently confined to SCP-9040-00’s brig by consensus of other instances. Sole instance to display non-anomalous behavior.

These instances have demonstrated no traits of worthy documentation.
[Redacted for brevity]

Addendum.01:

Interview 9040.01

Date: 29/08/2025
Interviewed: SCP-9040
Interviewer: Dr. Jessica Marta Morthon
Foreword: Following a report from an isolated resident near Dwingeloo, Netherlands, embedded field agents were dispatched. The subject was transferred to a local medical center under the cover story of gastro-intoxicational hallucinations. An on-site interview was conducted at the residence, utilizing an amplification system to compensate for SCP-9040's reduced vocal volume. Communication with Site-███ Administration was maintained.

[BEGIN LOG]

Dr. Morthon: Good afternoon, Captain. And to the rest of your… crew. I appreciate you agreeing to speak with me.

SCP-9040-01: Aye, lass, let us parley. Though mark ye, it ain't fer the love o' yer kind. 'Tis 'cause we have no choice.

SCP-9040-06: We shouldna be jawin' with titans at all! Did ye see how the last one acted!

SCP-9040-04: Belay that, Antennio. The Cap'in's word stands. We'll have need o' titan's timber if we're to mend our lady back to health.

SCP-9040-09: Lass, ye’ve no idea what it was like. In all me years, I’d never seen nothin’ the like. The sky split and the Great Sea boiled in the blink o' an eye. Twas the Maelstrom!

[Multiple instances begin shouting over one another until SCP-9040-01 ignites a miniature firecracker from its chest-belt.]

SCP-9040-01: Silence!

[The noise ceases immediately.]

SCP-9040-01: Roachard, keep yer mandibles shut 'fore I see fit to feed 'em to the sticklebacks!

Dr. Morthon: [Clears throat] Captain… perhaps you would like to provide an account of this “Maelstrom”?

[SCP-9040-01 exchanges a glance with SCP-9040-02.]

SCP-9040-02: A bargain, then. The Cap'in'll spin ye the tale, an' ye'll grant us timber enough to mend the Queen Ant's Revenge.

Dr. Morthon: The Queen Ant's Revenge…

[Low murmur among SCP-9040.]

SCP-9040-01: Aye, the Queen Ant's Revenge.

[Dr. Morthon touches her earpiece.]

Dr. Morthon: Only string for the tale.

SCP-9040-02: The string an' half the timber.

[Dr. Morthon touches her earpiece.]

Dr. Morthon: Deal.

[Excited chittering among SCP-9040.]

SCP-9040-01: A bargain struck, a bargain honored.

SCP-9040-06: [Muttering] Mark me words, ye'll regret it…

SCP-9040-01: [Clears pharynx] The Great Sea was calm that morn. Sun shone, sails were full, an' crew singin' their duties. We were down on the gun deck, cards on the table, truly a fair day. Then down comes Carachris, scuttlin’ from the tops with his antenna all a-quiver. Says a storm's a brewin'. Course we laughed him off-

SCP-9040-33: I resent that!

[SCP-9040-21 draws its sewing needle to SCP-9040-33's cervix.]

SCP-9040-21: Stow it, ye cheat.

SCP-9040-01: But just as we dealt the next hand, a shadow crept across the cards. We looked up through the grate where a darkness had poured 'cross the sky, like a spilled bottle o' ink. The winds turned cruel, howlin' like hounds loose from Hell's own kennels. An' the sea. Oh, the sea, lass. I wished I would've stayed under to not see her. Mountains o' water, higher than the mainmast. They crashed down, each threatenin' to steal me crew away!

[Several SCP-9040 nod.]

SCP-9040-01: We’d danced with tempests before, but this beast was another breed o’ fury. Still we fought, passin' buckets from claw to claw. The lads reelin' the sails in clingin' to what they could, damned if they let go. Antennio, curse his black heart, kept her true.

[SCP-9040-06 puffs his thorax slightly.]

SCP-9040-01: We could hear her whole frame creakin' beneath the swell. Yet, the Revenge she held. An' just when we thought the Reaper'd passed us by… It came…

[SCP-9040 display collective agitation.]

Dr. Morthon: It? What do you mean “it”?

SCP-9040-01: A shadow, lass. Greater than the storm itself. Rushin' t'ward us through the gale.

Dr. Morthon: What kind of shadow?

SCP-9040-01: The kind that swallows ships whole. The kind ye pray ye only ever see in nightmares. An' when it rose beside our bow, we saw it plain: the Devil's own Leviathan, Redmaw…

[SCP-9040 display generalized distress.]

Dr. Morthon: Redmaw…? Who- what is Redmaw?

[Prolonged silence.]

SCP-9040-01: We'd never seen a creature like it, with wrath enough to tear worlds. We manned what cannon the torrent had not yet waterlogged. Shot an' flame we hurled at it. But Redmaw's scales turned back our lead as though they were nothin' more than raindrops.

Its eyes, though vacant as the abyss, I could tell all we'd done was anger it with our defiance. It vanished beneath for a split second, an' then like a mountain it rose from the water an' crashed 'gainst the ship's waist. Snapped our mainmast clean in twain, an' pitched half the crew screamin' into the brine.

[SCP-9040 bow heads, removing hats and pressing them to thoraxes. Several click mandibles in unison.]

SCP-9040-01: Their cries, lass, their cries still echo in me antenna. Cut short as the fiend devoured 'em. We watched it feast, powerless.

Dr. Morthon: [Quietly] …That's horrible.

SCP-9040-01: We were stripped o' hope, our guns spent, our decks slick with death. But then, bold young Ticker here [places its claw on SCP-9040-51] seized a harpoon, lashed hisself to the derrick,3 an' called for heave. Two took the rope, then four, then all. The whole crew put their carapaces to it. Up he swung, arced over the side o' the deck an' above the waves.

SCP-9040-51: I saw it under the water, Ma'am. Big eyes, like the size o' helm wheels. Empty, dead eyes. No mercy in 'em. Thought I was done for.

SCP-9040-01: With but one chance, as Redmaw rose from the deep, leapin' to snatch another soul, Ticker's arm found its mark. The harpoon, drove deep into the monster's eye!

Before its jaw could close, we tore the derrick back from Death's bite. The beast shrieked. A shriek to split the Great Sea. It reeled, an' thrashed beneath the waves, its shadow swimmin' away. Soon after, the heavens cleared, as though it'd commanded the storm.

Dr. Morthon: My… my god.

[Prolonged silence.]

SCP-9040-01: We had won. But victory came dear. The Revenge murmured with hurt, her belly fillin' fast. We steered her to the nearest shore, an' there she lies still… Wounded, but triumphant!

[SCP-9040 collectively cheer.]

[END LOG]

Addendum.02:

Investigation Report

SCP-9040-00's shipwreck was recovered along the shoreline of Visvijver Holtien.4 An additional instance, subsequently designated SCP-9040-53, was recovered within. Both were transported to Site-███ and transferred to SCP-9040 custody alongside the negotiated allotment of string and timber.

Correlation of the recovery site with meteorological records confirmed that "the Maelstrom" corresponds to a minor storm event recorded on 24/08/2025.

Investigation Report

Continued surveys of Visvijver Holtien yielded a specimen consistent with descriptions of "Redmaw," distinguished by red pigmentation and the presence of a sewing needle embedded within the left eye. Presentation of a sketch to SCP-9040 resulted in unanimous confirmation of identity, accompanied by marked agitation among instances.

The specimen demonstrated aggressive feeding behavior, and analysis of fecal matter confirmed partial Blattella germanica exoskeletons.

"Redmaw" was taxonomically identified as a young adult Carassius auratus,5 likely released into the pond ecosystem by a nearby inhabitant.

Footnotes
1. Islands, rock formations and vegetation.
2. German cockroaches
3. Mast-mounted crane apparatus, used for deployment of longboats and handling of cargo.
4. A small fishpond of an approximately 300m2 surface area.
5. Common goldfish

euclid

link to memo

Special Containment Procedures

As an early warning system, additional monitoring protocols have been integrated with both routine Foundation automated anomaly detection algorithms and manual surveys. Routine monitoring of all mass events are to continue with adjusted flagging thresholds for self-induced deviation from human behaviour associated with: timekeeping, language, rules, values and meaning. Large-scale events considered at-risk are to be prevented and dissolved where possible, and if not, Kant counters to be deployed with task forces on standby as a precaution.

Humans throughout history naturally observe rites associated with timekeeping, language, rules, values and meaning.

In particular, preventative measures to regulate and rein in global wellness events, unorthodox spiritual movements and social media trends are the priority, including but not limited to:

  • A multi-pronged initiative of awareness campaigns by the World Health Organisation and at the grassroots level targeting alternative health practices are to be intensified and maintained.
  • At the same time, national governments are to be engaged to enforce stronger regulation of their respective healthcare sectors under the pretext of managing rapidly ageing populations, and/or pandemic preventative measures, with all forms of wellness events requiring government approval or strict regulation.
  • Similarly, the creation of a global legislative and enforcement framework under the pretext of monitoring misinformation and incitement of violence is in progress.
  • Monitoring and infiltration of unorthodox religious or spiritual movements, prioritising those with a greater number of members and/or more extreme practices.
  • Long-term cultural shifts easing any culturally entrenched forms of excessive working are to be steadily induced.
  • Greater investments into education, and improved physical and mental health services for the general public.

The above measures are also being rolled out across Foundation sites in multiple stages, except where required for research purposes. To alleviate suspicion, a simple explanation citing a longitudinal study showing that greater staff morale is associated with increased work efficiency is to be provided as part of all new employee welcome packages with a clearance level below 4. All employees of security clearance level 4 and above will receive this document instead.

Due to SCP-9041 naturally operating as a negative feedback loop, its robust fail-safe mechanism, and the relatively high critical mass required to trigger manifestations of SCP-9041-associated phenomena, direct intervention is seldom required. Regardless, active monitoring at a community level and intervention on a case-by-case basis is required to prevent potential escalation in the unlikely event of a mass breach.

Description

SCP-9041 collectively encompasses a set of intrinsic human behaviours which underpin conventional daily activities. Broadly, these can be categorised into core behavioural modules associated with:

Behaviour Description
Timekeeping Conducting activities in a periodic pattern
Language The transfer of information to another
Rules Any form of innate systematic behaviour
Values Principles shaping one’s character
Meaning Anything driven by a conscious purpose

In summary, these seemingly mundane activities constitute reality maintenance protocols. Deviation from these core behavioural modules have demonstrably resulted in anomalous events, scaling in proportion to the magnitude of deviation. Note that this only applies when intentionally self-induced. The act of involuntary behaviour or obstructing another from accomplishing these goals (e.g. in cases of famine or pandemic) does not appear to have a significant impact.

The possibility that additional core behavioural modules may exist has not been excluded. However, most, if not all human behaviour are emergent properties made up of at least one of the above fundamental behaviours. For example, the actions below naturally involve at least one core module:

Action Behavioural relation
Eating Timekeeping, Language, Rules, Values, Meaning
Sleeping Timekeeping, Rules
Breathing Timekeeping, Rules
Talking Language, Rules, Values, Meaning
Cooking Timekeeping, Language, Rules, Meaning

These behaviours are naturally self-containing, in that excess deviation under normal circumstances leads to death. In addition, even in the case where deviation occurs, the passive maintenance of core behaviour modules by other individuals nearby exert a natural buffer or suppressive force. As such, it is a wicked problem1 from the perspective of any attempts at containment breach.

At the time of writing, all anomalies known to the Foundation are undergoing review in the context of these five constants.

Addendum

  • A: Initial discovery
  • B: Systematic evaluation
  • C: Supporting evidence
  • D: Well characterised anomalies
  • E: Future directions
  • F: Frequently asked questions
  • G: Supplementary information

Records of initial discovery

During a routine screen of anomaly patterns, a statistically significant non-random pattern of recurring minor anomalous phenomena were detected2, appearing to be associated with a large-scale global wellness movement primarily promoting extreme fasting and a dysregulation of sleep schedules (among other non-standard activities). Following standard procedures, a research team was assigned to the case, with pre-approved monitoring, memetic countermeasures, surveillance and intelligence gathering responses activated.

However, this rapidly proved to be perplexing, with initial investigations sometimes providing conflicting and contradictory information. Unlike conventional scenarios, the correlation was both (a) reproducible and (b) had no apparent non-mundane causative factor. Notably, each group in the movement operated autonomously. After exhausting all standard preliminary investigation protocols, the case was subsequently escalated to the department-level, site-level and finally inter-site level. After approximately 388 days without the emergence of any credible theories or validated conclusions, (well above the median preliminary investigation cycle of 90 days) budget and ethical constraints were relaxed by the ethics committee, and collaboration with a carefully curated group of Foundation-affiliated academic institutes was permitted.

For the next few months, cross-departmental Foundation teams approached the situation from every angle, including but not limited to chronology, memetics, tactical theology, and thaumaturgy. The eventual breakthrough was motivated by a researcher’s postulation: if a signal is observable in data it is also explainable by data. Following that, a longitudinal study was designed where every quantifiable piece of mundane and anomalous peripheral data (of any modality) over the long-term was collected: environmental variables, human physiological measurements from biosensor data, weather and atmospheric conditions, Kant counter fluctuations, Akiva radiation, etc. The complete list of measurements collected amounted to ~23000-27000 unique types3.

A custom deep learning pipeline was built in collaboration with the Shénjīyíng4, operating on an ensemble model of Deepseek, Gemma and Qwen. In parallel, custom parsers were developed to handle nomenclative hazards, memetic infohazards and other data which cannot be safely ingested without triggering anomalous effects. Input data was collated into a series of sparse matrices and fed through this pipeline. The majority of compute resources from all Foundation facilities were diverted to this project, running for an estimated 33550336 GPU hours over 6 months.

Five “clusters” emerged naturally from the data as visualised by a uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP). A laborious manual curation process was conducted, with multiple researchers independently reviewing the same data and taking a consensus. As a result, each of the five emergent clusters were assigned to the previously described categories: timekeeping, values, language, rules, meaning5.

Systematic evaluation of core behavioural modules

Due to the sensitive nature of the experiment, voluntary testing with a 3-month bonus as an incentive was carried out on a carefully curated subset of Foundation employees with clearance levels 1 to 3, while maximising for demographic variation. All individuals gave informed consent to being amnesticised at the conclusion of the experiment series. Details of SCP-9041’s true nature were then provided to a group of participants (informed group), while others received intentionally misleading information (uninformed group). Multiple overlapping sets of Kant counters were tested and calibrated for high precision detection following iteratively refined benchmarking protocols.

Note that individual core behaviours are rarely mutually exclusive. The core behavioural modules in the table below represent the primary behaviour in a set of overlapping actions.

Core behaviour Induced behaviour in participants
Timekeeping Intentionally eating, sleeping, breathing and blinking at random intervals. This requires constant change, as circadian rhythms naturally stabilise.
Language Distorting all forms of body language, speech, writing and communication with others in both in-person meetings and digital media. Silence or the lack of a response was also a valid option.
Rules Randomly disrupting any form of self-driven tasks. E.g. reading a book and intentionally skipping chapters (against their original intentions), walking up stairs to a destination and taking steps back at random, etc.
Values Acting opposed to one’s principles, e.g. one who desires wealth subverts this principle by spending freely, and vice versa. Note that “morality” is secondary for the purposes of this concept, any action voluntarily opposing one’s principles is valid.
Meaning Participants were thoroughly interviewed by practicing psychiatrists for their views on life, particularly on their sense of fulfillment in daily tasks, perspective on nihilism, and overall contentment.

The informed group were instructed to subvert core behavioural modules, while it was imposed and enforced on the uninformed group. To maximise sensitivity and specificity, all informed participants were given the opportunity to leave the experiment at this stage while retaining the bonus. Identical tests were conducted in subgroups of individuals of varying levels of spirituality, physical health, physical traits and psychological states.

The results were striking. Broad trends are summarised below:

  • Among the informed group, environmental Hume levels decreased in all cases, while participant Hume levels increased, consistent with minor but statistically significant reality breaches.
  • Magnitude of Hume level changes scaled in proportion to the magnitude of the core behavioural module subversion.
  • Hume level changes were at a relatively low level. Though it is theoretically possible to induce a stable reality breach within the small groups, the scale and magnitude of intentional core behavioural module subversion required to manifest even a moderately sized reality breach would be non-trivial.
  • Among the uninformed group, no statistically significant changes in Hume levels were detected.
  • No statistically significant correlations were observed from demographic or religious factors to Hume level variations.
  • In all cases, there were no statistically significant correlations with Akiva radiation emissions, indicating a lack of faith or belief-driven phenomena.

Supporting evidence throughout recorded history

A review of the historical record provides another layer of justification for these findings. All the four great ancient civilisations independently developed concepts associated with the five core behavioural modules and ordering of the cosmos: Egypt’s ma’at, Mesopotamia’s me, India’s dharma, and China’s lǐ. A new proposal that other civilisations existed but went extinct from core module breaches is under discussion.

It should be noted that upon further investigation, all recorded initial trigger incidents associated with reality benders currently known to the Foundation show strong deviation from at least one of the core behavioural modules, with the magnitude of their reality warping scaling in proportion to the trigger incidents. The most straightforward and well-known examples of controlled, sustained core module deviation resulting in these incidents are the ascetic and cultivation practices of the xiān, fakirs, nahualli, and others6.

Well characterised anomalies

The established system of core behavioural modules serves as a useful classification framework for existing anomalies, tying their initial manifestation to deviations from core behavioural module(s). To obtain the full set of possible trigger events, a custom human-in-the-loop deep learning pipeline was developed7. Given the set of core behavioural modules and all available knowledge bases, potential trigger events were generated and ranked in order of likelihood for further experimental validation.

For brevity, only a subset of verified examples are provided to highlight that the origins of multiple independent anomalies can be explained by the aforementioned rules. At the time of this report, all predictions and/or experimental validations run to date have either empirically supported or provided credible preliminary evidence that initial manifestations of anomalous entities or phenomena are correlated with extreme deviation from at least one of the core behavioural modules listed above.

Anomaly Core behaviour Validated trigger event(s)
[[scp-035]] Words, Values, Rules, Meaning Previously circumstantial historical evidence of a similar-looking mask in the possession of Cesare Borgia before its later recovery in Venice was revisited in the context of SCP-9041. The first recorded reference to the mask was made during a visit by Niccolo Machiavelli to Borgia’s court following the Sinigaglia Massacre8. The confluence of multiple factors, including but not limited to: inverting core tenets of a belief system with full papal authority, inverting the meaning peace and massacre and weaponising family values is currently the leading theory behind the manifestation of SCP-0359. The significance of Sinigaglia (modern-day Senigallia) as a key Romance language isogloss10 is now categorised as collateral ontological fallout from the primary incident, with other isoglosses under various stages of investigation.
[[scp-049]] Rules, Values, Meaning Records from plague-devasted Avignon and Firenze circa 1350 CE mention a large subset of doctors, who being psychologically overwhelmed by the situation, intentionally discarded all patient care principles in treatment. While little information is available on SCP-049’s origin, the earliest known records of its sightings are concordant with the time period11.
[[scp-871]] Timekeeping, Rules, Values, Meaning A government official in the Qing dynasty, in an attempt to gain the emperor’s favour, hosted a slightly less lavish version of the Manchu-Han banquet where he feasted for six days and nights “to transform his ethnic identity”12. The scale and intent of the subversion of the original significance of the event meant to unify the world’s most populous nation-state at the time, was the most likely trigger for SCP-871’s original manifestation. A meta-analysis revealed multiple separate incidents among merchants travelling along the silk road with seemingly little rations, and a rate of diabetes mellitus significantly above the median after adjusting for nutritional and environmental conditions. Crucially, all conclusively dated reports occur after the approximate date of the banquet.
[[scp-914]] Rules Several separate organised and sustained mass worker revolts occurred circa 1850 CE in the form of intentional abandonment of all forms of behavioural self-regulation, subsequently affecting procedural consistency and protocols across lathe workshops from Saint Petersburg to the Crimean Peninsula and rendering all output irreproducible13. Shortly after, rumours of “preternaturally precise parts” circulated across Northern Europe, before the workshops were abandoned due to a period of on-going revolutions engulfing the region. Several components of [[scp-914]] were traced to the aforementioned workshops, though the origin of others have not been confirmed.

Future directions

The re-evaluation of all known anomalies against the set of five core behavioural modules is not complete, and in some cases may be impossible to fully verify. For reference purposes, a few key examples undergoing active re-investigation are listed below.

Anomaly Core behaviour Predicted trigger event(s)
[[scp-055]] Unconfirmed SCP-055 is known to maintain properties unique from other antimemetic entities: (a) the lack of a conventional functional amnesia response pattern ubiquitous in all other antimemetic entities, (b) the ineffectiveness of mnestics in recovering even trace memories of its properties, (c) its inertness to all known physical or anomalous metrics and (d) most importantly, the ability to remember what it is not. While originally considered to be a unique form of antimeme, with the discovery of SCP-9041, current leading theories regard it as a “stable unit of primordial non-being” or monad which has entered baseline reality due to a breach in core behavioural modules. In the scope of this theoretical model, its incompatibility with consciousness would manifest as symptoms analogous to amnesia. However, due to its singular nature, there is no consensus on what potential trigger events would have resulted in such a manifestation. Its current classification as an antimemetic entity is under active review.
[[scp-682]] Unconfirmed14 SCP-682’s resistance to all attempted methods of destruction seems also to extend to all attempted approaches to classification. “Proof-by-exhaustion” classification attempts culminated in revisiting SCP-682’s multidimensionality theory15, according to which, SCP-682’s existence overlaps in multiple alternate dimensions. Hence, it can be only fully neutralised by eliminating it in every universe simultaneously. Drawing on insight from SCP-055, if the monad theory holds, it is highly likely that SCP-682 may have some overlap with this primordial space.
The space and community where conventional naming conventions are absent Language, Timekeeping16 An unknown civilisation circa 1200 BCE eliminated the concept of individual naming17. Circumstantial evidence localises this nameless Eastern Mediterranean empire to between Karaoğlan18 near modern-day Ankara and the city of Pylos19. The above series of events culminated in the closed ecosystem where consistent labels cannot be applied to entities

Frequently asked questions

Full experimental logs associated with SCP-9041 were disclosed at the subsequent quarterly Foundation inter-site directors meeting, followed by a question and answer panel with the primary investigators of each study. Relevant questions and responses have been edited and summarised below for clarity, and will be appended to the next edition of the primer for staff with security clearance level 4 and above.

A: Before we begin, let us address the elephant in the room: How was this not discovered for so long? The answer is a boring one: (a) a straightforward confusion of correlation vs causation, (b) its passive nature only apparent at scale, and (c) its further obfuscation by the multiple variables involved, which under normal circumstances would be conflated with simple human error. Like many other facts now known20, it was a widespread assumption that nobody got around to testing, and was subtle enough to hide in plain sight.

Q: Why the classification?

Editor’s note: multiple variations of this question were raised.

A: At first glance, breaching SCP-9041 appears to be the simplest and easiest way to achieve a XK-class scenario. Fortunately, the opposite is true. Maintenance of core behavioural modules are a part of our fundamental instincts, and a natural fail-safe exists should one deviate too far from baseline behaviour. Furthermore, the passive buffer effect provided by the community as a whole acts to further maintain baseline reality in a given locality. The simple fact that “anomalies” are the exception and not the norm justifies the classification.

Q: Should the information be disclosed to [select anomalous organisations] to aid in preventative measures?

Editor’s note: multiple groups of interest were raised as candidates.

A: Information can be disclosed on a need-to-know basis following standard procedure, but note that disclosure is unlikely to be approved except under exceptional circumstances. First, unlike other containment protocols, their innocuous nature makes cover stories significantly easier to construct. Second, and more importantly, the knowledge that Type-Green reality benders can be created is not knowledge which we would like to be circulated widely.

At this point of time, to the best of the Foundation’s knowledge, no other groups of interest are known to be aware of this information. However, the close alignment between Sarkic rituals and controlled deviation from core behavioural modules are under review.

Q: Are these traits unique to humans or to all sapient organisms?

A: Unfortunately, testing this is not feasible at this time, though on-going monitoring of other sapient species is being conducted. For reasons described a minute ago, there can be no risk of disclosure of this information to other sapient species.

Q: Do we have an estimate on how many high-level reality benders have existed throughout history?

A: Almost a tautological question, and is impossible to accurately quantify by their nature. For obvious reasons, conventional observation of a high-level reality bender is ineffective. Current best practices track unique reality-bending “footprints” and other statistical anomalies over a long term, grouping them by uniqueness (i.e. Autonomous Paranormal Traces). The accurate tracking of high-level reality benders are further complicated by their common practice of assuming multiple different identities throughout history, for instance Hermes Trismegistus, Guǎn Lù, Abu Mashar al-Balkhi and the Comte de Saint Germain are now widely thought to be manifestations of the same entity. To illustrate the depth of the problem, the stable existence of only one high-level reality-bender has been conclusively verified21.

Q: In the context of the core behavioural modules and containment protocols, the overall implications of the studies conducted so far indicate that anomalies are functionally equivalent to “reality breaches”, can you comment on this point?

A: To answer your question directly, yes, they are both conceptually and functionally identical. To the best of our knowledge, these “reality breaches” occur on a spectrum, where stable and persistent reality breaches manifest as persistent anomalous entities, and short-term breaches manifest as instances of anomalous phenomena.

Expanding on this point further, let us consider the Scranton reality anchor which channels “reality” from alternate universes. The principle is not dissimilar, but in this context “reality breaches” caused by a deviation from core behavioural modules allow, for lack of a better word, an “original or primordial reality22” to emanate through the cracks.

And to be pedantic, the premise is incorrect. What we colloquially refer to as “anomalies” or “reality breaches” is actually the inverse, where elements of a more “real” dimension leak into and merge with elements of baseline reality. Technically, from an “original” perspective it is us who are anomalies. This is of course an oversimplification (for instance the more “primitive” dimension by definition has no elements), but we believe the analogy is suitable for illustrative purposes.

Editor’s note: To avoid confusion, containment protocols will continue to use the existing meaning of these terms.

Q: What would a hypothetical collective all-of-humanity abandonment of core behavioural modules reality breach look like in the most extreme scenario?

A: Given the current population size, an emanation of that scale would result in a proportionally extreme anomalous event and/or entity manifestation. An estimated Hume level breach of that magnitude is projected to have a collateral radius stretching beyond the outer Oort cloud.

In theory, in the far future where humanity spreads across the cosmos and a hypothetical collective reality breach occurs with sufficient critical mass, “nothing” would occur. As in, reality as we know it would “undo” itself.

Fortunately, neither of these scenarios are likely for previously mentioned reasons. The likelihood of many other, more localised XK-class scenarios occurring are multiple orders of magnitude higher than this one, at least in the present time.

Q: Can we quantify how much divergence from baseline behaviour is required to create a “reality breach”?

A: The process is inherently very noisy due to variability across humans, and the limit of detection of individual Kant counters. From the previous experimental logs, we have established a baseline confidence interval, though the variance is still rather high and requires further refinement.

Also, we established these baselines solely on an extrapolation of these low-level deviations. No experiments for inducing high-level reality breaches have yet been approved.

Q: Are some previously known side-effects of core behavioural module breaches, for example hallucinations caused by a lack of sleep, actually micro-reality breaches?

Experiments on this topic are currently being planned. The main difficulty here is that by definition, the breach would be so small that conventional Kant counters will have trouble distinguishing signal from background noise.

Q: What are the implications of this discovery for future defensive and offensive developments?

A: A separate symposium is being organised. Please circulate the upcoming flyer among interested staff.

Q: Are there common properties among the anomalies which have no known trigger?

A: First, among those who have verifiable chronologies, they all appear to pre-date human civilisation.

Second, they appear to have a “higher proportion” (for lack of a better term) of primordial reality, which is ultimately reflected in their object classes - usually at least Keter or equivalent.

Q: Following from that question, let us take the premise that humans create breaches in reality and anomalies by extension. Since anomalies exist that pre-date humanity, there must be a primum mobile of unreality?

A: An insightful question, and one independently raised by the O5 council. Yes, if the theory behind SCP-9041 is correct, there must exist such a prime mover of “un-reality” as a whole. Given that the theory has held up under all empirical testing so far, the search for the primum mobile is on-going.

We do have potential directions to explore, but these will not be expanded on at this time. We do not wish to oversell or overstate our claims, especially in the case of such a fundamental question. Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence, and our hypotheses will require extensive validation to the extent possible by current and future methods.

And so, he set off for the material world.”//]] ===== + SCP-9041 [[>]] [[module Rate]] [[/>]] [[include :scp-wiki:theme:black-highlighter-theme]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:acs-animation]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:customizable-acs |containment-class= euclid |containment-color= 255,211,0 |secondary-class= flor galana |secondary-color= 60,179,113 |inc-split-color= --]]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:customizable-acs |containment-class= euclid |containment-image= https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/component%3Aanomaly-class-bar/euclid-icon.svg |containment-color= 255,211,0 |inc-esoteric-layout = --]]] [[div class="anom-bar-esoteric"]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:anomaly-class-bar-source |item-number= 9041 |clearance= 4 |container-class= euclid |secondary-class= flor galana |secondary-icon= https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/local--files/chaos-arts/icon-CC-FlorGalana.svg |disruption-class= vlam |risk-class= warning ]] **Special Containment Procedures** As an early warning system, additional monitoring protocols have been integrated with both routine Foundation automated anomaly detection algorithms and manual surveys. Routine monitoring of all mass events are to continue with adjusted flagging thresholds for self-induced deviation from human behaviour associated with: //timekeeping, language, rules, values and meaning.// Large-scale events considered at-risk are to be prevented and dissolved where possible, and if not, Kant counters to be deployed with task forces on standby as a precaution. [[include component:image-block | name=along_river.png | position=right | caption=Humans throughout history naturally observe rites associated with timekeeping, language, rules, values and meaning.  | width=100% | style="float: right; margin: 10px;"]] In particular, preventative measures to regulate and rein in global wellness events, unorthodox spiritual movements and social media trends are the priority, including but not limited to: * A multi-pronged initiative of awareness campaigns by the World Health Organisation and at the grassroots level targeting alternative health practices are to be intensified and maintained. * At the same time, national governments are to be engaged to enforce stronger regulation of their respective healthcare sectors under the pretext of managing rapidly ageing populations, and/or pandemic preventative measures, with all forms of wellness events requiring government approval or strict regulation. * Similarly, the creation of a global legislative and enforcement framework under the pretext of monitoring misinformation and incitement of violence is in progress. * Monitoring and infiltration of unorthodox religious or spiritual movements, prioritising those with a greater number of members and/or more extreme practices. * Long-term cultural shifts easing any culturally entrenched forms of excessive working are to be steadily induced. * Greater investments into education, and improved physical and mental health services for the general public. The above measures are also being rolled out across Foundation sites in multiple stages, except where required for research purposes. To alleviate suspicion, a simple explanation citing a longitudinal study showing that greater staff morale is associated with increased work efficiency is to be provided as part of all new employee welcome packages with a clearance level below 4. All employees of security clearance level 4 and above will receive this document instead. Due to SCP-9041 naturally operating as a negative feedback loop, its robust fail-safe mechanism, and the relatively high critical mass required to trigger manifestations of SCP-9041-associated phenomena, direct intervention is seldom required. Regardless, active monitoring at a community level and intervention on a case-by-case basis is required to prevent potential escalation in the unlikely event of a mass breach. **Description** SCP-9041 collectively encompasses a set of intrinsic human behaviours which underpin conventional daily activities. Broadly, these can be categorised into core behavioural modules associated with: ||~ Behaviour   ||~ Description || || Timekeeping || Conducting activities in a periodic pattern || || Language     || The transfer of information to another || || Rules        || Any form of //innate// systematic behaviour || || Values       || Principles shaping one’s character || || Meaning      || Anything driven by a conscious purpose || In summary, these seemingly mundane activities constitute reality maintenance protocols. Deviation from these core behavioural modules have demonstrably resulted in anomalous events, scaling in proportion to the magnitude of deviation. Note that this only applies when //intentionally self-induced//. The act of involuntary behaviour or obstructing another from accomplishing these goals (e.g. in cases of famine or pandemic) does not appear to have a significant impact. The possibility that additional core behavioural modules may exist has not been excluded. However, most, if not all human behaviour are emergent properties made up of at least one of the above fundamental behaviours. For example, the actions below naturally involve at least one core module: ||~ Action ||~ Behavioural relation || || Eating || Timekeeping, Language, Rules, Values, Meaning || || Sleeping     || Timekeeping, Rules || || Breathing     || Timekeeping, Rules || || Talking      || Language, Rules, Values, Meaning || || Cooking      || Timekeeping, Language, Rules, Meaning || These behaviours are naturally self-containing, in that excess deviation under normal circumstances leads to death. In addition, even in the case where deviation occurs, the passive maintenance of core behaviour modules by other individuals nearby exert a natural buffer or suppressive force. As such, it is a //wicked problem//[[footnote]]Rittel, H. W., & Webber, M. M. (1973). //Dilemmas in a general theory of planning.// Policy sciences, 4(2), 155-169.[[/footnote]] from the perspective of any attempts at containment breach. At the time of writing, all anomalies known to the Foundation are undergoing review in the context of these five constants. **Addendum** [[tabview]] [[tab A: Initial discovery]] **Records of initial discovery** During a routine screen of anomaly patterns, a statistically significant non-random pattern of recurring minor anomalous phenomena were detected[[footnote]]Incidents emerging were consistently short-lived and/or so minor as to not require containment, for instance a sack of rice displacing a few grams more than its true mass, or a pen with twice the capacity of ink than should be physically possible. Containment task forces uncovered these details after an exhaustive characterisation of every item in an office building believed to be one of the focal points for an anomalous incident, and it is possible that more are present but unaccounted for.[[/footnote]], appearing to be associated with a large-scale global wellness movement primarily promoting extreme fasting and a dysregulation of sleep schedules (among other non-standard activities). Following standard procedures, a research team was assigned to the case, with pre-approved monitoring, memetic countermeasures, surveillance and intelligence gathering responses activated. However, this rapidly proved to be perplexing, with initial investigations sometimes providing conflicting and contradictory information. Unlike conventional scenarios, the correlation was both (a) reproducible and (b) had no apparent non-mundane causative factor. Notably, each group in the movement operated autonomously. After exhausting all standard preliminary investigation protocols, the case was subsequently escalated to the department-level, site-level and finally inter-site level. After approximately 388 days without the emergence of any credible theories or validated conclusions, (well above the median preliminary investigation cycle of 90 days) budget and ethical constraints were relaxed by the ethics committee, and collaboration with a carefully curated group of Foundation-affiliated academic institutes was permitted. For the next few months, cross-departmental Foundation teams approached the situation from every angle, including but not limited to chronology, memetics, tactical theology, and thaumaturgy. The eventual breakthrough was motivated by a researcher’s postulation: //if a signal is observable in data it is also explainable by data.// Following that, a longitudinal study was designed where every quantifiable piece of mundane and anomalous peripheral data (of any modality) over the long-term was collected: environmental variables, human physiological measurements from biosensor data, weather and atmospheric conditions, Kant counter fluctuations, Akiva radiation, etc. The complete list of measurements collected amounted to ~23000-27000 unique types[[footnote]]There is on-going debate on how certain measurements (for instance various spectra of psychological traits) should be categorised, available in the full experimental logs.[[/footnote]]. A custom deep learning pipeline was built in collaboration with the //Shénjīyíng//[[footnote]]神机营, Divine Machine Battalion[[/footnote]], operating on an ensemble model of Deepseek, Gemma and Qwen. In parallel, custom parsers were developed to handle nomenclative hazards, memetic infohazards and other data which cannot be safely ingested without triggering anomalous effects. Input data was collated into a series of sparse matrices and fed through this pipeline. The majority of compute resources from all Foundation facilities were diverted to this project, running for an estimated 33550336 GPU hours over 6 months. Five “clusters” emerged naturally from the data as visualised by a uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP). A laborious manual curation process was conducted, with multiple researchers independently reviewing the same data and taking a consensus. As a result, each of the five emergent clusters were assigned to the previously described categories: //timekeeping, values, language, rules, meaning[[footnote]]This multimodal and assumption-free approach is now being trialled on other anomalous events and entities which previously resisted investigative attempts.[[/footnote]]//. [[/tab]] [[tab B: Systematic evaluation]] **Systematic evaluation of core behavioural modules** Due to the sensitive nature of the experiment, voluntary testing with a 3-month bonus as an incentive was carried out on a carefully curated subset of Foundation employees with clearance levels 1 to 3, while maximising for demographic variation. All individuals gave informed consent to being amnesticised at the conclusion of the experiment series. Details of SCP-9041’s true nature were then provided to a group of participants (informed group), while others received intentionally misleading information (uninformed group). Multiple overlapping sets of Kant counters were tested and calibrated for high precision detection following iteratively refined benchmarking protocols. Note that individual core behaviours are rarely mutually exclusive. The core behavioural modules in the table below represent the primary behaviour in a set of overlapping actions. ||~ Core behaviour ||~ Induced behaviour in participants || || Timekeeping || Intentionally eating, sleeping, breathing and blinking at random intervals. This requires constant change, as circadian rhythms naturally stabilise. || || Language     || Distorting all forms of body language, speech, writing and communication with others in both in-person meetings and digital media. Silence or the lack of a response was also a valid option. || || Rules        || Randomly disrupting any form of self-driven tasks. E.g. reading a book and intentionally skipping chapters (against their original intentions), walking up stairs to a destination and taking steps back at random, etc. || || Values       || Acting opposed to one’s principles, e.g. one who desires wealth subverts this principle by spending freely, and vice versa. Note that “morality” is secondary for the purposes of this concept, any action voluntarily opposing one’s principles is valid. || || Meaning      || Participants were thoroughly interviewed by practicing psychiatrists for their views on life, particularly on their sense of fulfillment in daily tasks, perspective on nihilism, and overall contentment. || The informed group were instructed to subvert core behavioural modules, while it was imposed and enforced on the uninformed group. To maximise sensitivity and specificity, all //informed// participants were given the opportunity to leave the experiment at this stage while retaining the bonus. Identical tests were conducted in subgroups of individuals of varying levels of spirituality, physical health, physical traits and psychological states. The results were striking. Broad trends are summarised below: * Among the //informed// group, environmental Hume levels decreased in all cases, while participant Hume levels increased, consistent with minor but statistically significant reality breaches. * Magnitude of Hume level changes scaled in proportion to the magnitude of the core behavioural module subversion. * Hume level changes were at a relatively low level. Though it is theoretically possible to induce a stable reality breach within the small groups, the scale and magnitude of intentional core behavioural module subversion required to manifest even a moderately sized reality breach would be non-trivial. * Among the uninformed group, no statistically significant changes in Hume levels were detected. * No statistically significant correlations were observed from demographic or religious factors to Hume level variations. * In all cases, there were no statistically significant correlations with Akiva radiation emissions, indicating a lack of faith or belief-driven phenomena. [[/tab]] [[tab C: Supporting evidence]] **Supporting evidence throughout recorded history** A review of the historical record provides another layer of justification for these findings. All the four great ancient civilisations independently developed concepts associated with the five core behavioural modules and ordering of the cosmos: Egypt’s //ma’at//, Mesopotamia’s //me//, India’s //dharma//, and China’s //lǐ//. A new proposal that other civilisations existed but went extinct from core module breaches is under discussion. It should be noted that upon further investigation, all recorded initial trigger incidents associated with reality benders currently known to the Foundation show strong deviation from at least one of the core behavioural modules, with the magnitude of their reality warping scaling in proportion to the trigger incidents. The most straightforward and well-known examples of controlled, sustained core module deviation resulting in these incidents are the ascetic and cultivation practices of the //xiān, fakirs, nahualli,// and others[[footnote]]While the knowledge that Type Blues can be induced is known to the Foundation, the implication that Type Greens can be induced and/or are on the same spectrum is new, and is the primary reason for the security clearance level.[[/footnote]]. [[/tab]] [[tab D: Well characterised anomalies]] **Well characterised anomalies** The established system of core behavioural modules serves as a useful classification framework for existing anomalies, tying their initial manifestation to deviations from core behavioural module(s). To obtain the full set of possible trigger events, a custom human-in-the-loop deep learning pipeline was developed[[footnote]]A fork of the previously described pipeline used to identify the initial anomaly. Where possible, a consensus of experts in the fields associated with the corresponding anomalies was reached.[[/footnote]]. Given the set of core behavioural modules and all available knowledge bases, potential trigger events were generated and ranked in order of likelihood for further experimental validation. For brevity, only a subset of verified examples are provided to highlight that the origins of multiple independent anomalies can be explained by the aforementioned rules. At the time of this report, all predictions and/or experimental validations run to date have either empirically supported or provided credible preliminary evidence that initial manifestations of anomalous entities or phenomena are correlated with extreme deviation from at least one of the core behavioural modules listed above. ||~ Anomaly ||~ Core behaviour ||~ Validated trigger event(s) || || [[scp-035]] || Words, Values, Rules, Meaning || Previously circumstantial historical evidence of a similar-looking mask in the possession of Cesare Borgia before its later recovery in Venice was revisited in the context of SCP-9041. The first recorded reference to the mask was made during a visit by Niccolo Machiavelli to Borgia’s court following the Sinigaglia Massacre[[footnote]]Niccolo Machiavelli in his personal correspondences with contemporaries commented that he observed him conversing, often all night, with SCP-035, and that “it would not engage in conversation without his direct permission, and around him adopted an expression that was “neither comedic nor sorrowful, but one formal and respectful”.[[/footnote]]. The confluence of multiple factors, including but not limited to: inverting core tenets of a belief system with full papal authority, inverting the meaning peace and massacre and weaponising family values is currently the leading theory behind the manifestation of SCP-035[[footnote]]Counter-intuitively, individuals occupying leading positions in high-control groups are less likely to fulfil the trigger condition of conscious, intentional subversion. Three simple reasons exist. First, few of their organisations operate on the scale of a major religion and have less “subversion weight”. Second, high-control groups often result in greater reinforcement of most core behavioural modules, buffering any lapses in others. Third, individuals leading high-control groups typically have Cluster B personality disorders. As such, they have lower self-awareness, with their actions having a proportionally lower impact by default. Though the implications are of significant interest, a discussion of Cesare Borgia’s true motivations and intentions is outside the scope of this document.[[/footnote]]. The significance of Sinigaglia (modern-day Senigallia) as a key Romance language isogloss[[footnote]]Renzi, Lorenzo (1985). //Nuova introduzione alla filologia romanza.// Bologna: il Mulino. p. 176. ISBN 88-15-04340-3.[[/footnote]] is now categorised as collateral ontological fallout from the primary incident, with other isoglosses under various stages of investigation. || || [[scp-049]] || Rules, Values, Meaning || Records from plague-devasted Avignon and Firenze circa 1350 CE mention a large subset of doctors, who being psychologically overwhelmed by the situation, intentionally discarded all patient care principles in treatment. While little information is available on SCP-049’s origin, the earliest known records of its sightings are concordant with the time period[[footnote]]The possibility that this entity was originally human, implying that multiple instances of SCP-049 may exist, has not been ruled out. However, this is unlikely given the high magnitude of core-behaviour deviation required for manifesting a single instance of a stable anomaly, and the fact that there are no known sightings of other SCP-049 instances.[[/footnote]]. || || [[scp-871]] || Timekeeping, Rules, Values, Meaning || A government official in the Qing dynasty, in an attempt to gain the emperor’s favour, hosted a slightly less lavish version of the Manchu-Han banquet where he feasted for six days and nights “to transform his ethnic identity”[[footnote]]After the date of this banquet, the Grand Secretariat’s influence was rapidly curbed by the Kangxi emperor.[[/footnote]]. The scale and intent of the subversion of the original significance of the event meant to unify the world’s most populous nation-state at the time, was the most likely trigger for SCP-871’s original manifestation. A meta-analysis revealed multiple separate incidents among merchants travelling along the silk road with seemingly little rations, and a rate of //diabetes mellitus// significantly above the median after adjusting for nutritional and environmental conditions. Crucially, all conclusively dated reports occur after the approximate date of the banquet. || || [[scp-914]] || Rules || Several separate organised and sustained mass worker revolts occurred circa 1850 CE in the form of intentional abandonment of all forms of behavioural self-regulation, subsequently affecting procedural consistency and protocols across lathe workshops from Saint Petersburg to the Crimean Peninsula and rendering all output irreproducible[[footnote]]Active monitoring of several developer communities associated with the statistical programming language R has now been established as a precaution.[[/footnote]]. Shortly after, rumours of “preternaturally precise parts” circulated across Northern Europe, before the workshops were abandoned due to a period of on-going revolutions engulfing the region. Several components of [[scp-914]] were traced to the aforementioned workshops, though the origin of others have not been confirmed. || [[/tab]] [[tab E: Future directions]] **Future directions** The re-evaluation of all known anomalies against the set of five core behavioural modules is not complete, and in some cases may be impossible to fully verify. For reference purposes, a few key examples undergoing active re-investigation are listed below. ||~ Anomaly ||~ Core behaviour ||~ Predicted trigger event(s) || || [[scp-055]] || Unconfirmed || SCP-055 is known to maintain properties unique from other antimemetic entities: (a) the lack of a conventional functional amnesia response pattern ubiquitous in all other antimemetic entities, (b) the ineffectiveness of mnestics in recovering even trace memories of its properties, (c) its inertness to all known physical or anomalous metrics and (d) most importantly, the ability to remember what it is //not//. While originally considered to be a unique form of antimeme, with the discovery of SCP-9041, current leading theories regard it as a “stable unit of primordial non-being” or //monad// which has entered baseline reality due to a breach in core behavioural modules. In the scope of this theoretical model, its incompatibility with consciousness would manifest as symptoms analogous to amnesia. However, due to its singular nature, there is no consensus on what potential trigger events would have resulted in such a manifestation. Its current classification as an antimemetic entity is under active review. || || [[scp-682]] || Unconfirmed[[footnote]]At time of writing, SCP-682 remains as one of the few thoroughly investigated anomalies not correlated to a deviation from core behavioural modules.[[/footnote]] || SCP-682’s resistance to all attempted methods of destruction seems also to extend to all attempted approaches to classification. “Proof-by-exhaustion” classification attempts culminated in revisiting SCP-682’s multidimensionality theory[[footnote]]While originally the leading theory, it lost credence after the Foundation’s successful elimination of unrelated multidimensional entities, leading researchers to believe that SCP-682 may be something different.[[/footnote]], according to which, SCP-682’s existence overlaps in multiple alternate dimensions. The above series of events culminated in [[span style="color:green"]]**the closed ecosystem where consistent labels cannot be applied to entities**[[/span]] || [[/tab]] [[tab F: Frequently asked questions]] **Frequently asked questions** Full experimental logs associated with SCP-9041 were disclosed at the subsequent quarterly Foundation inter-site directors meeting, followed by a question and answer panel with the primary investigators of each study. Relevant questions and responses have been edited and summarised below for clarity, and will be appended to the next edition of the primer for staff with security clearance level 4 and above. [[div class="blockquote"]] A: Before we begin, let us address the elephant in the room: //How was this not discovered for so long?// The answer is a boring one: (a) a straightforward confusion of correlation vs causation, (b) its passive nature only apparent at scale, and (c) its further obfuscation by the multiple variables involved, which under normal circumstances would be conflated with simple human error. Like many other facts now known[[footnote]]Aristotle claimed that women had less teeth than men, but it did not appear to have occurred to him to count them.[[/footnote]], it was a widespread assumption that nobody got around to testing, and was subtle enough to hide in plain sight. Q: Why the classification? //Editor’s note: multiple variations of this question were raised.// A: At first glance, breaching SCP-9041 appears to be the simplest and easiest way to achieve a XK-class scenario. Fortunately, the opposite is true. Maintenance of core behavioural modules are a part of our fundamental instincts, and a natural fail-safe exists should one deviate too far from baseline behaviour. Furthermore, the passive buffer effect provided by the community as a whole acts to further maintain baseline reality in a given locality. The simple fact that “anomalies” are the exception and not the norm justifies the classification. Q: Should the information be disclosed to [select anomalous organisations] to aid in preventative measures? //Editor’s note: multiple groups of interest were raised as candidates.// A: Information can be disclosed on a need-to-know basis following standard procedure, but note that disclosure is unlikely to be approved except under exceptional circumstances. First, unlike other containment protocols, their innocuous nature makes cover stories significantly easier to construct. Second, and more importantly, the knowledge that Type-Green reality benders can be //created// is not knowledge which we would like to be circulated widely. At this point of time, to the best of the Foundation’s knowledge, no other groups of interest are known to be aware of this information. However, the close alignment between Sarkic rituals and controlled deviation from core behavioural modules are under review. Q: Are these traits unique to humans or to all sapient organisms? A: Unfortunately, testing this is not feasible at this time, though on-going monitoring of other sapient species is being conducted. For reasons described a minute ago, there can be no risk of disclosure of this information to other sapient species. Q: Do we have an estimate on how many high-level reality benders have existed throughout history? A: Almost a tautological question, and is impossible to accurately quantify by their nature. For obvious reasons, conventional observation of a high-level reality bender is ineffective. Current best practices track unique reality-bending “footprints” and other statistical anomalies over a long term, grouping them by uniqueness (i.e. Autonomous Paranormal Traces). The accurate tracking of high-level reality benders are further complicated by their common practice of assuming multiple different identities throughout history, for instance Hermes Trismegistus, Guǎn Lù, Abu Mashar al-Balkhi and the Comte de Saint Germain are now widely thought to be manifestations of the same entity. To illustrate the depth of the problem, the stable existence of only one high-level reality-bender has been conclusively verified[[footnote]]The Yellow Millet One Dream World Warning Immortal 黄粱一梦警世真君 (colloquial title) voluntarily provided his true name in the Library’s records.[[/footnote]]. Q: In the context of the core behavioural modules and containment protocols, the overall implications of the studies conducted so far indicate that anomalies are functionally equivalent to “reality breaches”, can you comment on this point? A: To answer your question directly, yes, they are both conceptually and functionally identical. To the best of our knowledge, these “reality breaches” occur on a spectrum, where stable and persistent reality breaches manifest as persistent anomalous entities, and short-term breaches manifest as instances of anomalous phenomena. Expanding on this point further, let us consider the Scranton reality anchor which channels “reality” from alternate universes. The principle is not dissimilar, but in this context “reality breaches” caused by a deviation from core behavioural modules allow, for lack of a better word, an “original or primordial reality[[footnote]]A dimension or dimensions which do not adhere to any dimensional classification criteria.[[/footnote]]” to emanate through the cracks. And to be pedantic, the premise is incorrect. What we colloquially refer to as “anomalies” or “reality breaches” is actually the inverse, where elements of a more “real” dimension leak into and merge with elements of baseline reality. Technically, from an “original” perspective it is us who are anomalies. This is of course an oversimplification (for instance the more “primitive” dimension by definition has no elements), but we believe the analogy is suitable for illustrative purposes. //Editor’s note: To avoid confusion, containment protocols will continue to use the existing meaning of these terms.// Q: What would a hypothetical collective all-of-humanity abandonment of core behavioural modules reality breach look like in the most extreme scenario? A: Given the current population size, an emanation of that scale would result in a proportionally extreme anomalous event and/or entity manifestation. An estimated Hume level breach of that magnitude is projected to have a collateral radius stretching beyond the outer Oort cloud. In theory, in the far future where humanity spreads across the cosmos and a hypothetical collective reality breach occurs with sufficient critical mass, “nothing” would occur. As in, reality as we know it would “undo” itself. Fortunately, neither of these scenarios are likely for previously mentioned reasons. The likelihood of many other, more localised XK-class scenarios occurring are multiple orders of magnitude higher than this one, at least in the present time. Q: Can we quantify how much divergence from baseline behaviour is required to create a “reality breach”? A: The process is inherently very noisy due to variability across humans, and the limit of detection of individual Kant counters. From the previous experimental logs, we have established a baseline confidence interval, though the variance is still rather high and requires further refinement. Also, we established these baselines solely on an extrapolation of these low-level deviations. No experiments for inducing high-level reality breaches have yet been approved. Q: Are some previously known side-effects of core behavioural module breaches, for example hallucinations caused by a lack of sleep, actually micro-reality breaches? Experiments on this topic are currently being planned. The main difficulty here is that by definition, the breach would be so small that conventional Kant counters will have trouble distinguishing signal from background noise. Q: What are the implications of this discovery for future defensive and offensive developments? A: A separate symposium is being organised. Please circulate the upcoming flyer among interested staff. Q: Are there common properties among the anomalies which have no known trigger? A: First, among those who have verifiable chronologies, they all appear to pre-date human civilisation. Second, they appear to have a “higher proportion” (for lack of a better term) of primordial reality, which is ultimately reflected in their object classes - usually at least Keter or equivalent. Q: Following from that question, let us take the premise that humans create breaches in reality and anomalies by extension. Since anomalies exist that pre-date humanity, there must be a //primum mobile// of unreality? A: An insightful question, and one independently raised by the O5 council. Yes, if the theory behind SCP-9041 is correct, there must exist such a prime mover of “un-reality” as a whole. Given that the theory has held up under all empirical testing so far, the search for the //primum mobile// is on-going. We do have potential directions to explore, but these will not be expanded on at this time. We do not wish to oversell or overstate our claims, especially in the case of such a fundamental question. Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence, and our hypotheses will require extensive validation to the extent possible by current and future methods. However, it is appended to this document for reference purposes while their association is being investigated further.// A transcript of a translated note discovered scribbled in the margins of a hardcover book located in “dado trader of fine copper ingots and liquor shop[[footnote]]Sign in the form of a cuneiform clay tablet contemporary to the time period[[/footnote]]” dated to circa 1750 BCE at an archeological site in Dilmun (دلمون), modern day Kuwait. SCP-9042.raw_content:
A careless gardener sows an eager crop.

Few remember why we turned our eyes from the sky.

When we accepted being alone in the vast universe as the only truth.

When the allure of the stars became nothing but empty ash and swirling rust.

When we returned to holding the wilds of this world as the only frontier remaining.

Perhaps if our eyes had not been forced lower, they would have been lost to us instead.

Not that it matters now. The hands have slipped. The stars are fracturing.

Our siblings await beyond the skies.
