Due to the anomaly's indestructible properties, which was identified as extending to all man-made objects, research efforts were taking longer than anticipated. While the research and translation of documents was proceeding, a second expedition heading to take over L.O.I.B2, was put together.

Expedition Log

Preface: Due to the continued presence of multiple prehistoric entities surrounding L.O.I.B2, a division of MTF Phi-2 (Clever Girls) was provided with class-W mnestics and tasked to, alongside Team Lima, contain or disperse the anomalous entities and secure access to L.O.I.B2. A small squadron of MTF Delta-45 (Rolling Thunder) agents was left on standby in case backup was necessary.

Date: 3/01/2024

Expedition Team: Agent Rodriguez(L2), Agent Asent(L3), Agent Ortiz(L4), Agent Rivera(L5), Agent Farraday(L6), Agent Gomez(L7), Agent Towers(L8), Agent Holland(P2), Agent Gines(P3), Agent Jewels(P4), Agent Zultan(P5), Agent Pimentel(P6)

Expedition Leads: Commander Nile Collins(L1), Commander Ilsa Undveld(P1), Commander Jake Gregors(D1)

[Begin Log]

The sun is in the middle of the sky, with clouds of dust obscuring 30% visibility as the teams pass through the rocky bushlands. Lima-1 drives an armored Jeep, with Lima-2 on the passenger seat and Lima-3 and -4 readying equipment in the back. Lima-1 looks to his right. There are two armored trucks with large containment cages on their beds, varying in sizes of 3 to 5 meters. They are being driven by the members of MTF Phi-2. On the left is the rest of Lima squad in their own armored Jeep.

Phi-2-1: Coming up on Beta two, everyone keep a lookout.

Through the dust, the top of a large stone ziggurat becomes visible from behind fortified stone walls. A giant stone archway gives passage into the fortress.

Phi-2-5: I see 'em! East!

From behind the walls, several skeletal entities emerge charging towards the agents. There are 4 entities in total. The two largest entities resemble mastodon skeletons, albeit with several parts of their body protected by metal armor, and the two others appear to be a tethyshadros and a type of saber-toothed feline.

The Phi-2 squadron separates from team Lima, staying back to unload the cages. Lima team continues to engage with the entities.

Lima-1: Alright everyone, you know the drill. Immobilize, then contain. Four, Seven, you're up!

Lima-4 opens the jeep's sunroof, carrying a portable missile launcher. On the other jeep, Lima-7 does the same. A few moments later, two rockets fly across the landscape, landing close to the entities. The blast breaks apart one of the smaller entities, while knocking down another, but the mastodons keep charging forward. The rest of the agents open fire on the anomalies.

The two vehicles are able to dodge the oncoming collisions and continue suppressive fire on the entities. While the armor receives no damage, the areas of exposed bone slowly begin to break apart. The entities attempt to knock away the vehicles, but the agents are able to maneuver out of the attacks.

After 2 minutes of continuous sustained firing, each of the mastodons loses one leg, causing them to collapse.

Lima-1: Phi-1, three targets immobilized, one terminated. You are clear for containment.

Phi-2-1: Copy that Lima One, we're-

One of the downed skeletal instances lets out a loud roar, followed by a distant rumbling. From the fortress' gates, a large skeletal specimen resembling a mansourasaurus slowly lumbers towards the team. Close behind, a wave of several dozen raptor-like entities2 rapidly approach team Lima.

Lima-5: Holy shit!

Lima-8: Captain, what's the plan?

Lima-1: Phi One, how long before you can get containment ready?

Phi-2-1: The small one's too far, but if you can buy us a few minutes, we can get at least one of the elephants ready to go.

Lima-1: Copy. Lima Five, follow me.

The two vehicles make a hard left, heading towards a hillside in the distance. Lima agents fire their weapons towards the crowd of entities, prompting them to follow away from Phi-2.

Lima-1: Delta-45, once we come back around, we're going to need you to create as much distance between us and the entities as possible.

Delta-45-1: Understood Lima One, making our way to you.

The two vehicles reach the hill and begin rapidly ascending.

Lima-1: Ready up the next round of missiles! We're blasting away as many of these fuckers as we can.

As they're about to crest the hill, the jeeps make a hard left, executing a U turn back towards the fortress. During the turn, Lima-4 and Lima-7 fire two more missiles into the crowd, shattering several of the skeletal entities and causing the rest to momentarily hesitate.

In that moment of hesitation, Delta-45 arrives on the scene, firing a barrage of gunfire and explosives which either destroys or disperses the rest of the entities. The Mansourasaurus attempts to reach Delta-45, but all the agents maneuver around it, eventually taking it down, but not destroying it.

Lima-3: Woo! Like fish in a barrel!

Lima-1: Thanks for the assist Delta. Standby for further action.

Delta-45-1: Not a problem Lima. Ya'll just get your sorry asses back to Phi.

Lima-1: Phi One, what's your status?

Phi-2-1: Well, we managed to corral these sons-a-guns into the cages, and even managed to snag ourselves a little extra. Those two that you blew up a bit ago? They reformed. Nothing we couldn't handle though.

Delta-45-1: Yeap, same thing happening over here.

Lima-1 looks back, all of the skeletons and their shattered pieces can be seen slowly reforming back together into complete instances. Before they can do much though, they are driven away or injured by Delta-45.

Delta-45-1: Don't worry about over here, we got these handled. Just get to the Fortress and let command know to bring more units for the takeover. And a bigger cage for long neck over 'ere.

Team Lima reaches Phi-2, which have now captured the first four entities that attacked the agents. The entities attempt to bite the agents and crash against the bars but are unable to break out of containment. Lima-3 looks out of the window as Phi-2-1 approaches.

Lima-3: Just another day?

Phi-2-1: <sighs> Just another day.

Lima-1: Command, we've secured the perimeter of Beta Two and dispersed all known hostiles. Requesting additional units for infiltration of the structure itself.

Command: Copy that Lima One, remain on standby for further action.

[End Log]

Following the takeover of the structure, several more discoveries were made within the primary ziggurat, including documents, anomalies, and non-hostile entities.

Trading with those of the Kingdom in the Sands was a wise choice indeed, though that shouldn't come as much of a surprise, since you have yet to lead us astray. Not only do we have access to more resources than we know what to do with, we can also do away with the tablets and lend our words on these parchments. Much better and easier in my opinion.

Now, the real matter of this text regards a request on my behalf. I believe that expansion of our trading port is necessary. We have several members of our peoples wishing to embark on further expeditions, and we do not have space for all our new resources without immediate transportation. Perhaps transforming this port into a settlement would prove much more beneficial for the future.

Acacius, 10th of the Spears

Another fleet approached from the west. They bore the icon of the Tartessians. Despite the little threat, the Legion of the Deep took swift action against the aggressors. Though, we let one vessel go as an envoy to the vapid monarchs.

Not only should this eliminate Tartessos as an enemy, after all they must see they are outmatched, but it shall also reinforce our power to the western kingdoms. While I understand your insistence in the pursuit of further action, I suggest we assuage more important matters. If it really irritates you, we can have Ushar handle the negotiations.

The legion and I shall continue as assigned. The tribes of the south should arrive at the meeting place in a matter of days. Await my return no later than eight nights.

Euthymia, 5th of the Spears

My king,

There is no winning this war. Our best solution is integration and collaboration. I do not doubt your strength or might, but this is not a case of individual strength. They harbor magics from beyond this world, accursed things capable of reducing men to ash and buildings to rubble in mere moments. Their numbers are many, not to mention their allies. An approach by sea would be hard enough as it is due to the monsters that prowl their waters. And even if we reached their city, the emperor and his Spears would rend us all to nought but dust.

Reconsider your plans, otherwise, I fear what will happen next.

Mnesus, chief advisor

Last of a Line

I am the last of a line,

Not a line of blood,

Nor rulers most divine,

Or men united through death and mud

I am the last of a kingdom

One whose light shone bright,

Built on backs of work and wisdom,

Whose life was snatched by horrid blight

Nothing remains of us but me,

Standing in the dust of our life laid bare,

The blight is gone, returning to their hell on the sea

Uncaring of our silent despair

Curse that tyrant king, defiler of natures,

I am the last of a line,

The third port has been established, no doubt Rex expects to send out an expedition to the south waters soon. I hope not. I believe we will find more success with the fledgling Assyrians. Should we make them allies, I believe expansion would be much easier in the future. But I digress, this should be a catalogue, not detailings on personal quarrels.

Progress with the harvesting of the crystal flowers is… moderate. We've yet to figure out an efficient method of collection and storage without damaging the geodes. However, what we are able to gain should suffice for now.

Tetra's development of further magics is fruitful to say the least, and Yss'gvan's training regimens have brought forth a myriad of skillful soldiers. Though of course, Acacius stole some of the recruits to man his ships in the northern fleet. Yss'gvan was not happy about that.

Rex's vision is coming to fruition. Slowly, but it's coming. I can see what he meant that day. I can't wait to see the fruit of our labors.

Seraphion, Keeper

Let the gardeners of the Haven know to hurry up with the harvests. For the others: For the love of all that is natural and unnatural, armor the bone beasts. I'm burning through materials and patience every time I need to reanimate one because you thought the added protection was unnecessary.

Tetra, 3rd of the Spears

This is the last testament of the Dunewalkers4, those who fly in the storms of earth. The Seaenid tyrant and his Thirteen Spears will soon march upon our land, but we will not bend. Like the earth that bore us and the storms that grant us flight, we will resist, rage, and tremble until our last breath. When we fall, let the sands claim us as they will all who borrowed life from its essence, as all things return from whence they came. Should anything of us be left after this conflict, then let it at least be this: We did not die in silence.

It seems that any individual's ability for unnatural abilities is determined prior to their birth, but is not entirely unchangeable. While it was believed that only magically inclined individuals could perform magic, that has been proven to be untrue, as demonstrated by my multiple examinations with unnatural artifacts and our soldiers. Clearly, already magical items or entities can change a person's nature to be magical themselves, or grant enough leeway to be able to use their properties correctly.

Take for example the Vitaentomo, their regenerative abilities directly changed our physiology through simple consumption. The insect's properties even awakened the latent magical potential within Lina, which would have otherwise gone unseen for, presumably, the rest of her life.

All of this is to indicate that we do not have to abide by what can or cannot be. The rules are there, but they can be changed, bent, broken. Of course, it will take hardship and strain, as all progress does, but eventually, we will succeed. As a first test, I suggest we conquer the seas. Lend me a battalion, and I'll ensure that they will be a force that need not fear the temper of the raging waters, but rather, use them as their own.

Your majesty,

They grow bolder by the day. A battalion was struck down a night ago by their legion of aberrations. It was those monstrous beasts of the 8th. They trespass and attack despite the treaties and believe we wouldn't notice. Should no action be taken, what's to stop them from taking more? I refuse to allow this blatant arrogance to go on further. Let me take my fleet. I will make an example out of their monsters. And should I fail, I expect no recognition of my works should conflict arrive on our doorstep.

General Tarthanus

This place… it really is something. Once a measly camp, now a fortified monument to our military ambitions. It's a sight to see indeed, and to think, it was built only mere seconds ago. Such is the gift that is that piece of rock, or as Rex would call it, the Staff of Strength. However obvious the name can be, the thing does live up to its name. A ziggurat, surrounded by encampments on all sides, homes and structures lining maze-like paths, and impenetrable walls where there was none before, made up of the purest and hardest stones that made up this rocky soil.

Impressive, to say the least.

Now that the Unseen is slain, I curse its name one hundred times and its being one hundred more, I wonder what he plans to do next. He told us we would meet at dusk and reveal his next quest to all. I'll write what has been said, as demanded by the duty bestowed upon me for my gift of rememberance of all that is written and read. I mark down the death of our great foe. The Unseen is no more, slain by the chief, Rex'aeter, and his Thirteen Spears. And with its death we celebrate new life, the renewed vigor of our once declining clan. A monument has been built, Robore-men, for it is with strength of mind that we push ourselves to take on the impossible.

Seraphion, Keeper

I̅X̅-1 are animate skeletal entities resembling prehistoric creatures which were previously found in the prehistoric European landscape. I̅X̅-1 behave similarly to how their non-anomalous counterpart would when they existed, but also possess the ability to communicate with other I̅X̅-1 instances regardless of the species they originate from. Due to their bodies being entirely composed of a skeletal structure, they do not need the basic requirements of food, sleep, or water.

Documents suggest that I̅X̅-1 instances were created through a thaumaturgic ritual involving the blood of several key figures in SCP-9225 culture, I̅X̅-2, and other currently unknown substances. Tests have shown that instances share a hivemind-like consciousness which likely contributes to their ability to communicate and work in tandem with one another, likely a result of I̅X̅-2 used during their creation.

Based on evidence found in ancient texts, as well as their encounter with the MTFs assigned to take L.O.I.B2, it appears likely that I̅X̅-1 instances were created specifically to serve as soldiers, siege weapons, spies, or defensive sentries. It is unknown how these entities were managed during and outside of combat.

As of current occupation of SCP-9225, a total of 10 I̅X̅-1 variants have been identified and catalogued. Variants include:

- Mastodons
- Tethyshadros
- Smilodons
- Mansourasaurus
- Scipionyx
- Saltriovenator
- Basilosaurus
- Elasmosaurus
- Efraasia
- Liopleurodon

I̅X̅-2 is an anomalous fungal species which, when ingested, provides a telepathic link between all who consume it. The fungus, colored green with lavender stalks, was found stored within several storage containers at L.O.I.B2. Its effects are present regardless of whether I̅X̅-2 is transformed into a gas or liquid. It is theorized that I̅X̅-2 was the primary method of controlling I̅X̅-1 instances, as well as increasing effectiveness between soldiers and workers during the empire's existence.

The origin of I̅X̅-2 is as of yet unknown.

Update: I̅X̅-2 instances grow in abundance within L.O.I.D2-B's tunnel system, and is, thus far, the only known place to find I̅X̅-2.

I̅X̅-3 is a golden lyre composed of 10 strings and decorated with carved sun imagery and topaz gems. When under direct sunlight, I̅X̅-3 can be used to generate concentrated energy beams or constructs. The intensity and strength of the energy released by I̅X̅-3 is dependant on the skill with which the lyre is played. The anomaly's effects also seem partially dependent on the user's will, as the form the constructs take, as well as the lethality of the energy released, relies on what the user wishes to do.

Documentation regarding this anomaly reveal that it was a relic stolen during a raid of a settlement within Greece. Further specifics are not mentioned.

I̅X̅-4 are an anomalous species of flora composed entirely of an organic rock structure. The structures making up their petals, leaves, anthers, and seeds, however, are all made up of organic crystals of varying shapes and colors. I̅X̅-4 instances can be found all across SCP-9225 in mountainous or rocky terrains, as I̅X̅-4 instances require large amounts of sediment and minerals, which they absorb from surrounding geological material, in order to grow to maturity.

I̅X̅-4 members can manifest as a variety of different flora, including but not limited to: Trees, flowers, vines, and shrubs. The crystalline structures, other than their origins, are nearly identical to non-anomalous crystals and can be used as such without incident.

Expedition Log

Preface: Due to SCP-9225-A's importance in the culture preceding SCP-9225, as well as its strategic point as the center of the anomaly, Team Lima was dispatched to explore and map out as much of the city layout as possible.

Date:3/12/2024

Expedition Team: Agent Rodriguez(L2), Agent Asent(L3), Agent Ortiz(L4), Agent Rivera(L5), Agent Farraday(L6), Agent Gomez(L7), Agent Towers(L8)

Expedition Leads: Commander Nile Collins(L1)

[Begin Log]

The feed opens in front of SCP-9225-A's gargantuan gate, it is the only open method into the city. The walls dwarf the agents and extend far to each side, connecting with the mountain. Behind the agents, a temporary camp of Foundation personnel has been set up in order to conduct research, provide backup if necessary, and make the establishment of a base simpler. It is morning.

Lima-1: Sound equipment check everyone.

All agents: Check

Lima-1: Command, you read us on your end.

Lima-1 looks back. From a set of computers in the camp, a female agent stands up, signalling a thumbs up.

Command: Loud and clear Lima One.

The agents turn and walk towards SCP-9225-A's gate.

Lima-1: Into the mouth of the beast then.

The team goes through the gates, following a dirt path into the city itself. In the lowest layer, the layout seems to consist mostly of small domestic buildings, farm lands, and simple shops separated and unevenly spread throughout. The residences are relatively small, bearing two floors, and are composed primarily of mudbrick and various types of stone. The fields they pass are abundant with crops, and several carts and wooden wagons litter the road. Multiple non-anomalous creatures can be seen roaming the cityscape.

As they walk, the path splits into multiple roads, alleyways, and streets. In the far distance, stairs and ramps can be seen going upwards to the higher layers.

Lima-7: Psst! Entities on our nine.

The agents look to their left. In one of the farther fields, a wooden humanoid can be seen tending to the crops, removing some and placing them into a tweed basket. The entity does not notice them. In further fields, several more can be seen doing the same. Lima-1 signals for them to approach quietly.

As the image of the entity gets clearer, its figure becomes more defined. It is made of tree bark, with the area above the waist resembling a male humanoid figure, while its lower area is made up of multiple sets of long roots that it uses as legs or extra arms. The top of its head sprouts branches and leaves, forming a small canopy.

Lima-2: Looks… friendly?

When the agents reach a close enough distance, the entity turns to look at them. Its face is featureless, with the exception of two carved holes that serve as its eyes. A soft green light emanates from within the holes. It stares at the agents momentarily, then returns to harvesting the field.

Lima-1: Command, we've come across our first anomalous entity. It appears to be non-hostile.

Command: Copy, any further details?

Lima-1: Partial humanoid, composition and appearance of a tree, and from the looks of it, they mostly just collect crops.

Command: Understood, you may continue the expedition.

The agents turn back to the roads. The wooden entity does not react to them leaving. Further along the pathways, the agents reach a plaza of moderate size. There are stalls along the edges and the center storing a variety of foods and items. The team searches the stalls, but other than finding instances of I̅X̅-2 and jewlery made using I̅X̅-4, no further anomalies are discovered.

Exploration of the rest of the layer reveals mostly the same layout of residences, farm land, and shops. Once the area has been marked, the team ascends to the next layer of SCP-9225-A.

Team Lima emerges near a large town hall connected to a section filled with larger buildings. The town hall is decorated with intricate patterns and royal imagery, depicting images of a regal figure reaching out to several individuals. Above the hall is a nest of unknown avians. The creatures have three sets of feathered wings, a long tail, and a pointed beak. They fly across the structure and ignore the agents.

They continue forwards, but come to a sudden stop.

Lima-4: What is it?

Lima-1 looks to the roofs of the buildings. There is nothing.

Lima-1: Thought I saw some-

A sudden rumbling echoes across the streets, getting closer. The agents duck for cover and from one of the side roads, a large stone golem lumbers through the street. The golem is around 8 meters tall, with thick, boulder-sized legs and equally thick arms. It does not have a head, but in its center is carved a glowing yellow eye. The golem looks around the area, then lumbers on to another part of the city. The agents come out of hiding.

Lima-4: That thing was huge!

Lima-8: Do you think it's like the others?

Lima-3: I don't know, don't really want to find out.

Lima-1: We can also safely assume there are more of them out there. If those wooden ones are anything to go off.

Lima-5: Yeah, I guess so. Where to then?

Lima-1: Command, we are located near what appears to be a town hall in the center sector of the second layer, can you see what the nearest landmark is?

Command: You've got a ziggurat close to the east, you should be able to reach it in some thirty minutes or so. If you also follow the northern route once you reach the ziggurat, you can ascend to the next layer.

Lima-1: Copy that. Alright team, you heard 'em! East sector. Stay on the lookout, and let me know if you see anything, I think there are other things here beside those golems.

The agents nod and move east. The walk to the ziggurat takes an hour and a half, as the agents encounter two more instances of the stone entities roaming the streets, as well as several anomalous entities patrolling in groups. These entities are humanoid, and are hidden by the armor covering them. Their faceplates bear an engraved human face, and wield a variety of different weapons suh as spears, scimitars with glowing edges, axes, and rounded shields with the mark of an unknown flower stamped onto their surfaces.

Despite the increased obstacles, the agents manage to evade detection. The streets are more tightly wound in the second sector, as the structures are larger and expansive. The homes are much more extensive, and there are multiple buildings dedicated to shops or other services such as schools and barracks.

The ziggurat looms above the team. As the team ascends the stairs to the structure, more of the city can be seen. While the remaining two upper layers are only slightly more visible, the agents can now see most of the second and first layer. In the second, dozens of golems can be seen patrolling the streets. The doors leading inside are shut. Lima-1 approaches and attempts to push. The doors open without much resistance. Inside the ziggurat, the rooms are illuminated by torchlight coming in through several indents in the walls.

Lima-1: Fan out, see if you can figure out what these things were used for.

The agents turn on their flashlights and go in separate directions, weapons drawn. The primary room of the ziggurat is filled with tables, seats, and a multitude of clay tablets and scrolls stored within shelves. Following the pathways deeper reveals several rooms containing anomalous artifacts and research. Lima-5 picks up a spear laying on a table next to several tools. The spear emits a faint electrical hum, and ingrained tubes within the shaft and head flow with a blue substance.

Lima-5: Do you think these people were actually experimenting with anomalies?

Lima-3: Is that really new? Ancient civs with anomalous gifts ring any bells for ya?

Lima-5: <Sighs> No, I mean, this looks like actual research. Y'know, experiments and shit.

Lima-2: Eh, s'all the same in the end. Used it to benefit themselves and fight against others. Nothing new here, they're just fancier about it.

Lima-5: Call me paranoid, but it just feels a little closer to home than I'd like.

Lima-2 grabs an amulet made of bone. He puts it down once it starts glowing.

Lima-6: Where'd you think they got all these?

Lima-1: <Absent minded> Clearly these folk didn't like to play nice with others, and besides, 9225 doesn't seem like the most normal place to live in.

Lima-1 points to another room. Through the faint light, he can see several empty cages next to more equipment.

Lima-1: Come on, we've got one last room.

The agents ascend to the tip of the ziggurat, finding a large office-like room with several decorations, artifacts, and shelves. When the agents enter, a group of small critters resembling clumps of dust skitter into hiding. The agents look around, but find it to be similar to what they had already found.

Once Lima-1 notifies command of the discovery, the agents leave the ziggurat and move to ascend to the third layer. As they walk across one of the staircases leading up, Lima-8 can be seen constantly looking around the area.

Lima-1: You doing alright eight?

Lima-8: <Stutter> Oh, umm, yeah. S'just that since the golem encounter, feel's like something's following us. When I look though, there's never anyone.

Lima-1: Probably because if they are following us, then they don't want to be seen. So keep attentive, better safe than sorry.

Team Lima reaches the third layer of the city. The houses are luxurious, now incorporating other materials into their architecture such as metals and decorative ceramics. Buildings tower over one another, standing with multiple floors, and are overall constructed more organized than the areas of the previous two layers. Here, near the back and the edges, several large buildings are built into the mountain and extend further into it. Though there are less golems roaming this layer, there is a significant increase in the amount of patrols of the armored entities.

The agents are hidden in an alleyway, taking cover from the entities. Lima-1 looks back through where they came, they are high above the lower city, and the sun is a few hours away from setting.

Lima-1: Command, how long do we have till sunset?

Command: Roughly four hours Lima One.

Lima-1 looks towards the third layer, and the palace at the highest point. He thinks for a few moments.

Lima-1: <Hums> I might be calling a return to base soon. At most, we might be able to get a basic idea of what the third layer looks like, but if we want to make it before sundown, we need to head back.

Command: Understood, head back to base camp, we'll cover the rest in a secondary exp-

Lima-8: <Loud whisper> Captain!

Everyone turns to look at Lima-8, who aims his rifle into the rooftops.

Lima-8: Something's on the rooftops!

A sudden noise comes from one of the alleyways behind Lima-1, and the agents turn their weapons, but see nothing. The members gather close, forming a perimeter. A noise echoes from another rooftop.

Lima-1: We've got to move to better cover. If we can get to one of the temples, the open space should-

Lima-4: Captain, we've got another problem.

On the other end of the alleyway, a group of the armored entities have noticed the agents and approach, weapons drawn.

Lima-1: Shit.

[REDACTED: LEVEL 5 CLEARANCE REQUIRED]

Afterword: Following Team Lima's expedition into SCP-9225-A, it was determined that Layers 1 and 2 would remain as the default research sources, since higher layers were considered too dangerous for individual squads to explore. A Foundation base was established among the structures of Layer 1, with researchers being able to enter Layer 2 only when accompanied by five or more agents. Expeditions into other areas of SCP-9225 are to continue as scheduled.

Tetra,

I'm not sure if I'm comfortable with those golems roaming the streets of Androdynamis. I'm not implying I don't trust your judgement, but the tree men are one subject, while these are a separate matter entirely. If anything should go wrong, the damage would be too much. Soldiers have honor, loyalty, determination. They have a true warrior's spirit. I don't even know if these barely intelligent boulders know what honor even means. I'm just saying, maybe test your little projects elsewhere, maybe one of the towns in the outskirts.

Yss'gvan, 9th of the Spears

My lord, a new kingdom arises in the north. When returning from our expedition, our caravan came across one Ushar Bako, 12th member of the Spears, and a supposed politician for their fledgling society. He and his men wish for an audience with you regarding formalities between you and their king. While normally I would refuse such ambitious claims from foolish men, they did offer a gift for your highness. It was multiple packages of jeweled flowers and foods like that I've never seen before. Their generosity is the reason for this correspondence. Maybe they have much more to offer than I first thought. I beg, let me know your desires and I will make it known as such.

Kheti, Advisor to his holiness the Pharaoh

The Tribe of the Arid Hills in the east has surrendered, the rest are sure to follow. If we are to root a state in the land we must act quickly before dissent spreads or the other kingdoms try to take it for themselves. I think sending both Ushar and Theron should bring a swift solution. Ushar, for his charisma, and Lucius for his swift action against any who would slow down our progress.

The Unification continues without opposition. Malthace also asked me to notify you of her completion of the elixir you requested. She will send various amounts soon.

On a more unfortunate matter, our magicians believe there is little else to gain regarding those ruins of flesh, our leads run dry and we still know nothing of the people they belonged to. I apologize for our failed efforts.

Yss'gvan, 9th of the Spears

I mark the fall of another group, the Theledrans, though they fought valiantly, they were no match for our emperor and his armies. Their techniques of imbuing will upon the world around them, however, was particularly interesting. We will study their methods for replication. I'm sure Tetra finds such things fascinating.

The combat doesn't end until the Unification is complete, however, so Rex'aeter has mobilized the Bronze Legion towards our next target, the Dunewalkers in the south.

As the power of our Seaenid Empire rises, so too will man's might. The Unification will continue.

Seraphion, Keeper

Would I have not come here myself, I don't think I would've believed any of what I write. I don't expect belief in what I write regardless, for it is something I thought unfathomable, and no doubt others do as well.

I write this text from Androdynamis, capital of the Seaenid empire, home of the tyrant king Rex'aeter, and his terrible army. Yet I find myself eating a warm pastry by a calm field while magical creatures fly above. Members of their infamous Bronze Legion walk past, yet they mingle with the citizens, exchanging pleasantries and words of kindness.

This is not the place I expected. The city is beautiful, its people happy, and even in the outer villages, the peasants live tranquil lives. These revelations are simultaneously frightening and beautiful to behold. If you were to look at the same sight I see, you would also ask yourself if these are the same terrible conquerors of the sea. Even those that submit are treated as their own. I hardly believe it myself.

I might extend my visit here a while longer.

A wanderer

I found myself today, when reciting a poem in the desert kingdom, insulted by various commoners. They deny our city's glory, our Emperor's majesty? They insult my art as jokes and jests, that no such violent empire could be as beautiful as my poems describe. Impudent fools the lot of them. The only reason they stand here under their own rule is because their pharaoh is wise to ally with our mighty lord, savior from the darkened days. I shall show them, take them to the city myself if I have to. Only upon bearing witness with their own eyes will they truly be able to see. Foolish they are because they deny our Emperor, but once he unifies the world, man shall be foolish no longer.

Athymas the poet

I mark another fall, this time the Kingdom of the Terrahominis, their resistance was short lived, and now they are no more. Their guardian, the Serpent of Many Eyes, is also lost, slain by our emperor, thus proving the power of united man over the magics of other beings. They should have forsaken it when we gave them the chance…

No matter, something new has surfaced. While on the return from the invasion, we came across strange ruins. They were alien, not quite magical, but also unlike anything we've ever seen. Steel structures, remains of people mixed with metal parts in their bones, and artifacts of which we've the slightest idea how to use.

Our emperor seemed concerned, we left several men and magicians to investigate and took some of the artifacts home. None of the common folk shall be informed. Hopefully we can gleam something of this mystery, for our emperor fears what potential threat could have created such strange things.

Seraphion, Keeper

I̅X̅-5 are anomalous humanoid constructs composed primarily out of wood, tree bark, and other tree components. Their sizes vary, but are often between the 1.5m-2m range. The bottom half of their body is made up of various roots that can be used as independent limbs for either movement or management of items. The upper half of their body is humanoid, with a canopy of branches and leaves growing out of their head, and a featureless face, with the exception of two glowing green eyes.

Based on observations, tests, and historical documentations, I̅X̅-5 instances were built primarily for menial labor such as farm work or house duties. While the method of their creation, as well as how they were instructed, is unknown, various discovered texts imply a strong connection to I̅X̅-6 entities.

I̅X̅-6 entities are anomalous constructs built out of various types of stone. They measure between 7-8 meters in height, with large, thick, and durable arms and legs. I̅X̅-6 instances lack a head and instead possess a large yellow runic eye carved into the center of their main body mass, which is roughly spherical.

These entities have incredible strength and defense, able to withstand most forms of firearms, and are primarily used as guardians/soldiers of SCP-9225-A. The method of their creation and methods of control is unknown, but are believed to be tied to I̅X̅-55.

I̅X̅-7 are an anomalous species of avian organisms which can be found across various environments within SCP-9225. These avian creatures measure 30cm long, with three sets of wings which each measure 45cm in wingspan. I̅X̅-7 instances are usually white and grey in coloration, with red and orange eyes, and a sharp yellow beak.

When threatened, I̅X̅-7 instances will rapidly flap their wings in order to create small gusts of wind capable of reaching 45kmh. Once the victim is disoriented, they will either flee, or attempt to overwhelm them if there are other instances nearby. They will use this same ability when hunting. Instances are omnivorous, but primarily feed on fruits, rodents, or other small organisms.

I̅X̅-7 instances are often found in flocks, and are rarely ever seen alone unless they are hunting, or searching for a mate, at which point they will leave the flock and try to mate with an instance from another flock.

I̅X̅-8 are agressive humanoid entities whose body are composed entirely of animate pieces of armor. Measuring between 1.5m-2m in height, these entities' bodies, or the armor they possess, are composed of a beryllium bronze alloy capable of absorbing thaumaturgical energy used to try and attack it. Their bodies are resistant to damage, but with enough sustained fire, can be temporarily terminated. The armor of I̅X̅-8 instances is of a bronze coloration, with several repeating designs across the body and a carved human face in their helmet. Expressions can vary between instances.

I̅X̅-8 instances serve as the primary defense force of SCP-9225-A, and will attack any individual on sight if it perceives them as a threat to SCP-9225-A. They often wield a variety of melee weapons also composed of beryllium bronze. Even if the weapon is taken away, instances are capable of taking and transmuting nearby materials into a new weapon.

The origin of I̅X̅-8 instances is unknown, as records indicate that, when the Seaenid empire still existed, their forces were composed of entirely of living individuals.

I̅X̅-9 is a spear composed primarily of a gold and copper alloy. This spear has been altered to harness an anomalous substance injected directly into a system of carved lines along its shaft and blade, which renders it capable of producing electrical energy. This energy can be stored or discharged at will and its intensity depends on the amount of energy stored prior to a discharge.

Based on textual evidence, the substance within I̅X̅-9 seems to originate from an anomalous species of marine fauna native to SCP-9225. Due to its apparent rarity, however, only a limited amount of I̅X̅-9 instances were produced, several of which have been found by Foundation personnel.

I̅X̅-10 are an anomalous species of insectoid creatures commonly found in the more rock-filled areas of SCP-9225. Instances vary in coloration, but are typically grey, brown, black or variations of these three. They have two sets of large chitinous wings, sharp pincers with a straw-like tongue, as well as four thick legs composed of a reinforced bone substance. These legs, when put together, can gyrate, similar to a drill, at fast enough speeds to pierce through most types of stone.

Specimens are primarily carnivorous, and will hunt in pacts for their prey, at which point they will attempt to drill through their targets with their legs and feed on their innards through the use of their tongue.

I̅X̅-11 is a thaumaturgic ritual capable of summoning one or more sandstorms of varying levels of intensity. When summoned, these sandstorms are under the control of the user and can be manipulated according to their will, although it takes focus to maintain them for long periods of time.

Found alongside the research regarding the ritual were several pieces of equipment which, when worn, allow an individual to glide and, to a certain extent, fly within the bounds of a sandstorm regardless of its nature.

Meeting Transcript

Date: 6/10/2024

Individuals Present: Dr. Wilmont, Dr. Mora, Dr. Pagan, Dr. Malave, O5 Liaison Quinn Hall

Foreword: The meeting presented in this transcript was organized by Agent Quinn Hall under the orders of O5-8. While Dr. Wilmont is the primary SCP-9225 research lead, it was also asked that the researchers in charge of the flora, fauna, and anomalous history divisions also be present.

<Begin Transcript>

Dr. Wilmont: Well, then, now that we're all here, should I ask what this meeting's all about?

Quinn Hall: This is about SCP-9225, and the current progress of your operations, as the overseers have taken a particular interest in ensuring proper investigation of the anomaly. Let us start with the entities.

Dr. Mora: Well, when it comes to the anomalous organisms within SCP-9225, you must already know that they are essentially immortal.

Quinn Hall: I was made aware.

Dr. Mora: But we've also learned that the ecosystem does not change much from its prior state. Other than not needing to account for reproduction anymore, the way we see the land today, is exactly the same as it would've been before SCP-9225came into being. Possibly with the exception of some of the topographical anomalies, as the rock walls that line the shore have so far not been mentioned in any recovered document.

Dr. Pagan: There is something similar with the flora of SCP-9225, wherein the specimens have barely changed across the centuries, but something differs slightly.

<Nervous tapping can be heard in the background>

Dr. Pagan: In my discussions with Dr. Mora, as well as other researchers, we came to the conclusion that all "living" entities within SCP-9225 have a limited degree of thought. This is most notable with the humanoids, as they mainly stick to "tasks", and for the animals, well they don't really change much as all they really think about is hunt, rest, and flee. The plants, however, do not grow as expected.

Quinn Hall: Go on.

Dr. Pagan: For example, let's take an instance of I̅X̅-4, when we observe them in their natural biomes, they will typically grow to maturity as expected. However, once the biome reaches a certain number of mature specimens, no further seeds will grow unless a new space opens up via removal of an already mature specimen.

Quinn Hall: And this isn't exclusive to those specific instances?

Dr. Pagan: No, we've checked the same with the rest of the plant species on the island. Of course, the limits vary according to a variety of factors, but the results are the same. Whether this is a result of SCP-9225 or the plants, floral growth seemingly stalls whenever threat of overgrowth would normally follow.

Quinn Hall: Hmm. Do you have a theory as to the cause?

Dr. Mora: We think it could be SCP-9225. We've got no proof of it yet, but it would make no sense for there to be an exception in the intelligence rule specifically for plant life. Though, we are dealing with an anomaly, so I guess anything really goes.

Quinn Hall: Understood.

<A chair swivels to the side.>

Quinn Hall: As for the island and its kingdom?

<Silence for a few moments.>

Dr. Malave: We haven't gleaned as much as we'd hope. We know that this empire, the Seaenids, rose to power starting roughly around the 920s BCE and continued on to, at the latest, 800 BCE. They were conquerors, led by an anomalously augmented emperor with a group of similarly augmented generals.

Dr. Wilmont: Unfortunately, we still have not found any documents or evidence from before 940, the year where defeat of something known as the Unseen happened, or after 805, where the last recorded conquest was that of a group of collective tribes in the middle east.

<Silence for several seconds.>

Dr. Malave: We believe these documents we are missing should be found in the upper city.

Quinn Hall: Then, if you know their possible location, why have no further expeditions been manned to explore these areas?

Dr. Wilmont: The entities, at those levels they are too many to avoid. Without even counting the threats we know nothing about. We have a theory, but I'd need council approval first.

Quinn Hall: What is the theory?

Dr. Wilmont: If it is true that these entities attack anything that they perceive as a threat, then maybe having our agents wear replica armor of a similar composition would fool them into a passive state.

Quinn Hall: You do realize what you are asking right?

Dr. Wilmont: Yes, but I really do think it is our best bet. We can equip the agents with I̅X̅-9 for weapons and hide their recording equipment within the armor. I would only need enough for five sets of armor.

Quinn Hall: I will try to make an appeal, but I warn you, if this doesn't work, and no further progress is made, your position on this project would be up for debate.

Dr. Wilmont: I know, but we don't see much of an alternative that wouldn't result in large losses of personnel.

Quinn Hall: Alright. This meeting is adjourned.

<End Transcript>

Afterword:Following this meeting, the proposal was brought to the O5 Council's attention, and after the subsequent approval, began preparations for the next expedition into the upper layers of SCP-9225-A.

The Unseen strikes once more, this time it took fifteen of us, and as usual, no one saw anything. Not a sound, nor a trace, nor even a sight out of the corner of their vision. This can't go on like this, I refuse to let it go on like this. I will go to the village tonight and rally all I can, and we will march to the Forest of Beasts, for that is the only place such a thing can exist. Upon my life and name, Rex'aeter, this monster shall take no more of our fellows' lives.

The situation has not improved. I don't think the emperor is sick, but he is unwell. As our scouts discovered more eldritch flesh structures buried in long forgotten mountains, more strange mechanical artifacts of steel and cogs, and more remnants of peoples long gone, the emperor grew ever more paranoid. He threw himself entirely into the investigation of these two lost peoples. He has gone as far as to leave the management of the conquest temporarily to the Ninth Spear.

I've never seen such a thing. I ought to speak with him, it's the least I can do. Though he has been difficult to bear in the last decades, I cannot deny that I too have failed my duty as his closest compatriot.

Seraphion, Keeper

I write this as I ready myself to hunt the Unseen once more, though it took some days, a battalion of men stand ready, sharpening their weapons and preparing for the coming battle. Helping me lead them are the tips of the spears that will bring down this cursed beast, the only thirteen to volunteer without hesitation when I returned safe from my previous hunt.

That day, no one answered my call, even Seraphion refused to go. Despite knowing his abilities render him a better scribe than fighter, the refusal hurt all the same. Regardless, I headed out to the woods that very night, intent on my resolve. Not long after, my ambition nearly proved to be my downfall.

The first clue was the attack of the mind, as I drew further into the forest, I could barely remember who I was or what I was doing. Then, it went for the kill, and my only option was to run. I couldn't see it, not even hear it, yet I knew it was giving chase and that if I stopped running, I would soon find myself another one of its victims.

In a stroke of luck, I tripped and fell into a small ravine, sliding through its slippery terrain until I ended up falling face first into a cavern. Though I suffered several injuries, I was safe. Getting a bearing on my surroundings, I realized that I had landed upon a field of pale grey and yellow flowers, accidentally inhaling their pollen.

Before I could decide on the next course of action, I thought back to the encounter and how unprepared I was to face such a bestial foe. I remembered its agile speed, its fanged mouth, sharpened claws and armored face. I remembered its multiple beady eyes and its sleek, shadow-like body. And before I could step foot out of the cavern, I realized that I was able to remember the encounter. And that I had seen the Unseen.

After I returned with my life and the knowledge of these flowers, it took little convincing to finally gather strength to put an end to this nightmare.

I believe the emperor is not in his right mind. I went and talked with him about his current state, and what he revealed is nothing short of madness. He wants to make our empire immortal, an impossible feat. Though I thought it metaphorical at first, he explained his plot, and now I see that whatever comes next can only end in either the greatest success man's ever known, or catastrophic failure.

He does not intend to tell the Thirteen. I don't think I can stop him. But I will not abandon him again.

Seraphion, Keeper

The Unseen is dead. Finally dead. After centuries of torment. I am happy, yet I can't help but think upon it from time to time. Such a powerful, horrid beast roaming the landscape unchained. So many were killed, lives destroyed, and fear sown throughout our clan. Yet it was not invincible, just different.

The Unseen was not the only threat out there. So many other dangers roam our island, unexplainable, untamable, dangerous. But if we could defeat one, we can defeat the rest. Maybe if we do, man won't have to live under the thumb of the thing's beyond understanding anymore. Maybe if we're strong enough, we could unite the whole world under our banner. Man, united as one. Wouldn't that be an interesting idea?

I̅X̅-12 are anomalous aquatic humanoids who reside within the underwater settlements spread around SCP-XXXX. They are highly aggressive and will attack any individual that approaches. I̅X̅-12 instances resemble humans mixed with properties of marine life, which appear to have been thaumaturgically grafted into their bodies through some sort of ritual. The aquatic traits of each individual instance can vary, but the most common traits appear to be webbed appendages, sharp teeth, gills, and scaled skin.

Instances wield weaponry similar to those used by I̅X̅-8, and even occasionally wear pieces of water damaged armor. However, for most instances, their added aquatic traits prevent the use of armor and therefore discard it entirely. The traits any individual instance possesses does not seem to correlate with others, with the exception of producing severe body deformations and granting the instance an extra anomalous ability.

For a list of all known I̅X̅-12 variants, submit an research inquest to the desk of either Dr. Mora or Dr. Wilmont.

I̅X̅-13 are an anomalous species of flora found in a small garden within the palace at the top of SCP-9225-A. Instances are a pale grey in coloration, with the exception of the nectar and seeds, which glow yellow. When analyzed, it was found that the pollen produced by I̅X̅-13 has mnestic properties when consumed or inhaled.

While there is a theorized origin to where I̅X̅-13 instances grow within SCP-9225, the precise location has been deemed to be unfeasible to reach.

I̅X̅-14 is the skull of an unknown creature. The skull possesses antimemetic properties that, when analyzed, differed from those of SCP-9225. As such, it is likely that the specimen possessed these properties prior to the formation of SCP-9225. The skull measures roughly 1 meter in size, with four eye sockets, multiple front-facing horn structures, and a large jaw with two rows of sharpened, backwards-facing teeth.

Based on texts found within SCP-9225, I̅X̅-14 seemed to be the first major anomalous entity slain by the SCP-9225 civilization, and the catalyst for their rapid expansion. Whether this entity was part of a larger species is unknown.

INCIDENT REPORT

Incident #: 9225-011

Location: L.O.I.B2/Thaumaturgical Research Base

Date of Occurrence: 5/13/2024

On 5/13/2024, 22:00 hours, researcher Thomas Jameson accidentally uncovered a hidden chamber within L.O.I.B2 when removing several documents from one of the ziggurat's research chambers. After contacting security personnel, a total of six armed agents were sent into the passageway to uncover where it led. The room, and a connected tunnel, led to an underground series of experimentation chambers containing a variety of mutilated anomalous organisms6, research documents, and unknown anomalous materials.

When the agents reached the deepest chamber of the complex, they encountered an unknown female entity dissecting a I̅X̅-12 corpse. The entity was covered in a black dress and displayed a skeletal body structure underneath the clothes. When the entity noticed the agents, it proceeded to attack them with a variety of different thaumaturgic spells, runes, and anomalous phenomena. The resulting conflict ended with the deaths of all agents present during the expedition.

Following this incident, monitoring equipment was set up in the closest chambers to the tunnel, as well as outside it, and the access point was sealed. The underground complex is to remain sealed off until further notice.

INCIDENT REPORT

Incident #: 9225-013

Location: L.O.I.A1/Primary Naval Port

Date of Occurrence: 5/20/2024

At 07:00 hours, unnatural weather phenomena began occurring off the coast of L.O.I.A1. A severe thunderstorm had manifested without warning in the area. While attempting to analyze the phenomena, Foundation instruments detected several naval vessels sailing within the storm's epicenter.

Following this discovery, several Foundation drones were deployed to attempt to approach the vessels. Once within the storm, the drones were able to capture footage of half a dozen Greek longships hidden within the storm. Swimming alongside the ships were several I̅X̅-12 instances. Leading the fleet was a larger longship, and at its head was an unidentified humanoid entity. The entity wore an altered variant of I̅X̅-8's armor, this one with sharper details, storm imagery and lacking a faceplate, wielding a spear with overloading energy.

The entity's face was obscured by dark clouds, which crackled with lightning and emanated from every slit and opening in the armor's design. Its eyes were its only visible feature, which glowed a bright white. After the entity noticed the drones, all footage ceased as they were all struck by lightning simultaneously.

The storm demanifested two hours after discovery. Research into the capture of the unidentified entity in the case of its remanifestation is ongoing.

INCIDENT REPORT

Incident #: 9225-014

Location: South Eastern Sector of SCP-9225

Date of Occurrence: 5/29/2024

During a routine scouting mission, a group of security personnel spotted a humanoid entity wandering a path between two hillsides. The personnel approached the entity, noting how it appeared to be an older Mediterranean male, around late 40s, and covered in a robe and simple clothes.

The entity ignored all attempts at communication with the agents, continuing to walk the path. When the agents attempted to restrain it, the entity reacted by manifesting a blade and attacking the agents. During the attack, the entity displayed anomalous levels of strength and agility, as well as the ability to manipulate the ground around it to generate clouds of dust to camouflage itself and blind the agents.

Following the deaths of all the squad members, the entity resumed its walking through the path. Foundation systems are to continually monitor the location of the entity and wait until capture is enacted.

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω2 is a non-hostile male humanoid of indeterminate age. It wears multiple luxurious articles of clothing, such as a long robe, colorful shirts and pants, as well as pieces of jewelry. I̅X̅-13 iconography is present in several pieces of jewelry and embroidery. SCP-9225-Ω2 is in a constant state of relaxation and joy, regardless of the circumstances. The entity is capable of producing various metals such as bullion, silver, and copper, spontaneously and without any known limits.

SCP-9225-Ω2 was discovered during an expedition into one of SCP-9225-A's economic institutions. When agents encountered the entity, it resided in a chamber completely filled with the various metals it can produce while reading several manuscripts detailing financial interactions with other ancient civilizations. It did not resist when the agents removed it from the chamber.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω3/The Magician

Status: Uncontained, continuously monitored

Description: SCP-9225-Ω3 is a female entity with powerful thaumaturgical capabilities. The entity is highly aggressive and will attack individuals who interrupt its work within the research chambers. Its body is mostly covered by a long black dress, which bears the I̅X̅-13 crest on a decorative brooch, but the areas that are uncovered, such as its arms, neck, and back, are all skeletal. The entity's head bears the appearance of a woman of Mediterranean descent in her late twenties, with long brown hair and one large yellow eye above its nose. Engraved upon both the dress and the bones of its body are several thaumaturgic runes which glow whenever the entity uses its anomalous capabilities.

The limits of SCP-9225-Ω3's thaumaturgical prowess are as of yet unknown. Due to the large quantity of runes in its body, it is capable of causing simple or complex effects depending on how many or what specific runes are in use. As such, priority has been placed on determining the meaning of each rune so that a list of possible combination effects as well as countermeasures can be composed.

SCP-9225-Ω3 was discovered following Incident-9225-011. SCP-9225-Ω3 does not leave the hidden chamber and is continuously seen working on and experimenting on the organisms and anomalies stored within the rooms.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω4/The Jailer

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω4 is an arachnid entity with partial humanoid qualities. It is 2.2 meters in height and is highly aggressive. The upper half of SCP-9225-Ω4's body is that of a male in his mid thirties, covered in smooth, blood-stained iron armor, and with its face obscured by an iron helmet bearing a lamentful expression. The I̅X̅-13 crest is marked on both of its shoulder plates. The lower half of SCP-9225-Ω4's body is entirely arachnid with features of the Mediterranean Black Widow (Latrodectus tredecimguttatus).

SCP-9225-Ω4 is capable of producing and manipulating iron chains released from the spinnerets located at the rear of its abdomen. Chains produced by SCP-9225-Ω4 are denser and more durable than regular chains, which SCP-9225-Ω4 uses in order to capture or attack individuals. SCP-9225-Ω4 also wields two sickles which produce a poison that, when introduced into the body, activates all of the body's pain receptors without causing additional damage.

The entity was found within the dungeons of SCP-9225-A, patrolling the tunnels alongside a variation of I̅X̅-8 instances wearing similar armor to SCP-9225-Ω4. The entity was able to be captured by security personnel alongside a deployment of MTF Epsilon-9 (Fire Eaters), who continuously kept SCP-9225-Ω4 incapacitated until it could be placed in containment and removed from SCP-9225-A.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω5/The Seafarer

Status: Uncontained, area surrounding SCP-9225 continuously monitored for remanifestation

Description: SCP-9225-Ω5 is a humanoid entity with weather manipulating capabilities. The entity also leads a naval battalion of I̅X̅-8 and I̅X̅-12 instances, though whether or not they actually control the entities is unknown. SCP-9225-Ω5 wears a set of beryllium bronze armor with storm and ocean imagery along its surface, alongside the I̅X̅-13 icon in the center. Grey thunder clouds with constant electrical charge constantly emerge from slits and openings in the entity's armor. SCP-9225-Ω5's face is obscured by the clouds it produces with the exception of its eyes, which glow a bright white.

The entity wields a more powerful variant of I̅X̅-9, which it uses to manipulate the surrounding storm that envelops its fleet when it manifests. Though there have not been many interactions with the anomaly, it is presumed to be aggressive, as it has thus far destroyed all drones attempting to monitor it during manifestations.

SCP-9225-Ω5 was first discovered during Incident-9225-013, and has since had 7 more manifestations with varying times of dissipation ranging from 1-24 hours.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω6/The Gardener

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω6 is a female humanoid entity with characteristics of flora endemic to SCP-9225. The entity is mostly passive, but will become aggressive when injured or when plant life is harmed near its presence.

SCP-9225-Ω6's body has two appendages replaced by, or housing four different species of flora. The entity's left eye is entirely subsumed by a blooming I̅X̅-13 instance, while its hair is made up of a variety of different leaves. Its body is wrapped by stone vines with both I̅X̅-4 instances and regular plant life growing out of them. The entity's right arm is made of a hollow wooden bark, inside the bark, I̅X̅-2 instances and other fungi grow in abundance. SCP-9225-Ω6's left leg is made up of roots intertwined to form the shape of a leg, though each root can move independently of the others. Flowers and other floral growths grow sporadically across the entity's body.

The entity was discovered during an expedition to catalogue L.O.I.D2, at which point it was found tending to a greenhouse of various plant species, anomalous and non anomalous. Before containment could be established, one of the agents accidentally damaged some of the plants in the greenhouse, causing it to enter a rage state, manipulating the surrounding plant life to attack the agents. Containment was eventually established, but eight security personnel died in the resulting conflict.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω7/The Cleric

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω7 is a female humanoid entity with anomalous healing capabilities. It is non-hostile, and will attempt to heal any injured individuals within its vicinity, regardless of whether they are a part of SCP-9225 or otherwise.

The anomaly wears a white and red tunic, with insectoid wings and long white hair. The tunic bears the I̅X̅-13 icon. SCP-9225-Ω7 also possesses a second set of arms alongside increased speed. Whenever the entity sees someone injured, it will begin to emit vocalizations similar to a soft tune, at which point the palms of their hands, as well as their hair, will begin glowing a soft red.

Through tests with D-class personnel, it's been demonstrated that SCP-9225-Ω7's healing abilities are powerful, being able to heal deep wounds and multiple different diseases. It is capable of reattaching severed limbs when focused entirely on the patient in some cases. However, if overexerted, the entity will enter a rest state for 1-7 days. SCP-9225-Ω7 is able to heal more than one person at a time, but the act will drain it much faster than regular. The limit of its powers do not extend to the regeneration of limbs or beyond. If unable to heal the patient, SCP-9225-Ω7 will cry for varying amounts of time, even while continuing to tend to other individuals.

SCP-9225-Ω7 was discovered in SCP-9225-A's main medical ward following an incident where several expedition members were injured by an attacking force of I̅X̅-8 instances. The agents took refuge in the building, at which point SCP-9225-Ω7 approached them and readily healed their injuries. SCP-9225-Ω was able to be contained and removed from SCP-9225-A not long after the incident.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω8/The Beast Keeper

Status: Uncontained, L.O.I.C2 under surveillance

Description: SCP-9225-Ω8 is a male humanoid of Mediterranean descent. It is around 2.2 meters tall, muscular, and sporadically wears pieces of beryllium bronze armor such as a chestpiece, right arm piece, and the leg pieces. The right arm piece is marked with the I̅X̅-13 crest. It displays increased strength and durability, being able to destroy boulders with its bare fists. It has a well maintained beard and hair, and behaves in a confrontative manner, most of the time in combat with other anomalous organisms.

SCP-9225-Ω8's primary ability is being able to command several anomalous fauna to aid it in combat. The effect extends to all known animals within SCP-9225, with the exception of human or humanoid entities. SCP-9225-Ω8 is usually accompanied by a large, quadruped organism with a reinforced segmented shell and a large head with multiple eyes and sharpened tusks. Each of its legs has four large claws which can easily cut through stone. This organism is around 4 meters in size, and when not in combat, the creature can retract into the shell and rest for an indeterminate amount of time.

The anomaly was discovered following an expedition into L.O.I.C2. When the assigned team encountered and were subsequently attacked by the entity and its allies, the agents were ordered to retreat. SCP-9225-Ω8 usually stays within the bounds of L.O.I.C2, but will occasionally venture out in order to fight other fauna not found in the area. It is under close monitoring.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω9/The General

Status: Uncontained, under continuous monitoring

Description: SCP-9225-Ω9 is an animate set of 2 meter tall beryllium bronze armor displaying human characteristics. It is theorized that I̅X̅-8 instances are variants of SCP-9225-Ω9, though this is unproven. SCP-9225-Ω9 is similar in appearance to I̅X̅-8, however, the coloration of the armor is more grey and red, with a I̅X̅-13 icon in the center. The armor worn by SCP-9225-Ω9 is also highly detailed and infused with thaumaturgic energy. This energy theoretically would allow SCP-9225-Ω9 to leap great distances, display feats of increased strength, and resist high amounts of damage.

SCP-9225-Ω9 was discovered within a chamber inside of the mountain where SCP-9225-A is built upon. The agents, when tasked with exploring the tunnel systems of the military bases in the third layer, came across a large room where SCP-9225-Ω9 poured over plans of attack for already extinct civilizations. While attempts to remove SCP-9225-Ω9 from the base were suggested, its anomalous capabilities, as well as the many other anomalies in the path such as I̅X̅-7, I̅X̅-8, and the unidentified captured avians7, make retrieval significantly difficult.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω10/The Portman

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω10 is an anomalous humanoid entity displaying characteristics similar to I̅X̅-12 instances. SCP-9225-Ω10 wears a blue tunic with white coloring and coral growths8 over its surface. The I̅X̅-13 icon is sewn into the right chest of the tunic. The entity's mouth has many sharp teeth, its eyes glow yellow, and the areas of skin not covered by the tunic are cloaked in scales of various colors.

The entity displays increased strength, and the areas of its body covered in coral provide strong defense against attacks. SCP-9225-Ω10's tunic and body is perpetually wet, regardless of location. It wields a spear and is passive unless provoked, displaying a lax, but stern attitude. SCP-9225-Ω10 was discovered in L.O.I.A1 near the docks, patrolling the area and inspecting the stored naval vessels. It was contained after a squad of agents engaged the entity with shock ammunition, restraining it and placing the entity in a thermal containment cell.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω11/The Collector

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω11 is a humanoid/avian hybrid which behaves passively unless an item is removed from its "collection". The entity resembles a winged humanoid with talons instead of feet and multiple sets of eyes placed sporadically upon its head. Its body is covered in colored feathers and a grey silk tunic with wind iconography, though in the upper shoulder, the icon of I̅X̅-13 is sewn into the silk.

Besides possessing increased agility and movement with its flight, the entity is also able to generate controlled wind bursts which can be used as attacks or to form vortexes around items in order to manipulate them from a distance. SCP-9225-Ω11 has a curious and persistent demeanor, often finding interest in items not native to its time period or knowledge. It will then try to steal them for inspection and possibly add them to its collection of accumulated items.

SCP-9225-Ω11 was discovered in an area of one of the ziggurats in SCP-9225-A. The vault, as it was called, was a large room filled with anomalous items from both SCP-9225 and other ancient civilizations. The entity was able to be moved into containment after being lured with simple electronic devices.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω12/The Politician

Status: Contained

Description: SCP-9225-Ω12 is a humanoid entity which displays both deceptive and cooperative behavior. Its appearance is that of a male of Mediterranean descent in his mid to late 30s. The instance is covered by a white tunic with the I̅X̅-13 icon embroidered upon it. Sprouting from its back is a second humanoid bearing an identical appearance, but covered in shadow and an anguished expression on its face. The second instance does not have any legs and is entirely attached to the original entity.

Both entities are capable of limited vocalizations, with the shadow entity acting cooperatively and the other one deceptively. SCP-9225-Ω12 was discovered within a public square in the second layer of SCP-9225-A, and while agents were able to lead it away from the location, it made its pressence known to several I̅X̅-6 and I̅X̅-8 entities roaming the area. The entity momentarily escaped the agents' containment, but was found two days later and, with the shadow's encouragement, captured without further incident.

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω13/The Hermit

Status: Uncontained, under constant surveillance

Description: SCP-9225-Ω13 is an anomalous entity resembling a male of Mediterranean descent in his late 40s. It wears simple robes with the I̅X̅-13 icon alongside dust covered clothes. SCP-9225-Ω13 spends most of its time roaming SCP-9225 in random patterns. When it encounters something perceived as a danger, it will manifest a large beryllium bronze blade and engage with it until the threat has either fled or expired.

SCP-9225-Ω13 also has the ability to manipulate dust particles from the ground around it to form massive clouds of dust and debris, which it can manipulate. The entity usually uses these abilities to quickly hide from attackers, disorient them, or disable their movements. SCP-9225-Ω13 was discovered during Incident-9225-014, and after the deaths of the assigned agents, was left to wander SCP-9225 while constantly monitored.

+Show Document9225-Profiles/Emperor
-Hide Document9225-Profiles/Emperor

Designation: SCP-9225-Ω

Status: Contained, under surveillance

Description: SCP-9225-Ω is an anomalous entity currently residing within a hidden chamber beneath the palace of SCP-9225-A. The entity resembles a 2.1m Mediterranean male and shows no signs of decay despite the lack of life signs. SCP-9225-Ω wears a set of beryllium bronze armor with a variety thaumic runes etched across its surface. The armor is also designed with intricate patterns imitating I̅X̅-13 imagery. A more detailed version of the I̅X̅-13 icon is carved into both the front of the helmet and the center of the chestplate.

SCP-9225-Ω's body is partially fused into the bone throne it sits upon, which examination has demonstrated is identical in composition to I̅X̅-14. Though SCP-9225-Ω hasn't shown any activity since its discovery, analysis of its body reveals that it is constantly emitting large quantities of cognitive, antimemetic, and conceptual energy which disperses into SCP-9225. Based on these findings, it is theorized that SCP-9225-Ω is the source of SCP-9225's anomalous properties, though the validity of this is as of yet unverifiable.

+Show Document9225-Hidden Chamber/Texts
-Hide Document9225-Hidden-Chamber/Texts

So it is I stand against my enemy one last time. The bones of the Unseen lie before me, wretched things. I never thought I'd see them again. Yet, despite my disdain, it is necessary. I need to understand, understand the Unseen and the source of its power. For through its only through understanding that we may truly achieve our goals.

Those ruins. Majestic. Horrifying. Alien. They reminded me of stories my parents, and their parents before them, and those that came several times before told. They told of a great war, a war of flesh and metal. A war so destructive, so horrifying, that it nearly rent the world apart. A war of empires that extended farther than even my reach does, with powers beyond what we thought possible. And now, they are stories. Forgotten except by those who survived, and those who passed on their memory. Their monuments nought but dust in the wind. I will not let the same happen to us.

From one of the ruins of flesh, my mages were able to retrieve a ritual. This ritual, when used on a creature, living or otherwise, allows the individual to peer deep into their nature. Memory is the only true form of immortality, and the Unseen manipulated this aspect for its own benefit. It may not have been immortal, but it was merely a beast, we are human. We learn, we adapt, we peer into the bounds of nature and take its power for ourselves. If we can harness the Unseen's power, then we need not worry about death any longer. My vision will endure. Humanity will be united, and together, we will rule as one.

Seraphion, my old friend, joins me in this endeavor. I know he disapproves, but regardless, he stays by my side. Of course, his power could prove useful in this venture, but I'm glad I won't have to charge into the dark alone this time.

Woe to this kingdom of ruin,

This memory of a thousand memories,

Remembered by none,

Relic of those that once were.

Woe to this kingdom of hubris,

And its fatuous monarch,

As in a bargain struck,

A callous truth took hold.

Woe to this kingdom of deceit,

Misshapen, bent by certainty and falsity,

A patchwork of innumerable remembrances,

Fashioned from those who knew its infamy.

Woe to this kingdom of what was,

Static construct of imitants,

Where life walks ceaseless,

And structures stand unbroken.

Woe to this kingdom of Forgotten,

The giver of this cursed boon,

That which feeds on what is lost,

And builds a grave from what was taken.

Woe to this sempiternal legacy,

This deathless stain upon existence,

For when all else is naught but gone,

This place will remain forever more.

Note: Analysis of the carvings reveal that each letter was slowly carved over the course of several decades, with the most recent line finishing completion over one year prior to SCP-9225's discovery. The author of the text and the reason behind its extended creation time are as of yet unknown.


Addendum 9225.8: Project Perpetua Proposal


+Show Document9225-Project Proposal
-Hide Document9225-Project Proposal

PROJECT PERPETUA PROPOSAL

Purpose: Discover a method of immortalizing the Foundation and its essential personnel so that the mission of Secure, Contain, and Protect, can be efficiently carried out for the foreseeable future.

Methodology: Phase 1 of Project Perpetua will involve the analysis of SCP-9225's "immortality" effect through the use of Foundation Kant counters, Conceptual Energy Analyzers, and Antimemetic Field Disruptors. The same shall be done for all SCP-9225-Ω instances in order to understand the impacts of SCP-9225's effect on living entities. Countermeasures against the erasure of sentience and sapience, as well as the imposition of anomalous qualities and changes based on collective beliefs will also be developed.

Once research is complete, Phase 2 will consist of attempts at replicating the same effect with Foundation resources. Tests will consist of first applying SCP-9225's effects on objects and organisms not present within SCP-9225. Once the indestructibility and regenerative properties of these tests are verified, the following test will verify the consequences on D-class personnel. Once these tests are also confirmed successful, the last stage of Phase 2 will commence, which consists of attempting to apply SCP-9225's qualities on concepts and the resulting reactions of all elements falling under the category of said concept. All data will be recorded and stored in backup antimemetic resistant deepwells in case of residual antimemetic effects contaminating the tests.

Phase 3 will begin once all testing is found to be successful. At this point, a refined procedure for the implementation of SCP-9225's effects on the Foundation will be developed. Following approval, a list of personnel deemed essential for the continuation of the Foundation's mission shall be discussed, subsequently culminating in the full, irreversible execution of the procedure.
