Result: Vote overruled.


[Begin Log]

The sound of a door opening, followed by the adjustment of a heavy wooden chair.

O5-1: The council is livid. You should've gone to the meeting.

Someone sips from a glass drink.

Administrator: And have them rip me to pieces? Funny. You're the only reasonable one in there.

A moment of silence.

Administrator:…and maybe Eight and Two.

O5-1 lets out a small chuckle.

O5-1: Seriously, why? You're not one to usually intervene on matters like this.

Administrator: To put it simply, I saw an opportunity too good to pass up.

O5-1: I wouldn't call it that. More of a mistake in my opinion. A giant warning sign in big neon letters screaming "This is what happens if you fuck around".

The glass is placed down on a mahogany desk.

Administrator: Times change, we aren't cavemen living in fear of the night anymore.

O5-1: No, we're slightly smarter cavemen who found greater darknesses to be afraid of instead.

Administrator: God, you're so pessimistic. And pedantic to boot.

O5-1: Kind of have to be in a job like this, you taught me so yourself.

Silence for several seconds.

Administrator: This project, it could change everything. Sure, it could use some tweaks here and there, but the idea is sound.

O5-1: It is also an idea built on top of the massive grave of the last ones who tried to pull it off.

Administrator: Humanity didn't become what it is today by shying away from danger. It saw the danger and figured out ways to neuterize it before it became lethal. Our society is built upon the failures of the unfortunate and the successes of those who improved upon their mistakes. We either dominate, or try again if there's enough of us left standing by the end.

O5-1 stays silent.

Administrator: We've advanced so much since then. We have new technologies, new research, entire societies built around the anomalous in a modern space. We can try again. Whatever they found at the source, we've either seen something similar before, or will find a new way to take care of it.

O5-1: Well, what if it works?

Administrator: What?

O5-1: Let's say this works. Project Perpetua works and the Foundation becomes truly immortal. What do you think we'll become? You've seen firsthand the power of memories, how those fortunate enough to be remembered change, whether through infamy or grace. Are you willing to let our legacy decide our fate?

Silence.

Administrator: Legacy is malleable, like all things, it can be manipulated to fit whatever narrative we need it to be. So long as our mission to protect mankind remains, what we become does not matter.

O5-1 stays silent.

Administrator: History is bound to be repeated by those who forget. If we want everything we've done to matter, really matter, then we have to ensure our continued survival. Otherwise, I'll wonder if all our sacrifices were ever really worth it in a world that's bound to forget.

Footsteps sound, followed by the sound of a door opening.

O5-1: Semper transit gloria mundi.

The door closes.

[End Log]

However, there are seemingly multiple documents with varying languages in use. Other languages include Egyptian, other variations of cuneiform, and Aramaic.
4. Theorized as being a nomadic tribe which roamed the Libyan desert between 1000 B.C.E. and 870 B.C.E. Documents reveal the possibility that they used anomalous practices to benefit their livelihoods, as well as in a religous context. No trace of this civilization has been found.
5. Though lacking much evidence, a connection between an ancient civilization known as the Theledrans and both I̅X̅-5 and I̅X̅-6 can be drawn. Further investigation into this kingdom's practices, as well as their use when taken by the Seaenid Empire, is ongoing.
6. Including I̅X̅-1, I̅X̅-5, I̅X̅-6, and I̅X̅-12 instances. More organisms were present, but are as of yet uncatalogued.
7. Upon closer inspection by the deployed agents, the avians bear several features similar to those of the avians periodically seen flying within the storm circles spread across SCP-9225. It is theorized that they are the same creatures, but no confirmation has been announced.

Noöspherics Division and security operatives under the influence of class-W mnestics are to patrol the area surrounding SCP-9225 in both seafaring and aerial vessels. Any abnormal activity taking place within or surrounding SCP-9225 must be reported to lead researcher Wilmont as well as the Overseer Council. **Description:** SCP-9225 is an island located in the Mediterranean sea, between Greece and Libya, measuring 80km in radius with an area of 20,000km^^2^^. The island is cloaked by an antimemetic effect, and as such, is entirely imperceptible and inaccessible to individuals not under the effects of mnestic drugs. The island itself has its topography partially warped in various locations, but most notably in the shoreline and its center. This can manifest via the bending of rocks to form sharp and uneven edges, as well as forcing the ground to bend at angles as steep as 90°. The environment, however, maintains the characteristics of a typical Mediterranean location, including non-anomalous biodiversity. SCP-9225 is home to a variety of different anomalies, both living and inanimate. Close studies have also demonstrated that these anomalies are either unwilling, or unable to leave the boundraries of SCP-9225. Despite this, caution must be exercised for personnel safety. Study and cataloguing of all anomalies present within SCP-9225 is ongoing. Spread across SCP-9225's terrain are multiple human settlements of varying size and composition, most of which are empty and intact. While the majority of settlements spread across the outer areas of the island are small towns or villages, in the island's center is a large city[[footnote]]The city, named Androdynamis, was later identified as being the capital of the residing civilization.[[/footnote]], hereby designated SCP-9225-A, measuring roughly 5,000km^^2^^. Like the rest of the island's structures, the city is entirely undamaged. This is due to a secondary anomalous effect encompassing everything native to SCP-9225 which makes all objects indestructible, and in the case of living entities, infinitely reform once they've received enough damage. This effect has rendered research efforts highly arduous and extensive. No origin for this effect has been determined. Based on early long distance imagery and analysis of SCP-9225-A and its surrounding settlements, it can be observed that the architecture used in their construction resembles a mix of various ancient civilizations. Mycenaean, Minoan, Mesopotamian, and Phoenician architecture have been found to be the most noticeable. Knowledge of how these different cultures could intertwine within SCP-9225 is unknown. SCP-9225 was discovered on 2/18/2024 after Noöspherics Division operative Wendy Wright spotted the island while on vacation on a Mediterranean cruise line. When no other individuals could perceive the island, site command was notified and proper containment procedures were carried out. = [[size 150%]]**Addendum 9225.1:** Early Exploration[[/size]] [[div style="border-top: 4px solid #888;"]] [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-RemoteExploration-Report" hide="-Hide Document9225-RemoteExploration-Report" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[tabview]] [[tab Drone Alpha Log]] [[<]] > **Objective:** Scout northern section of SCP-9225, report back with data. > ---- > [Begin Log, 2/20/2024] > > **14:27:** //Drone Alpha approaches the northern coastline of SCP-9225. Terrain is rough, with rows of abnormally large jagged rocks creating a makeshift barrier across the shore. The rocks making up the barrier extend 10 meters upwards and jut at various angles. To the right of the drone, a structure can be seen in the distance. The drone approaches.// > > **14:35:** //The drone reaches a large port surrounded by residential and military buildings. The port resembles a large, conical cothon. Beside the exterior docks there are evenly placed wide ramps along the sides which extend under the water, with roads leading from the ramps into the city and other larger structures. Purpose unknown. Drone detects signs of large housing structures under the port. Movement under the water is detected, though visual contact is unfeasible.// > > **15:01:** //Terrain resembles typical dry shrublands with hills bearing dense rock formations. Several non-anomalous mammals, avians, and reptilians spotted across the terrain. They do not act different from regular instances. Unidentified flying organisms spotted. They appear to be large insectoids, with four spider-like stone legs and two sets of chitinous wings. They can be seen drilling into the mountainous terrain and camouflaging into the stones with their exoskeletons of similar color, or swarming nearby organisms.// > > **16:55:** //The drone passes through three small settlements, all bearing the same characteristics and architecture with small differences. All are intact and devoid of human habitation. Several unidentified organisms spotted during exploration, though they avoided contact with Drone Alpha.// > > **18:48:** //Drone Alpha reaches a mountain of immense size when approaching the center of SCP-9225, with an estimated height of 3,500m above sea level. There are several openings carved into the base of the mountain as well as the upper regions. On approach, it can be seen that they are pathways leading into the mountain, with pillars and support extending inside. Drone progress is blocked by barred gates posted on each entrance.// > > **22:39:** //Drone returns to base without issues.// > > [End Log] [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab Drone Beta Log]] [[<]] > **Objective:** Scout southern section of SCP-9225, report back with data. > ---- > [Begin Log, 2/20/2024] > > **14:21:** //Drone Beta arrives at the southern coast through another port similar to the one spotted by Drone Alpha. It can be surmised that there are several ports like these spread throughout the coast of SCP-9225. No unusual activity detected.// > > **15:20:** //A particularly vegetated area leads into a biome composed entirely of stone. Despite this, there are multiple different forms of plant life made up of this stone material. This includes stone trees and a multitude of stone flowers and plants with different colored geodes making up their petals, leaves, and anthers.// > > **16:11:** //The drone encounters a settlement, much larger than the ones found by Drone Alpha. This one looks to be a military fortress with a ziggurat-like structure serving as its center. In the area surrounding the fortress, as well as within, several animate skeletal entities can be seen roaming and patrolling the landscape. Entities resemble a variety of different extinct wildlife, some heavily altered, and others even wearing makeshift armor. The fortress shows signs of being made to accommodate these anomalies and other militaristic equipment. Several roads extend from the fortress.// > > **17:49:** //The large mountain spotted by Drone Alpha can be seen. From Drone Beta's perspective, a large, complex city is built in the area beneath the mountain, as well as the higher areas. Parts of SCP-9225-A are built into the mountain, with the metropolis surrounded by it on all sides save for the south. The city is multi-layered, with some of the higher areas' structures blending into the mountain. Ziggurats and large halls are spread across the entire expanse, separated by dozens of residential and mercantile buildings, topped by a large palace at the highest point of the city.// > > **21:53:** //The drone returns to base without complications.// > > [End Log] [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab Drone Charlie Log]] [[<]] > **Objective:** Scout eastern section of SCP-9225, report back with data. > ---- > [Begin Log, 2/20/2024] > > **14:36:** //Drone Charlie arrives on the eastern coast, beside another port town. The drone spots signs of multiple structures of varying sizes under the water and connected to the island. In conjunction, the underwater structures resemble a settlement. Several humanoid shapes can be spotted moving rapidly between the structures.// > > **15:00:** //Several small storm circles move across the landscape. In between each strike of lightning, flocks of unknown avian organisms fly in unison in the storms' centers.// > > **16:12:** //Several villages identified, no further anomalies detected.// > > **17:34:** //A large temple lies surrounded by dozens of domestic buildings. On the outskirts there are several pens and fields of vegetation. Some are filled with non-anomalous animals, while others lie empty.// > > **17:55:** //The drone reaches the center of SCP-9225. Passage into SCP-9225-A without going through the gates on the mountain or through the southern sector is ill-advised.// > > **22:06:** //Drone Charlie returns to base without further incident.// > > [End Log] [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab Drone Delta Log]] [[<]] > **Objective:** Scout western section of SCP-9225, report back with data. > ---- > [Begin Log, 2/20/2024] > > **14:45:** //Drone Delta approaches the western coast, which is heavily forested for several kilometers. The forest is obscured, with the drone's headlight being unable to penetrate the darkness beyond two meters. Movement detected amidst the dense vegetation. Drone instructed to fly over the area.// > > **17:13:** //Drone Delta spots another large settlement a few kilometers from the forest covering much of the west side of SCP-9225. There are three pyramid structures, albeit smaller than those found by Alpha and Beta. Outside the town there is a concentration of buildings near a cave leading underneath a hillside. There are several roads spreading from the settlement further into SCP-9225.// > > **18:06:** //Transmission is lost after a projectile from an unidentified source strikes down Drone Delta.// > > [End Log] [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[/tabview]] > **Note:** Clearly, SCP-9225 is more complex than we thought. It's an entire ecosystem of anomalies intermixed with the remnants of a civilization that, for all we know, seemed quite dexterous in the field of anomalous phenomena, more so than its contemporaries. I think the next best course of action should be setting up camp in one of the settlements, preferably on the south side, to better organize further progress. We're going to need more personnel. > > -Dr. Wilmont [[/collapsible]] [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-Expedition/Log01" hide="-Hide Document9225-Expedition/Log01" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[<]] > = [[size 120%]]**Expedition Log**[[/size]] > ---- > **Preface:** Following the drone reconnaissance explorations, an expedition into SCP-9225 was approved by O5 Command. The goal of this expedition is to explore L.O.I.Β1 in the southern coast and set up camp to establish Foundation presence on SCP-9225. > > **Date:**02/27/2024 > > **Expedition Team:** Agent Rodriguez(L2), Agent Asent(L3), Agent Ortiz(L4), Agent Rivera(L5), Agent Farraday(L6), Agent Gomez(L7), Agent Towers(L8) > > **Expedition Lead:** Commander Nile Collins(L1) > ---- > [Begin Log] > > //Feed opens upon a small Foundation vessel. The weather is cloudy, with waves splashing the deck of the ship. The shore of SCP-9225 can be seen rapidly approaching. The Lima Team members make final preparations.// > > **Lima-1:** Everybody's feed up and running? > > //All team members nod in unison. A large wave crashes into the ship, drenching several of the agents.// > > **Lima-4:** Are you fu- > > **Lima-5:** Come on... > > **Lima-7:** Shit, that's cold! > > **Command:** Prepare for deployment. Arrival on SCP-9225 in T-minus thirty seconds. > > //The agents move hurriedly and position themselves near the front of the vessel. Each has a backpack full of supplies to set up a temporary base of operations.// > > **Command:** We'll have our ships close by for when you send the signal. Once you've ensured full control over B1, we'll send in the rest of the personnel. > > **Lima-1:** Understood command, ready for deployment. > > //The ship enters the port and approaches the right docks. When it closes the distance, the agents jump onto one of the ramps. Once all members are off, the boat leaves to reconvene with the larger ships. The agents look around.// > > **Lima-3:** Damn... > > **Lima-8:** Impressive right? > > **Lima-3:**Yeah. I've seen my fair share of anomalous ruins, but this is something else. > > **Lima-7:** I'm just glad it ain't Sarkic. Trust me, if the walls don't eat you, you'll be smelling like a fresh corpse for weeks. > > // Lima team ascends the ramp and walks along the docks. On their right are several buildings which appear to be made of limestone. On their left, several ships are tied to masts along the canal.// > > **Lima-1:** Remember to look out for traps. Never know with these things. > > **Lima-2:** I'm more worried about the other anomalies. You see the shit in those recordings? > > **Lima-5:** That's why they sent us here. Coast seemed safest. > > **Lima-2:** Still, like cap said, never know with these things. > > //Lima team continues to walk along the harbor, eventually reaching a large building where the canal ends and several ships are stored.// > > **Lima-1:** Command, we've reached the end of the docks. No sign of opposition so far. > > **Command:** Copy, continue the mission. Attempt to reach the main gubernatorial building. > > //The squad continues past the cothon and into the city. Despite the wide streets, there are structures everywhere, all unaltered. Spread across the streets are shops, carts, chariots, and different types of pottery. The team keeps their guns drawn. One hour later, they reach a large, palace-like structure. It is rectangular, with pillars lining the inside. Intricate carvings of seafaring vessels, soldiers, and underwater humanoids with weapons are spread throughout the stone surfaces and ceramic pots decorate the hall. They walk inside the main room. There are several passages that lead further into the building.// > > **Lima-1:** Alright, Three, Four, and Six, you start setting up in here. Five and Eight, check the perimeter. Two and Seven, we clear out the rest of the palace. > > //The agents nod and disperse to fulfill their respective missions. Lima-1,-2, and -7 move to the back of the room where a small, plain throne is located. Above the throne there is a large mural, it depicts a regal figure, dressed in armor with a bronze tinge and wielding an ornate longsword of the same color in the right hand, and a white scepter with an eye in the left. Lima-1 signals for the team to split. Lima-2 and -7 go down the right hall, while he goes down the left.// > > **Command:** Lima Five, Lima Eight, report. > > **Lima-5:** Everything's alright on my end. No signs of threats so far. > > **Lima-8:** Same here, but I did come across a large garden near the back. All the plants seem to be fine, no overgrowth or anything. > > **Command:** We'll notify the researchers about the observation. Continue your duties. > > //As Lima-1 walks down the corridor, a sudden noise echoes through the palace. He whirls around to look behind him, but there is nothing there.// > > **Lima-1:** Everyone, report. What was that? > > **Lima-6:** Well, Lima-4 accidentally knocked over one of the vases while setting up the light attachments... and it doesn't have any damage. > > **Lima-4:** Not only that... but the reason I tripped, is because the walls won't budge. None of the nails I try to hammer in go through. > > **Lima-3:** Hold on, let me try something. > > //A gunshot explodes from the main room, followed by silence.// > > **Lima-3:** Well, something's definitely off. The shot did nothing to the vase, still as new as how we found it. > > **Lima-1:** Okay, put the vase back in its place and set up what you can, however you can. We'll leave the rest for the coats to figure out. > > //Lima-1 continues walking down the dark corridor, coming across several doors. He opens each one, revealing either ornate bedrooms, dining halls, or servant's quarters. On the final door, Lima-1 opens to reveal an armory. Inside the armory are several typical weapons of the era, but on the far wall, hung to the wall, lies a gold lyre decorated with bright topaz gems.// > > **Lima-1:** Command, have eyes on a possible anomalous weapon. > > **Lima-2:** We um.. also found the library. Or at least we think it is. > > **Lima-4:** We've set up on our end, or at least what we can. B1 camp is set and ready! > > **Command:** Understood. Lima-1, do we have an all clear to make landfall? > > //Lima-1 walks back to the main palace room. The rest of the agents, bar Lima-2 and -7, are present. Lima-8 walks up to Lima-1.// > > **Lima-8:** Outside's all clear captain. No hostiles in sight. > > **Lima-1:** Alright then. Command, make ready for landfall. You've got the all clear. > > [End Log] > > ---- > > **Afterword:** Following Expedition01, a Foundation camp was established on the port town and research into the surrounding area began underway. Due to the anomaly's indestructible properties, which was identified as extending to all man-made objects, research efforts were taking longer than anticipated. While the research and translation of documents was proceeding, a second expedition heading to take over L.O.I.B2, was put together. [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-Expedition/Log02" hide="-Hide Document9225-Expedition/Log02" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[<]] > = [[size 120%]]**Expedition Log**[[/size]] > ---- > **Preface:** Due to the continued presence of multiple prehistoric entities surrounding L.O.I.B2, a division of [[[https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/task-forces#phi-2 | MTF Phi-2 (Clever Girls)]]] was provided with class-W mnestics and tasked to, alongside Team Lima, contain or disperse the anomalous entities and secure access to L.O.I.B2. A small squadron of [[[https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/task-forces#delta-45 | MTF Delta-45 (Rolling Thunder)]]] agents was left on standby in case backup was necessary. > > **Date:** 3/01/2024 > > **Expedition Team:** Agent Rodriguez(L2), Agent Asent(L3), Agent Ortiz(L4), Agent Rivera(L5), Agent Farraday(L6), Agent Gomez(L7), Agent Towers(L8), Agent Holland(P2), Agent Gines(P3), Agent Jewels(P4), Agent Zultan(P5), Agent Pimentel(P6) > > **Expedition Leads:** Commander Nile Collins(L1), Commander Ilsa Undveld(P1), Commander Jake Gregors(D1) > ---- > [Begin Log] > > //The sun is in the middle of the sky, with clouds of dust obscuring 30% visibility as the teams pass through the rocky bushlands. Lima-1 drives an armored Jeep, with Lima-2 on the passenger seat and Lima-3 and -4 readying equipment in the back. Lima-1 looks to his right. There are two armored trucks with large containment cages on their beds, varying in sizes of 3 to 5 meters. They are being driven by the members of MTF Phi-2. On the left is the rest of Lima squad in their own armored Jeep.// > > **Phi-2-1:** Coming up on Beta two, everyone keep a lookout. > > //Through the dust, the top of a large stone ziggurat becomes visible from behind fortified stone walls. A giant stone archway gives passage into the fortress.// > > **Phi-2-5:** I see 'em! East! > > //From behind the walls, several skeletal entities emerge charging towards the agents. There are 4 entities in total. The two largest entities resemble mastodon skeletons, albeit with several parts of their body protected by metal armor, and the two others appear to be a tethyshadros and a type of saber-toothed feline.// > > //The Phi-2 squadron separates from team Lima, staying back to unload the cages. Lima team continues to engage with the entities.// > >  **Lima-1:** Alright everyone, you know the drill. Immobilize, then contain. Four, Seven, you're up! > > //Lima-4 opens the jeep's sunroof, carrying a portable missile launcher. On the other jeep, Lima-7 does the same. A few moments later, two rockets fly across the landscape, landing close to the entities. The blast breaks apart one of the smaller entities, while knocking down another, but the mastodons keep charging forward. The rest of the agents open fire on the anomalies.// > > //The two vehicles are able to dodge the oncoming collisions and continue suppressive fire on the entities. While the armor receives no damage, the areas of exposed bone slowly begin to break apart. The entities attempt to knock away the vehicles, but the agents are able to maneuver out of the attacks.// > > //After 2 minutes of continuous sustained firing, each of the mastodons loses one leg, causing them to collapse.// > > **Lima-1:** Phi-1, three targets immobilized, one terminated. You are clear for containment. > > **Phi-2-1:** Copy that Lima One, we're- > > //One of the downed skeletal instances lets out a loud roar, followed by a distant rumbling. From the fortress' gates, a large skeletal specimen resembling a mansourasaurus slowly lumbers towards the team. Close behind, a wave of several dozen raptor-like entities[[footnote]]Identified as Scipionyx specimens.[[/footnote]] rapidly approach team Lima.// > > **Lima-5:** Holy shit! > > **Lima-8:** Captain, what's the plan? > > **Lima-1:** Phi One, how long before you can get containment ready? > > **Phi-2-1:** The small one's too far, but if you can buy us a few minutes, we can get at least one of the elephants ready to go. > > **Lima-1:** Copy. Lima Five, follow me. > > //The two vehicles make a hard left, heading towards a hillside in the distance. Lima agents fire their weapons towards the crowd of entities, prompting them to follow away from Phi-2.// > > **Lima-1:** Delta-45, once we come back around, we're going to need you to create as much distance between us and the entities as possible. > > **Delta-45-1:** Understood Lima One, making our way to you. > > //The two vehicles reach the hill and begin rapidly ascending.// > > **Lima-1:** Ready up the next round of missiles! We're blasting away as many of these fuckers as we can. > > //As they're about to crest the hill, the jeeps make a hard left, executing a U turn back towards the fortress. During the turn, Lima-4 and Lima-7 fire two more missiles into the crowd, shattering several of the skeletal entities and causing the rest to momentarily hesitate.// > > //In that moment of hesitation, Delta-45 arrives on the scene, firing a barrage of gunfire and explosives which either destroys or disperses the rest of the entities. The Mansourasaurus attempts to reach Delta-45, but all the agents maneuver around it, eventually taking it down, but not destroying it.// > > **Lima-3:** Woo! Like fish in a barrel! > > **Lima-1:** Thanks for the assist Delta. Standby for further action. > > **Delta-45-1:** Not a problem Lima. Ya'll just get your sorry asses back to Phi. > > **Lima-1:** Phi One, what's your status? > > **Phi-2-1:** Well, we managed to corral these sons-a-guns into the cages, and even managed to snag ourselves a little extra. Those two that you blew up a bit ago? They reformed. Nothing we couldn't handle though. > > **Delta-45-1:** Yeap, same thing happening over here. > > //Lima-1 looks back, all of the skeletons and their shattered pieces can be seen slowly reforming back together into complete instances. Before they can do much though, they are driven away or injured by Delta-45.// > > **Delta-45-1:** Don't worry about over here, we got these handled. Just get to the Fortress and let command know to bring more units for the takeover. And a bigger cage for long neck over 'ere. > > //Team Lima reaches Phi-2, which have now captured the first four entities that attacked the agents. The entities attempt to bite the agents and crash against the bars but are unable to break out of containment. Lima-3 looks out of the window as Phi-2-1 approaches.// > > **Lima-3:** Just another day? > > **Phi-2-1:** Just another day. > > **Lima-1:** Command, we've secured the perimeter of Beta Two and dispersed all known hostiles. Requesting additional units for infiltration of the structure itself. > > **Command:** Copy that Lima One, remain on standby for further action. > > [End Log] > > ---- > > **Afterword:** After additional personnel and weaponry was provided, the MTF teams managed to secure B2 with little resistance, encountering only a saltriovenator instance and a few more of the smilodon and scipionyx instances. Following the takeover of the structure, several more discoveries were made within the primary ziggurat, including documents, anomalies, and non-hostile entities. [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] @@ @@ = [[size 150%]]**Addendum 9225.2:** Research and Documentation[[/size]] [[div style="border-top: 4px solid #888;"]] [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-Catalogue/Historical-Documents" hide="-Hide Document9225-Catalogue/Historical-Documents" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[<]] > **Note:** Following translation[[footnote]]The language used by the SCP-9225 civilization appears to be a derivative of Mycenaean Linear B mixed with elements of Babylonian cuneiform. However, there are seemingly multiple documents with varying languages in use. Other languages include Egyptian, other variations of cuneiform, and Aramaic.[[/footnote]] of several of the clay tablets, parchments, and scrolls, compiled from the occupation of L.O.I.B1 and L.O.I.B2, it has been determined that pieces of data found within SCP-9225 are subject to scrutiny and further investigation. When making comparisons with documents from other structures, multiple documents provide contradictory, external, or false information. Some pieces appear to originate from other locations. For the sake of clarity, they will be categorized alongside their respective location. Further documents will be added as translation continues. > > -Dr. Wilmont [[/<]] [[tabview]] [[tab L.O.I.B1]] [[<]] > Trading with those of the Kingdom in the Sands was a wise choice indeed, though that shouldn't come as much of a surprise, since you have yet to lead us astray. I̅X̅-1 behave similarly to how their non-anomalous counterpart would when they existed, but also possess the ability to communicate with other I̅X̅-1 instances regardless of the species they originate from. Due to their bodies being entirely composed of a skeletal structure, they do not need the basic requirements of food, sleep, or water. Documents suggest that I̅X̅-1 instances were created through a thaumaturgic ritual involving the blood of several key figures in SCP-9225 culture, I̅X̅-2, and other currently unknown substances. Tests have shown that instances share a hivemind-like consciousness which likely contributes to their ability to communicate and work in tandem with one another, likely a result of I̅X̅-2 used during their creation. Based on evidence found in ancient texts, as well as their encounter with the MTFs assigned to take L.O.I.B2, it appears likely that I̅X̅-1 instances were created specifically to serve as soldiers, siege weapons, spies, or defensive sentries. It is unknown how these entities were managed during and outside of combat. As of current occupation of SCP-9225, a total of 10 I̅X̅-1 variants have been identified and catalogued. Variants include: > - Mastodons > - Tethyshadros > - Smilodons > - Mansourasaurus > - Scipionyx > - Saltriovenator > - Basilosaurus > - Elasmosaurus > - Efraasia > - Liopleurodon [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-2]] [[<]] I̅X̅-2 is an anomalous fungal species which, when ingested, provides a telepathic link between all who consume it. The fungus, colored green with lavender stalks, was found stored within several storage containers at L.O.I.B2. Its effects are present regardless of whether I̅X̅-2 is transformed into a gas or liquid. It is theorized that I̅X̅-2 was the primary method of controlling I̅X̅-1 instances, as well as increasing effectiveness between soldiers and workers during the empire's existence. --The origin of I̅X̅-2 is as of yet unknown.-- **Update:** I̅X̅-2 instances grow in abundance within L.O.I.D2-B's tunnel system, and is, thus far, the only known place to find I̅X̅-2. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-3]] [[<]] I̅X̅-3 is a golden lyre composed of 10 strings and decorated with carved sun imagery and topaz gems. When under direct sunlight, I̅X̅-3 can be used to generate concentrated energy beams or constructs. The intensity and strength of the energy released by I̅X̅-3 is dependant on the skill with which the lyre is played. The anomaly's effects also seem partially dependent on the user's will, as the form the constructs take, as well as the lethality of the energy released, relies on what the user wishes to do. Documentation regarding this anomaly reveal that it was a relic stolen during a raid of a settlement within Greece. Further specifics are not mentioned. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-4]] [[<]] I̅X̅-4 are an anomalous species of flora composed entirely of an organic rock structure. The structures making up their petals, leaves, anthers, and seeds, however, are all made up of organic crystals of varying shapes and colors. I̅X̅-4 instances can be found all across SCP-9225 in mountainous or rocky terrains, as I̅X̅-4 instances require large amounts of sediment and minerals, which they absorb from surrounding geological material, in order to grow to maturity. I̅X̅-4 members can manifest as a variety of different flora, including but not limited to: Trees, flowers, vines, and shrubs. The crystalline structures, other than their origins, are nearly identical to non-anomalous crystals and can be used as such without incident. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[/tabview]] [[/collapsible]] @@ @@ = [[size 150%]]**Addendum 9225.3:** Progress with the Capital[[/size]] [[div style="border-top: 4px solid #888;"]] [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-Expedition-City/Log01" hide="-Hide Document9225-Expedition-City/Log01" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[<]] > = [[size 120%]]**Expedition Log**[[/size]] > ---- > **Preface:** Due to SCP-9225-A's importance in the culture preceding SCP-9225, as well as its strategic point as the center of the anomaly, Team Lima was dispatched to explore and map out as much of the city layout as possible. > > **Date:**3/12/2024 > > **Expedition Team:** Agent Rodriguez(L2), Agent Asent(L3), Agent Ortiz(L4), Agent Rivera(L5), Agent Farraday(L6), Agent Gomez(L7), Agent Towers(L8) > > **Expedition Leads:** Commander Nile Collins(L1) > ---- > [Begin Log] > > //The feed opens in front of SCP-9225-A's gargantuan gate, it is the only open method into the city. The walls dwarf the agents and extend far to each side, connecting with the mountain. Behind the agents, a temporary camp of Foundation personnel has been set up in order to conduct research, provide backup if necessary, and make the establishment of a base simpler. It is morning.// > > **Lima-1:** Sound equipment check everyone. > > **All agents:** Check > > **Lima-1:** Command, you read us on your end. > > //Lima-1 looks back. From a set of computers in the camp, a female agent stands up, signalling a thumbs up.// > > **Command:** Loud and clear Lima One. > > //The agents turn and walk towards SCP-9225-A's gate.// > > **Lima-1:** Into the mouth of the beast then. > > //The team goes through the gates, following a dirt path into the city itself. In the lowest layer, the layout seems to consist mostly of small domestic buildings, farm lands, and simple shops separated and unevenly spread throughout. The residences are relatively small, bearing two floors, and are composed primarily of mudbrick and various types of stone. The fields they pass are abundant with crops, and several carts and wooden wagons litter the road. Multiple non-anomalous creatures can be seen roaming the cityscape.// > > //As they walk, the path splits into multiple roads, alleyways, and streets. In the far distance, stairs and ramps can be seen going upwards to the higher layers.// > > **Lima-7:** Psst! Entities on our nine. > > //The agents look to their left. In one of the farther fields, a wooden humanoid can be seen tending to the crops, removing some and placing them into a tweed basket. The entity does not notice them. In further fields, several more can be seen doing the same. Lima-1 signals for them to approach quietly.// > > //As the image of the entity gets clearer, its figure becomes more defined. It is made of tree bark, with the area above the waist resembling a male humanoid figure, while its lower area is made up of multiple sets of long roots that it uses as legs or extra arms. The top of its head sprouts branches and leaves, forming a small canopy.// > > **Lima-2:** Looks... friendly? > > //When the agents reach a close enough distance, the entity turns to look at them. Its face is featureless, with the exception of two carved holes that serve as its eyes. A soft green light emanates from within the holes. It stares at the agents momentarily, then returns to harvesting the field.// > > **Lima-1:** Command, we've come across our first anomalous entity. It appears to be non-hostile. > > **Command:** Copy, any further details? > > **Lima-1:** Partial humanoid, composition and appearance of a tree, and from the looks of it, they mostly just collect crops. > > **Command:** Understood, you may continue the expedition. > > //The agents turn back to the roads. The wooden entity does not react to them leaving. Further along the pathways, the agents reach a plaza of moderate size. There are stalls along the edges and the center storing a variety of foods and items. The team searches the stalls, but other than finding instances of I̅X̅-2 and jewlery made using I̅X̅-4, no further anomalies are discovered.// > > //Exploration of the rest of the layer reveals mostly the same layout of residences, farm land, and shops. Once the area has been marked, the team ascends to the next layer of SCP-9225-A.// > > //Team Lima emerges near a large town hall connected to a section filled with larger buildings. The town hall is decorated with intricate patterns and royal imagery, depicting images of a regal figure reaching out to several individuals. Above the hall is a nest of unknown avians. The creatures have three sets of feathered wings, a long tail, and a pointed beak. They fly across the structure and ignore the agents.// > > //They continue forwards, but come to a sudden stop.// > > **Lima-4:** What is it? > > //Lima-1 looks to the roofs of the buildings. There is nothing.// > > **Lima-1:** Thought I saw some- > > //A sudden rumbling echoes across the streets, getting closer. The agents duck for cover and from one of the side roads, a large stone golem lumbers through the street. The golem is around 8 meters tall, with thick, boulder-sized legs and equally thick arms. It does not have a head, but in its center is carved a glowing yellow eye. The golem looks around the area, then lumbers on to another part of the city. The agents come out of hiding.// > > **Lima-4:** That thing was huge! > > **Lima-8:** Do you think it's like the others? > > **Lima-3:** I don't know, don't really want to find out. > > **Lima-1:** We can also safely assume there are more of them out there. If those wooden ones are anything to go off. > > **Lima-5:** Yeah, I guess so. Where to then? > > **Lima-1:** Command, we are located near what appears to be a town hall in the center sector of the second layer, can you see what the nearest landmark is? > > **Command:** You've got a ziggurat close to the east, you should be able to reach it in some thirty minutes or so. If you also follow the northern route once you reach the ziggurat, you can ascend to the next layer. > > **Lima-1:** Copy that. Alright team, you heard 'em! East sector. The walk to the ziggurat takes an hour and a half, as the agents encounter two more instances of the stone entities roaming the streets, as well as several anomalous entities patrolling in groups. These entities are humanoid, and are hidden by the armor covering them. Their faceplates bear an engraved human face, and wield a variety of different weapons suh as spears, scimitars with glowing edges, axes, and rounded shields with the mark of an unknown flower stamped onto their surfaces.// > > //Despite the increased obstacles, the agents manage to evade detection. As the team ascends the stairs to the structure, more of the city can be seen. While the remaining two upper layers are only slightly more visible, the agents can now see most of the second and first layer. In the second, dozens of golems can be seen patrolling the streets. The doors leading inside are shut. Lima-1 approaches and attempts to push. The doors open without much resistance. Inside the ziggurat, the rooms are illuminated by torchlight coming in through several indents in the walls.// > > **Lima-1:** Fan out, see if you can figure out what these things were used for. > > //The agents turn on their flashlights and go in separate directions, weapons drawn. The primary room of the ziggurat is filled with tables, seats, and a multitude of clay tablets and scrolls stored within shelves. Following the pathways deeper reveals several rooms containing anomalous artifacts and research. Lima-5 picks up a spear laying on a table next to several tools. The spear emits a faint electrical hum, and ingrained tubes within the shaft and head flow with a blue substance.// > > **Lima-5:** Do you think these people were actually experimenting with anomalies? > > **Lima-3:** Is that really new? Ancient civs with anomalous gifts ring any bells for ya? > > **Lima-5:** No, I mean, this looks like actual research. Y'know, experiments and shit. > > **Lima-2:** Eh, s'all the same in the end. Used it to benefit themselves and fight against others. Nothing new here, they're just fancier about it. > > **Lima-5:** Call me paranoid, but it just feels a little closer to home than I'd like. > > //Lima-2 grabs an amulet made of bone. He puts it down once it starts glowing.// > > **Lima-6:** Where'd you think they got all these? > > **Lima-1:** Clearly these folk didn't like to play nice with others, and besides, 9225 doesn't seem like the most normal place to live in. > > //Lima-1 points to another room. Through the faint light, he can see several empty cages next to more equipment.// > > **Lima-1:** Come on, we've got one last room. > > //The agents ascend to the tip of the ziggurat, finding a large office-like room with several decorations, artifacts, and shelves. When the agents enter, a group of small critters resembling clumps of dust skitter into hiding. The agents look around, but find it to be similar to what they had already found.// > > //Once Lima-1 notifies command of the discovery, the agents leave the ziggurat and move to ascend to the third layer. As they walk across one of the staircases leading up, Lima-8 can be seen constantly looking around the area.// > > **Lima-1:** You doing alright eight? > > **Lima-8:** Oh, umm, yeah. S'just that since the golem encounter, feel's like something's following us. When I look though, there's never anyone. > > **Lima-1:** Probably because if they are following us, then they don't want to be seen. So keep attentive, better safe than sorry. > > //Team Lima reaches the third layer of the city. The houses are luxurious, now incorporating other materials into their architecture such as metals and decorative ceramics.  Buildings tower over one another, standing with multiple floors, and are overall constructed more organized than the areas of the previous two layers. Here, near the back and the edges, several large buildings are built into the mountain and extend further into it. Though there are less golems roaming this layer, there is a significant increase in the amount of patrols of the armored entities.// > > //The agents are hidden in an alleyway, taking cover from the entities. Lima-1 looks back through where they came, they are high above the lower city, and the sun is a few hours away from setting.// > > **Lima-1:** Command, how long do we have till sunset? > > **Command:** Roughly four hours Lima One. > > //Lima-1 looks towards the third layer, and the palace at the highest point. He thinks for a few moments.// > > **Lima-1:** I might be calling a return to base soon. At most, we might be able to get a basic idea of what the third layer looks like, but if we want to make it before sundown, we need to head back. > > **Command:** Understood, head back to base camp, we'll cover the rest in a secondary exp- > > **Lima-8:** Captain! > > //Everyone turns to look at Lima-8, who aims his rifle into the rooftops.// > > **Lima-8:** Something's on the rooftops! > > //A sudden noise comes from one of the alleyways behind Lima-1, and the agents turn their weapons, but see nothing. The members gather close, forming a perimeter. A noise echoes from another rooftop.// > > **Lima-1:** We've got to move to better cover. If we can get to one of the temples, the open space should- > > **Lima-4:** Captain, we've got another problem. > > //On the other end of the alleyway, a group of the armored entities have noticed the agents and approach, weapons drawn.// > > **Lima-1:** Shit. > > = [[size 130%]]**[REDACTED: LEVEL 5 CLEARANCE REQUIRED]**[[/size]] > > ---- > > **Afterword:** Following Team Lima's expedition into SCP-9225-A, it was determined that Layers 1 and 2 would remain as the default research sources, since higher layers were considered too dangerous for individual squads to explore. A Foundation base was established among the structures of Layer 1, with researchers being able to enter Layer 2 only when accompanied by five or more agents. Expeditions into other areas of SCP-9225 are to continue as scheduled. I'm not implying I don't trust your judgement, but the tree men are one subject, while these are a separate matter entirely. If anything should go wrong, the damage would be too much. Malthace also asked me to notify you of her completion of the elixir you requested. She will send various amounts soon. > > On a more unfortunate matter, our magicians believe there is little else to gain regarding [[[https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-2095 | those ruins of flesh]]], our leads run dry and we still know nothing of the people they belonged to. I apologize for our failed efforts. > > Yss'gvan, 9th of the Spears > I mark the fall of another group, the Theledrans, though they fought valiantly, they were no match for our emperor and his armies. The Unification will continue. > > Seraphion, Keeper > Would I have not come here myself, I don't think I would've believed any of what I write. I don't expect belief in what I write regardless, for it is something I thought unfathomable, and no doubt others do as well. > > I write this text from Androdynamis, capital of the Seaenid empire, home of the tyrant king Rex'aeter, and his terrible army. Yet I find myself eating a warm pastry by a calm field while magical creatures fly above. Members of their infamous Bronze Legion walk past, yet they mingle with the citizens, exchanging pleasantries and words of kindness. > > This is not the place I expected. The city is beautiful, its people happy, and even in the outer villages, the peasants live tranquil lives. These revelations are simultaneously frightening and beautiful to behold. If you were to look at the same sight I see, you would also ask yourself if these are the same terrible conquerors of the sea. Even those that submit are treated as their own. I hardly believe it myself. > > I might extend my visit here a while longer. > > A wanderer > I found myself today, when reciting a poem in the desert kingdom, insulted by various commoners. Steel structures, remains of people mixed with metal parts in their bones, and artifacts of which we've the slightest idea how to use. > > Our emperor seemed concerned, we left several men and magicians to investigate and took some of the artifacts home. None of the common folk shall be informed. Hopefully we can gleam something of this mystery, for our emperor fears what potential threat could have created such strange things. > > Seraphion, Keeper [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-Catalogue/Anomalies/SCP-9225-A" hide="-Hide Document9225-Catalogue/Anomalies/SCP-9225-A" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[tabview]] [[tab I̅X̅-5]] [[<]] I̅X̅-5 are anomalous humanoid constructs composed primarily out of wood, tree bark, and other tree components. Their sizes vary, but are often between the 1.5m-2m range. The bottom half of their body is made up of various roots that can be used as independent limbs for either movement or management of items. The upper half of their body is humanoid, with a canopy of branches and leaves growing out of their head, and a featureless face, with the exception of two glowing green eyes. Based on observations, tests, and historical documentations, I̅X̅-5 instances were built primarily for menial labor such as farm work or house duties. While the method of their creation, as well as how they were instructed, is unknown, various discovered texts imply a strong connection to I̅X̅-6 entities. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-6]] [[<]] I̅X̅-6 entities are anomalous constructs built out of various types of stone. They measure between 7-8 meters in height, with large, thick, and durable arms and legs. I̅X̅-6 instances lack a head and instead possess a large yellow runic eye carved into the center of their main body mass, which is roughly spherical. These entities have incredible strength and defense, able to withstand most forms of firearms, and are primarily used as guardians/soldiers of SCP-9225-A. The method of their creation and methods of control is unknown, but are believed to be tied to I̅X̅-5[[footnote]]Though lacking much evidence, a connection between an ancient civilization known as the Theledrans and both I̅X̅-5 and I̅X̅-6 can be drawn. Further investigation into this kingdom's practices, as well as their use when taken by the Seaenid Empire, is ongoing.[[/footnote]]. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-7]] [[<]] I̅X̅-7 are an anomalous species of avian organisms which can be found across various environments within SCP-9225. These avian creatures measure 30cm long, with three sets of wings which each measure 45cm in wingspan. I̅X̅-7 instances are usually white and grey in coloration, with red and orange eyes, and a sharp yellow beak. When threatened, I̅X̅-7 instances will rapidly flap their wings in order to create small gusts of wind capable of reaching 45kmh. Once the victim is disoriented, they will either flee, or attempt to overwhelm them if there are other instances nearby. They will use this same ability when hunting.  Instances are omnivorous, but primarily feed on fruits, rodents, or other small organisms. I̅X̅-7 instances are often found in flocks, and are rarely ever seen alone unless they are hunting, or searching for a mate, at which point they will leave the flock and try to mate with an instance from another flock. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-8]] [[<]] I̅X̅-8 are agressive humanoid entities whose body are composed entirely of animate pieces of armor. Measuring between 1.5m-2m in height, these entities' bodies, or the armor they possess, are composed of a beryllium bronze alloy capable of absorbing thaumaturgical energy used to try and attack it. Their bodies are resistant to damage, but with enough sustained fire, can be temporarily terminated. The armor of I̅X̅-8 instances is of a bronze coloration, with several repeating designs across the body and a carved human face in their helmet. Expressions can vary between instances. I̅X̅-8 instances serve as the primary defense force of SCP-9225-A, and will attack any individual on sight if it perceives them as a threat to SCP-9225-A. They often wield a variety of melee weapons also composed of beryllium bronze. Even if the weapon is taken away, instances are capable of taking and transmuting nearby materials into a new weapon. The origin of I̅X̅-8 instances is unknown, as records indicate that, when the Seaenid empire still existed, their forces were composed of entirely of living individuals. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-9]] [[<]] I̅X̅-9 is a spear composed primarily of a gold and copper alloy. This spear has been altered to harness an anomalous substance injected directly into a system of carved lines along its shaft and blade, which renders it capable of producing electrical energy. This energy can be stored or discharged at will and its intensity depends on the amount of energy stored prior to a discharge. Based on textual evidence, the substance within I̅X̅-9 seems to originate from an anomalous species of marine fauna native to SCP-9225. Due to its apparent rarity, however, only a limited amount of I̅X̅-9 instances were produced, several of which have been found by Foundation personnel. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-10]] [[<]] I̅X̅-10 are an anomalous species of insectoid creatures commonly found in the more rock-filled areas of SCP-9225. Instances vary in coloration, but are typically grey, brown, black or variations of these three. They have two sets of large chitinous wings, sharp pincers with a straw-like tongue, as well as four thick legs composed of a reinforced bone substance. These legs, when put together, can gyrate, similar to a drill, at fast enough speeds to pierce through most types of stone. Specimens are primarily carnivorous, and will hunt in pacts for their prey, at which point they will attempt to drill through their targets with their legs and feed on their innards through the use of their tongue. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-11]] [[<]] I̅X̅-11 is a thaumaturgic ritual capable of summoning one or more sandstorms of varying levels of intensity. When summoned, these sandstorms are under the control of the user and can be manipulated according to their will, although it takes focus to maintain them for long periods of time. Found alongside the research regarding the ritual were several pieces of equipment which, when worn, allow an individual to glide and, to a certain extent, fly within the bounds of a sandstorm regardless of its nature. [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] [[=]] [[size 140%]][[collapsible show="+Show Document9225-Catalogue/Historical-Documents/SCP-9225-A/02" hide="-Hide Document9225-Catalogue/Historical-Documents/SCP-9225-A/02" |align=center]][[/size]] [[/=]] [[<]] > The Unseen strikes once more, this time it took fifteen of us, and as usual, no one saw anything. Not a sound, nor a trace, nor even a sight out of the corner of their vision. This can't go on like this, I refuse to let it go on like this. I will go to the village tonight and rally all I can, and we will march to the Forest of Beasts, for that is the only place such a thing can exist. Upon my life and name, Rex'aeter, this monster shall take no more of our fellows' lives. > The situation has not improved. I don't think the emperor is sick, but he is unwell. As our scouts discovered more eldritch flesh structures buried in long forgotten mountains, more strange mechanical artifacts of steel and cogs, and more remnants of peoples long gone, the emperor grew ever more paranoid. He threw himself entirely into the investigation of these two lost peoples. He has gone as far as to leave the management of the conquest temporarily to the Ninth Spear. > > I've never seen such a thing. I ought to speak with him, it's the least I can do. Though he has been difficult to bear in the last decades, I cannot deny that I too have failed my duty as his closest compatriot. > > Seraphion, Keeper > I write this as I ready myself to hunt the Unseen once more, though it took some days, a battalion of men stand ready, sharpening their weapons and preparing for the coming battle. Helping me lead them are the tips of the spears that will bring down this cursed beast, the only thirteen to volunteer without hesitation when I returned safe from my previous hunt. > > That day, no one answered my call, even Seraphion refused to go. Despite knowing his abilities render him a better scribe than fighter, the refusal hurt all the same. Regardless, I headed out to the woods that very night, intent on my resolve. Not long after, my ambition nearly proved to be my downfall. > > The first clue was the attack of the mind, as I drew further into the forest, I could barely remember who I was or what I was doing. Then, it went for the kill, and my only option was to run. I couldn't see it, not even hear it, yet I knew it was giving chase and that if I stopped running, I would soon find myself another one of its victims. > > In a stroke of luck, I tripped and fell into a small ravine, sliding through its slippery terrain until I ended up falling face first into a cavern. Though I suffered several injuries, I was safe. Getting a bearing on my surroundings, I realized that I had landed upon a field of pale grey and yellow flowers, accidentally inhaling their pollen. > > Before I could decide on the next course of action, I thought back to the encounter and how unprepared I was to face such a bestial foe. I remembered its agile speed, its fanged mouth, sharpened claws and armored face. I remembered its multiple beady eyes and its sleek, shadow-like body. And before I could step foot out of the cavern, I realized that I was able to remember the encounter. And that I had seen the Unseen. > > After I returned with my life and the knowledge of these flowers, it took little convincing to finally gather strength to put an end to this nightmare. > I believe the emperor is not in his right mind. I went and talked with him about his current state, and what he revealed is nothing short of madness. He wants to make our empire immortal, an impossible feat. Though I thought it metaphorical at first, he explained his plot, and now I see that whatever comes next can only end in either the greatest success man's ever known, or catastrophic failure. > > He does not intend to tell the Thirteen. I don't think I can stop him. But I will not abandon him again. > > Seraphion, Keeper > The Unseen is dead. Finally dead. After centuries of torment. I am happy, yet I can't help but think upon it from time to time. Such a powerful, horrid beast roaming the landscape unchained. So many were killed, lives destroyed, and fear sown throughout our clan. Yet it was not invincible, just different. > > The Unseen was not the only threat out there. So many other dangers roam our island, unexplainable, untamable, dangerous. But if we could defeat one, we can defeat the rest. Maybe if we do, man won't have to live under the thumb of the thing's beyond understanding anymore. Maybe if we're strong enough, we could unite the whole world under our banner. Man, united as one. Wouldn't that be an interesting idea? They are highly aggressive and will attack any individual that approaches. I̅X̅-12 instances resemble humans mixed with properties of marine life, which appear to have been thaumaturgically grafted into their bodies through some sort of ritual. The aquatic traits of each individual instance can vary, but the most common traits appear to be webbed appendages, sharp teeth, gills, and scaled skin. Instances wield weaponry similar to those used by I̅X̅-8, and even occasionally wear pieces of water damaged armor. However, for most instances, their added aquatic traits prevent the use of armor and therefore discard it entirely. The traits any individual instance possesses does not seem to correlate with others, with the exception of producing severe body deformations and granting the instance an extra anomalous ability. For a list of all known I̅X̅-12 variants, submit an research inquest to the desk of either Dr. Mora or Dr. Wilmont. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-13]] [[<]] I̅X̅-13 are an anomalous species of flora found in a small garden within the palace at the top of SCP-9225-A. Instances are a pale grey in coloration, with the exception of the nectar and seeds, which glow yellow. When analyzed, it was found that the pollen produced by I̅X̅-13 has mnestic properties when consumed or inhaled. While there is a theorized origin to where I̅X̅-13 instances grow within SCP-9225, the precise location has been deemed to be unfeasible to reach. [[/<]] [[/tab]] [[tab I̅X̅-14]] [[<]] I̅X̅-14 is the skull of an unknown creature. The skull possesses antimemetic properties that, when analyzed, differed from those of SCP-9225. As such, it is likely that the specimen possessed these properties prior to the formation of SCP-9225. The skull measures roughly 1 meter in size, with four eye sockets, multiple front-facing horn structures, and a large jaw with two rows of sharpened, backwards-facing teeth. Based on texts found within SCP-9225, I̅X̅-14 seemed to be the first major anomalous entity slain by the SCP-9225 civilization, and the catalyst for their rapid expansion. Whether this entity was part of a larger species is unknown.
