SCP-9343.raw_content:
We all need to find our eternity.

Item#: 9343
Level3
Containment Class:
esoteric
Secondary Class:
archon
Disruption Class:
ekhi
Risk Class:
notice
link to memo

A non-functional instance of SCP-9343-1.

Special Containment Procedures: SCP-9343-1 sites are to be closed off to the public and preserved for Foundation research. Any SCP-9343-1 sites no longer exhibiting the presence of SCP-9343-2 specimens are to be demolished, following the results of incident SCP-9343-A. Any members of the public having witnessed SCP-9343-2 are to be amnesticized and released.

Due to the scale and acceptance of SCP-9343-3 throughout mundane society, the decision has been made for it to be left uncontained.

Description: SCP-9343 is the collective classification for a number of associated objects and anomalous phenomenon discovered in the north of England and throughout Scotland.

SCP-9343-1 refers to a variety of structures and buildings built in the style of 12th century architecture. SCP-9343-1 instances usually take the form of a church or statue, however one recorded instance of it taking the form of a full settlement has been discovered. These structures display the ability to convert speech into echoes which repeat infinitely. These repeating vocalizations range greatly in length depending on the SCP-9343-1 instance they were produced by and have been given the classification SCP-9343-2.

For information surrounding SCP-9343-3, see "Addendum: SCP-9343-3".

Initial Discovery: Evidence of SCP-9343 was first discovered following multiple reports of extremely loud screaming of numerous voices being heard in various villages in the north of Britain. These reports were originally left unexplained, but were used to locate broken SCP-9343-1 structures following the discovery of the first functional instance of SCP-9343-1.

A functional SCP-9343-1 structure was first discovered 12/3/12, after a newspaper article revealed a group of teenagers claiming to have discovered a church which spoke to them. This article was intercepted by Foundation personnel, with a disinformation campaign being employed claiming the building was a performance art project.

Upon entering the SCP-9343-1 structure, Foundation personnel observed of multiple overlapping voices. Efforts to hear individual voices proved challenging.

Due to the inability to isolate individual voices, Senior Researcher Campbell suggested the development of an AI capable of de-scrambling SCP-9343-2. In the meantime, testing began on non-functional instances of SCP-9343-1, which were discovered following investigations into the reports of explosive voices.

Testing Log: SCP-9343-1

Subject: Non-Functional SCP-9343-1 instance
Objective: Attempt to reactivate anomalous properties through repairs.
Results: SCP-9343-1 instance was repaired using materials matching those used at suspected time of construction. All damage, both major and superficial, was repaired. SCP-9343-1 instance began to echo the last sentence spoken by each member of Foundation personnel inside once repairs were completed.
Notes: Test was completed on two instances of SCP-9343-1, results proved consistent.

Subject: Repaired SCP-9343-1 instance
Objective: Discover the effects of damaging an instance of SCP-9343-1 which contains SCP-9343-2 instances.
Results: Upon damage being applied to SCP-9343-1 instance created an opening from the interior to the exterior, all SCP-9343-2 instances began to scream. These screams started increasing in volume and a loud gust was heard heading towards and exiting through the orifice. Following exit, instances continued to rise in volume and move outside of the building until reaching a maximum of 132 decibels, at which point all instances demanifested.
Notes: Following witnessing this event, present Foundation personnel reported feelings of guilt and remorse similar to the feeling of losing a loved one. Requests to visit a site councilor are to be accepted.

Incident Report SCP-9343-A

On 1/5/12, a leaked episode of the show "Grand Designs" was scrubbed from the web and a disinformation campaign was put into effect, claiming the episode contained an editing error and was taken down by the parent company Channel 4. This episode consisted of a couple renovating a non-functional instance of SCP-9343-1 in an attempt to convert it into a house. Below is a transcript of the segment demonstrating SCP-9343-2 specimen, once the SCP-9343-1 instance had been sufficiently repaired.

A still from the episode.

Sarah ████: So now we're gonna be filling the last of the gaps with some concrete. What's really nice about old buildings like these is, since the walls are already made of thick stones, we don't need any regular insulation.

<An edited montage takes place, during which almost all of the walls have their gaps filled with concrete.>

Dave ████: I think this is the last bit now. Sarah, would you like the honours?

Sarah ████: Alrighty. Here we go!

<The camera zooms as they cover a small gap in a wall.>

Dave ████: Perfect.

<An SCP-9343-2 instance manifests, repeating the word "Perfect" in Dave ████'s voice.>

Cameraman: What the hell is that?

Director: Cut! Who's doing that?

<As more people begin to speak, more SCP-9343-2 instances manifest, until all that can be heard is a cacophony of sound. Cast and crew are then seen evacuating the building, with cameras continuing to roll until running out of batteries 33 minutes later.>

Following this video's removal, Foundation personnel located and secured the involved instance of SCP-9343-1.

Because of the risk undocumented SCP-9343-1 instances pose to the Veil, additional resources were provided to aid in their discovery. Permission has been granted for the demolition of non-functional instances of SCP-9343-1, due to the effective resource cost of containing individual instances.

On 13/5/12, a working prototype model of Cacophony.aic finished development and became available for use in de-scrambling SCP-9343-2 instances. Following the success of Cacophony.aic, Senior Researcher Campbell was promoted to research lead. Below is a list of de-scrambled SCP-9343-2 instances discovered in the first functioning instance of SCP-9343-1, along with those from two additional instances discovered during expanded Foundation scouting.

Voice: Mature Masculine
Language of Origin: Old English
Translation: There is no place I would have preferred to be born, no people I would have rather met and no regret I hold that matters.

Voice: Young Masculine
Language of Origin: Old English
Translation: We're off to help some of the lads up north. Think they're about to get attacked. If we don't come back, you know what happened.

Voice: Young Feminine
Language of Origin: Old English
Translation: We couldn't get mum here before we lost her. She didn't get to say that she loved us. Hopefully my words will do.



Open Attached Document
Close

To: Lead Researcher Campbell
From: Researcher Falls
Subject: Vacation Days

I'd like to take some time off to spend time with my family. Me and my parents aren't on the best terms right now and I think I'd like to change that. I'm requesting the remainder of my vacation days this year to go visit them. I thought I'd let you know ahead of time. You seem pretty invested in this one. It's a nice look on you.

Researcher Falls


To: Researcher Falls
From: Lead Researcher Campbell
Subject: Re:Vacation Days

Hi, Falls.

Please don't take the time off. We're understaffed right now as is and this thing is just starting to get interesting. I could really use your help with this. I'm not going to refuse you your time away but I would love it if you could reconsider.

Thanks,
Campbell.


Voice: Young Male
Language of Origin: Modern English
Transcription: What the fuck? Are you God or something?
Notes: This entry is believed to from one of the teenagers who discovered the original SCP-9343-1 site.

Voice: Mature Feminine
Language of Origin: Old English
Translation: The religious sorts have been showing up more and more recently. We cannot risk them finding this place. If you're hearing this, know my plan worked.
Notes: Believed to refer to the Roman Catholic Church, who would have been present in the region at the time.

Voice: Mature Masculine
Language of Origin: Old English
Translation: They slaughtered us. I managed to get away. I don't think I was followed. If you survived, join me in the woods. We can't let them take Glæsisvellir.
Note: The term "Glæsisvellir" translates to "Glittering Plains". In Norse mythology, Glæsisvellir is said to contain "Ódáinsakr", where nobody could die.

Part of a broken SCP-9343-1 instance.

Following the translation of the last listed SCP-9343-2, a search of a nearby woodland was authorised. 4 stone structures were soon discovered buried. These structures resembled statues of various unknown figures, with small holes located on the mouths.
These holes each exuded a single, significantly-longer instance of SCP-9343-2 each1 . Following the recording of each instance, each structure was confirmed capable of producing new instances when spoken into the mouth.

A full team was allocated to the quick translation of each instance of SCP-9343-2 recorded.


Design: Resembles a weeping man.
Length: 122 minutes
Voice: Mature Masculine

There is no joy in my heart without him.
His body lying wrecked in a field somewhere.
No warm breath on my neck.
No warm hands in mine.

I close my eyes and see his, watching.
I reach out.
He is not here.

I walked the Dales this morning.
I woke in a cold sweat.
Sheep watched me pass them.
They did not care.

I heard him speak.
Words for only my ears.
I have not wept since that morn.

If I feel a tear coming.
I step out to the hills.
I feel my husband with me.
Clinging to the breeze.



Open Attached Document
Close

To: SCP-9343 Team
From: Doctor O'Connor
Subject: Wedding Invitations!

Hi everyone!

Just sending out an email to let you all know that I finally made the decision to propose to my boyfriend of 4 years. I just felt I'd been waiting to do something I knew I wanted. It's a little rushed, but we think we want to have the wedding in a couple weeks, so save the date for a week on Saturday! Hope to see you all there and thank you for making me feel so welcome ever since I joined this team.

Dave O'Connor, Translation Team


To: Doctor O'Connor
From: Researcher Manks
Subject: Re:Wedding Invitations!

Congratulations! So happy for you! You can count on me and Paul being there.

Researcher Manks, Paraphysics


To: Doctor O'Connor
From: Director Littlewood
Subject: Re:Wedding Invitations!

I won't be able to make it but make sure to drink a little more for me. Congratulations.

Site Director Littlewood


To: Doctor O'Connor
From: Lead Researcher Campbell
Subject: Re:Wedding Invitations!

Hi Dave.

Why have I received no paperwork regarding this? We have a lot of work to do with 9343 and this is going to really slow things down. Are you certain of that date? Is it too late for you to move it to later in the year? This really feels out of the blue and you're the second person on the team to do something like this. Is it possible there's another effect with the anomaly? I understand you played a large role in recent translation efforts. Could you submit for a cognitohazard test? Sorry if this is a lot but this has caught me off guard and is really throwing a wrench in our research.

Thanks,
Campbell.


Following the exchange of these emails, Doctor O'Connor and Researcher Falls were tested for cognitohazardous effects. These tests returned negative.

Design: A man holding a scroll.
Length: 73 minutes
Voice: Mature Masculine

When visitors come to us, they may offer you texts.
Written accounts of how the world works.
Do not accept these.

The texts hold lies, altered with time.
Stories of beings beyond us.
Tales telling us how we should live.
Who we may be.

Writing spits in the face of being.
Mimicking us.
To speak and be heard is to live.
To live is to be heard, eternal.

The texts can burn.
Rot, tear.
The texts can be changed.
Warped to serve their reader.

The voice persists.

Design: A woman looking into the distance.
Length: 92 minutes
Voice: Mature Feminine

For when your end is in your sights.
You may have settled your memory in a tomb.
Awaiting our Ódáinsakr.

Wait no more.
Our eternity is complete.
Where gusts blow strong.
Where clouds are at our fingertips.

Head to the summit.
Feel the wind on your neck as you wander.
Beneath the earth we will lay.
Endless.

Join our cacophony.
Speak your truth.
Become forever.


Following the translation of the third SCP-9343-2 instance, efforts were diverted to locating "Ódáinsakr". After extensive searching, a hollow region was discovered underground, near the peak of Mount Whernside2. This space has been designated SCP-9343-1-α.

After locating and excavating an entrance, MTF Zeta-9 ("Mole Rats") Fireteam "VERSE" were dispatched to explore the space. Each member was provided translation equipment with a direct connection to Cacophony.aic. Additionally, all members were equipped with soundproof headgear with built in radio communication, in order to prevent producing new instances of SCP-9343-2.

Exploration Log: SCP-9343-1-α

VERSE-1 - Agent Gantsev

VERSE-2 - Agent Beard

VERSE-3 - Agent McCrary

<Begin Log>

VERSE-3: Everyone's translator working?

VERSE-1: Pretty sure. Yours good, 2?

VERSE-2: Affirmative.

COMMAND: Be wary of any movement inside. We have reason to believe there may be something living in there.

VERSE-1: Copy.

<Members of VERSE begin descending into SCP-9343-1-α, lowering into a staircase. Each member activates their head-mounted lights.>

<SCP-9343-2 instances can be heard in the distance. They do not appear to be repeating.>

VERSE-3: Voices ahead. Advise.

COMMAND: Proceed with caution.

<They reach the bottom of the staircase, the space opening to reveal a small village. No movement is visible. A large monument can be seen at the end of the cavern, protruding from the ground and reaching the ceiling. Throughout the area, SCP-9343-2 instances are heard, seemingly in dialogue with one another.>

VERSE-1: Hey! Anyone there?

<Instances do not acknowledge members of VERSE.>

VERSE-2: Is this what you were expecting, command?

COMMAND: Negative. Behaviour does not match previous specimen. Proceed into one of the buildings.

<VERSE-1 and VERSE-3 enter a small cottage building as VERSE-2 stands guard. Inside, the rooms are bare. Furniture matches that of 12th century England. Rooms are covered in dust and littered with cobwebs, but appear undisturbed. Atop the dining table are multiple plates of rotten food. Two instances of SCP-9343-2 appear to be conversing in the kitchen space. These instances have been labelled SCP-9343-2-A and SCP-9343-2-B.>

SCP-9343-2-A: Ma, how long until tea?

SCP-9343-2-B: It won't be ready for a while. Go play out for a bit. I will shout you when it's ready.

<SCP-9343-2-A is heard shouting from the front entrance, before joining a group of other SCP-9343-2 instances.>

VERSE-1: Was that a kid?

VERSE-2: I think so. Seems to be a group of them talking out here.

VERSE-3: Well, besides the voices, this place seems empty. Doesn't look like anyone's lived here for a while.

COMMAND: Noted. Please head to the structure in the distance.

VERSE-2: Copy that.

<Members of VERSE make their way through the settlement, checking buildings as they pass them. Eventually they reach a building resembling a church, with a single shattered window. A child-like instance of SCP-9343-2 is heard weeping outside.>

SCP-9343-2-C: I'm sorry! I didn't mean to break it! Please let them come back. Please!

VERSE-1: No instances inside the church.

VERSE-2: Didn't the brief say the voices disappeared when the structure broke?

VERSE-1: Jesus.

<VERSE proceed towards the monument, cutting through an alley. As they pass through, two SCP-9343-2 instances appear.>

SCP-9343-2-D: Boo!

VERSE-3: Fuck my life! I thought they couldn't-

SCP-9343-2-E: (yelping) I told you to stop doing that!

<VERSE-1 and -2 begin laughing at VERSE-3>

VERSE-2: Command, advise. VERSE-3 is scared of the dark.

VERSE-3: Fuck you guys.

COMMAND: The monument is just ahead. Please proceed.

<VERSE-3 heads forwards, leaving -1 and -2 to trail behind. Next to the monument, an instance of SCP-9343-1 resembling a statue of the same woman looking into the distance stands. Upon members of VERSE approaching, an instance of SCP-9343-2 manifests. This instance has been labelled SCP-9343-2-α.>

SCP-9343-2-α: Behold mortal. You stand before our Ódáinsakr. Our eternity. Speak your truth to it. Find what you deserve and snatch it. Feel yourself carried through the world. Your memory infinite. Become immortal. Become always.

<SCP-9343-2-α then began repeating this for the duration of the log.>

COMMAND: Get a closer look at the monument.

<VERSE-2 approaches the monument. It appears to be made out of limestone, with the sides smoothed apart from a small hole 178 centimetres from the ground.>

VERSE-2: This good?

VERSE-3: What's with the hole?

<VERSE-3 momentarily covers the hole with his finger. At the same moment, Foundation personnel outside of SCP-9343-1-α noticed the strong wind had stopped. This effect ceased upon the removal of VERSE-3's finger.>

COMMAND: Issue up top. Head outside.

VERSE-1: Copy.

<End Log>

Close

To: Lead Researcher Campbell, Director Littlewood
From: Agent McCrary
Subject: Transfer

I'd like to request a transfer. The statue in that place the other day really helped me to realise that I don't need to take this shit from the other two. If you check the logs from that expedition, they were unprofessional and rude to me, laughing at me when I was in distress. I'd like to move over to a different squad, I don't care which one. Maybe to Sigma-88, I've worked with some of those guys in the past. I can't keep dealing with this from them.

Agent McCrary, Zeta-9, "Mole Rats"


To: Director Littlewood
From: Lead Researcher Campbell
Subject: Re:Raise

This is starting to get ridiculous. This is the third instance of something like this happening to someone after encountering SCP-9343. I understand that the tests for cognitohazards returned negative on both the anomaly and the individuals I flagged but I'm telling you something is wrong. People don't just suddenly make big decisions like this.

Thanks, Campbell.



Addendum: SCP-9343-3

Further investigation into SCP-9343-1-α has revealed covering the monument inside results in the cessation of all wind within a 50 mile radius of the structure. Additionally, SCP-9343-1-α has proven structural unstable, with buildings inside having had sections damaged from previous explorations. Due to the risks associated, testing on SCP-9343-1-α has been put on hold to preserve the effects of the structure. Testing on SCP-9343-2 instances discovered inside of SCP-9343-1-α has determined they begin to repeat every 24 hours.

Following the exploration of SCP-9343-1-α, audio testing revealed instances of SCP-9343-2 present in wind throughout northern Britain. Instances appear to have different words spoken by different voices to produce complete sentences. This phenomenon has been designated SCP-9343-3. An excerpt from a recording of this is attached below.

As the sun sets on another kingdom, we remain.
As others call this land home, we remain.
To live is to fight to persist.
To find place in this world.

We have found ours.
Speaking to those alone with their thoughts.
Sharing the joy of us.

You did not find us.
We were never really gone.

Find your eternity.

Below is an email released by the former lead researcher on SCP-9343 following the discovery of SCP-9343-3.

Open Attached Document
Close

To: SCP-9343 Team, Director Littlewood
From: Lead Researcher Campbell
Subject: Resignation.

Hello everybody.

You've all read the subject. This email isn't intended to garner sympathy or have you all convince me to stay. I wouldn't try that on you, you're all clever people. My time in this position has made that very clear. I simply felt I should tell you all why.

This job has never been my passion. Don't get me wrong, I've enjoyed my time here, but I'm a people person. I want to be able to spend time with the people I love and build a community. You don't really get any of that here. You sit at a desk, write paperwork and figure out if the talking shark knows we understand it (for those not acquainted with that anomaly, it didn't). I was content with this for a while.

I'd always told myself this was just a stepping stone, and one day I'd leave and do what I loved. Before I knew it, 15 years had gone by. And what did I have to show for it? A couple commendations and the word senior before my name. I thought I'd blew it.

But then SCP-9343 fell onto my desk. I wasn't thrilled, mind you. The last couple projects I'd lead hadn't exactly gone well. But this one was different. Research was progressing, we were making more and more discoveries and it wasn't another hoax by a particularly driven teenager. I still wasn't doing what I loved, but at least it was getting interesting. A whole undocumented people! A whole culture nobody alive knew anything about.

Eventually, we found SCP-9343-1-α and discovered SCP-9343-3. Obviously, I'd noticed a few members of the team being affected by the anomaly prior, but that happens with a lot of stuff round here. And we tested it for cognitohazards. I just wrote it off as people being emotional. But, when we were wrapping up the stuff on top of that mountain, I swear to god it spoke to me specifically. And it told me what I needed to hear.

I'm going to do what I've always wanted. And that starts with bidding farewell to this place. I'm going to go start fresh. I regret staying as long as I did. Maybe I'll work in a school or run for mayor of a small town, but I need to do something new. Because I think it was right.

We all need to find our eternity.

Thanks,
Campbell.

Following the release of this email, Senior Researcher Campbell was amnesticised and discharged from the Foundation. No signs of cognitohazardous interference were detected.

Update: 3/9/25

Recent testing suggests the presence of SCP-9343-3 in wind throughout the continent of Europe, with instances discovered in Germany, Serbia and Finland. Investigations are ongoing.

SCP-9343-1 instances usually take the form of a church or statue, however one recorded instance of it taking the form of a full settlement has been discovered. These structures display the ability to convert speech into echoes which repeat infinitely. These repeating vocalizations range greatly in length depending on the SCP-9343-1 instance they were produced by and have been given the classification SCP-9343-2. For information surrounding SCP-9343-3, see "Addendum: SCP-9343-3". **Initial Discovery:** Evidence of SCP-9343 was first discovered following multiple reports of extremely loud screaming of numerous voices being heard in various villages in the north of Britain. These reports were originally left unexplained, but were used to locate broken SCP-9343-1 structures following the discovery of the first functional instance of SCP-9343-1. A functional SCP-9343-1 structure was first discovered 12/3/12, after a newspaper article revealed a group of teenagers claiming to have discovered a church which spoke to them. This article was intercepted by Foundation personnel, with a disinformation campaign being employed claiming the building was a performance art project.   Upon entering the SCP-9343-1 structure, Foundation personnel observed of multiple overlapping voices. Efforts to hear individual voices proved challenging. Due to the inability to isolate individual voices, Senior Researcher Campbell suggested the development of an AI capable of de-scrambling SCP-9343-2. In the meantime, testing began on non-functional instances of SCP-9343-1, which were discovered following investigations into the reports of explosive voices. [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] > [[=]] > [[size 110%]]**Testing Log: SCP-9343-1**[[/size]] > [[/=]] > > **Subject:** Non-Functional SCP-9343-1 instance > **Objective:** Attempt to reactivate anomalous properties through repairs. > **Results:** SCP-9343-1 instance was repaired using materials matching those used at suspected time of construction. All damage, both major and superficial, was repaired. SCP-9343-1 instance began to echo the last sentence spoken by each member of Foundation personnel inside once repairs were completed. > **Notes:** Test was completed on two instances of SCP-9343-1, results proved consistent. > > **Subject:** Repaired SCP-9343-1 instance > **Objective:** Discover the effects of damaging an instance of SCP-9343-1 which contains  SCP-9343-2 instances. > **Results:** Upon damage being applied to SCP-9343-1 instance created an opening from the interior to the exterior, all SCP-9343-2 instances began to scream. These screams started increasing in volume and a loud gust was heard heading towards and exiting through the orifice. Following exit, instances continued to rise in volume and move outside of the building until reaching a maximum of 132 decibels, at which point all instances demanifested. > **Notes:** Following witnessing this event, present Foundation personnel reported feelings of guilt and remorse similar to the feeling of losing a loved one. Requests to visit a site councilor are to be accepted. [[/div]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #132b52"]] [[=]] **Incident Report SCP-9343-A** [[/=]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] On 1/5/12, a leaked episode of the show "Grand Designs" was scrubbed from the web and a disinformation campaign was put into effect, claiming the episode contained an editing error and was taken down by the parent company Channel 4. This episode consisted of a couple renovating a non-functional instance of SCP-9343-1 in an attempt to convert it into a house. Below is a transcript of the segment demonstrating SCP-9343-2 specimen, once the SCP-9343-1 instance had been sufficiently repaired. [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #154c79"]] @@ @@ [[include component:image-block | name=960px-Hardham_church,_interior.jpg | caption=A still from the episode. | width=150]] **Sarah ████:** So now we're gonna be filling the last of the gaps with some concrete. What's really nice about old buildings like these is, since the walls are already made of thick stones, we don't need any regular insulation. //// **Dave ████:** I think this is the last bit now. Sarah, would you like the honours? **Sarah ████:** Alrighty. Here we go! //// **Dave ████:** Perfect. //// **Cameraman:** What the hell is that? **Director:** Cut! Who's doing that? //// [[/div]] Following this video's removal, Foundation personnel located and secured the involved instance of SCP-9343-1. Because of the risk undocumented SCP-9343-1 instances pose to the Veil, additional resources were provided to aid in their discovery. Permission has been granted for the demolition of non-functional instances of SCP-9343-1, due to the effective resource cost of containing individual instances. [[/div]] [[/div]] On 13/5/12, a working prototype model of Cacophony.aic finished development and became available for use in de-scrambling SCP-9343-2 instances. Following the success of Cacophony.aic, Senior Researcher Campbell was promoted to research lead. Below is a list of de-scrambled SCP-9343-2 instances discovered in the first functioning instance of SCP-9343-1, along with those from two additional instances discovered during expanded Foundation scouting. [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #154c79"]] **Voice:** Mature Masculine **Language of Origin:** Old English **Translation:** There is no place I would have preferred to be born, no people I would have rather met and no regret I hold that matters. **Voice:** Young Masculine **Language of Origin:** Old English **Translation:** We're off to help some of the lads up north. Think they're about to get attacked. If we don't come back, you know what happened. **Voice:** Young Feminine **Language of Origin:** Old English **Translation:** We couldn't get mum here before we lost her. She didn't get to say that she loved us. Hopefully my words will do. [[/div]] @@ @@ [[=]] [[collapsible show="Open Attached Document" hide="Close"]] [[/=]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #132b52"]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Lead Researcher Campbell **From:** Researcher Falls **Subject:** Vacation Days [[/div]] ------ I'd like to take some time off to spend time with my family. Me and my parents aren't on the best terms right now and I think I'd like to change that. I'm requesting the remainder of my vacation days this year to go visit them. I thought I'd let you know ahead of time. You seem pretty invested in this one. It's a nice look on you. //Researcher Falls// [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Researcher Falls **From:** Lead Researcher Campbell **Subject:** Re:Vacation Days [[/div]] ------ Hi, Falls. Please don't take the time off. We're understaffed right now as is and this thing is just starting to get interesting. I could really use your help with this. I'm not going to refuse you your time away but I would love it if you could reconsider. Thanks, //Campbell.// [[/div]] [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] @@ @@ [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #154c79"]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] **Voice:** Young Male **Language of Origin:** Modern English **Transcription:** What the fuck? Are you God or something? **Notes:** This entry is believed to from one of the teenagers who discovered the original SCP-9343-1 site. **Voice:** Mature Feminine **Language of Origin:** Old English **Translation:** The religious sorts have been showing up more and more recently. We cannot risk them finding this place. If you're hearing this, know my plan worked. **Notes:** Believed to refer to the Roman Catholic Church, who would have been present in the region at the time. **Voice:** Mature Masculine **Language of Origin:** Old English **Translation:** They slaughtered us. I managed to get away. I don't think I was followed. If you survived, join me in the woods. We can't let them take Glæsisvellir. **Note:** The term "Glæsisvellir" translates to "Glittering Plains". In Norse mythology, Glæsisvellir is said to contain "Ódáinsakr", where nobody could die. [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[include component:image-block | name=French_-_Head_of_an_Old_Testament_King_-_Walters_2721.jpg |caption=Part of a broken SCP-9343-1 instance. | width=200px]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] Following the translation of the last listed SCP-9343-2, a search of a nearby woodland was authorised. 4 stone structures were soon discovered buried. These structures resembled statues of various unknown figures, with small holes located on the mouths. These holes each exuded a single, significantly-longer instance of SCP-9343-2 each[[footnote]]Apart from one statue resembling a soldier, which was discovered in too poor a condition to function.[[/footnote]] . Following the recording of each instance, each structure was confirmed capable of producing new instances when spoken into the mouth. A full team was allocated to the quick translation of each instance of SCP-9343-2 recorded. [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #132b52"]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] **Design:** Resembles a weeping man. **Length:** 122 minutes **Voice:** Mature Masculine [[/div]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #0071B6"]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] There is no joy in my heart without him. His body lying wrecked in a field somewhere. No warm breath on my neck. No warm hands in mine. I close my eyes and see his, watching. I reach out. He is not here. I walked the Dales this morning. I woke in a cold sweat. Sheep watched me pass them. They did not care. I heard him speak. Words for only my ears. I have not wept since that morn. If I feel a tear coming. I step out to the hills. I feel my husband with me. Clinging to the breeze. [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[=]] [[collapsible show="Open Attached Document" hide="Close"]] [[/=]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #00000"]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** SCP-9343 Team **From:** Doctor O'Connor **Subject:** Wedding Invitations! [[/div]] ------ Hi everyone! Just sending out an email to let you all know that I finally made the decision to propose to my boyfriend of 4 years. I just felt I'd been waiting to do something I knew I wanted. It's a little rushed, but we think we want to have the wedding in a couple weeks, so save the date for a week on Saturday! Hope to see you all there and thank you for making me feel so welcome ever since I joined this team. //Dave O'Connor, Translation Team// [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Doctor O'Connor **From:** Researcher Manks **Subject:** Re:Wedding Invitations! [[/div]] ------ Congratulations! So happy for you! You can count on me and Paul being there. //Researcher Manks, Paraphysics// [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Doctor O'Connor **From:** Director Littlewood **Subject:** Re:Wedding Invitations! [[/div]] ------ I won't be able to make it but make sure to drink a little more for me. Congratulations. //Site Director Littlewood// [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Doctor O'Connor **From:** Lead Researcher Campbell **Subject:** Re:Wedding Invitations! [[/div]] ------ Hi Dave. Why have I received no paperwork regarding this? We have a lot of work to do with 9343 and this is going to really slow things down. Are you certain of that date? Is it too late for you to move it to later in the year? This really feels out of the blue and you're the second person on the team to do something like this. Is it possible there's another effect with the anomaly? I understand you played a large role in recent translation efforts. Could you submit for a cognitohazard test? Sorry if this is a lot but this has caught me off guard and is really throwing a wrench in our research. Thanks, //Campbell.// [[/div]] Following the exchange of these emails, Doctor O'Connor and Researcher Falls were tested for cognitohazardous effects. These tests returned negative. @@ @@ [[/div]] [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] **Design:** A man holding a scroll. **Length:** 73 minutes **Voice:** Mature Masculine [[/div]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #c25128"]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] When visitors come to us, they may offer you texts. Written accounts of how the world works. Do not accept these. The texts hold lies, altered with time. Stories of beings beyond us. Tales telling us how we should live. Who we may be. Writing spits in the face of being. Mimicking us. To speak and be heard is to live. To live is to be heard, eternal. The texts can burn. Rot, tear. The texts can be changed. Warped to serve their reader. The voice persists. [[/div]] [[/div]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] **Design:** A woman looking into the distance. **Length:** 92 minutes **Voice:** Mature Feminine [[/div]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #785fc9"]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] For when your end is in your sights. You may have settled your memory in a tomb. Awaiting our Ódáinsakr. Wait no more. Our eternity is complete. Where gusts blow strong. Where clouds are at our fingertips. Head to the summit. Feel the wind on your neck as you wander. Beneath the earth we will lay. Endless. Join our cacophony. Speak your truth. Become forever. [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[/div]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] Following the translation of the third SCP-9343-2 instance, efforts were diverted to locating "Ódáinsakr". After extensive searching, a hollow region was discovered underground, near the peak of Mount Whernside[[footnote]]A mountain located in Yorkshire, the tallest of a set of mountains known as "The Three Peaks".[[/footnote]]. This space has been designated SCP-9343-1-α. After locating and excavating an entrance, MTF Zeta-9 ("Mole Rats") Fireteam "VERSE" were dispatched to explore the space. Each member was provided translation equipment with a direct connection to Cacophony.aic. Additionally, all members were equipped with soundproof headgear with built in radio communication, in order to prevent producing new instances of SCP-9343-2. [[/div]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #000000"]] [[=]] [[size 110%]]**Exploration Log: SCP-9343-1-α**[[/size]] ---- [[/=]] [[div class="addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] //VERSE-1// - Agent Gantsev //VERSE-2// - Agent Beard //VERSE-3// - Agent McCrary //// **VERSE-3:** Everyone's translator working? **VERSE-1:** Pretty sure. Yours good, 2? **VERSE-2:** Affirmative. **COMMAND:** Be wary of any movement inside. We have reason to believe there may be something living in there. **VERSE-1:** Copy. //// //// **VERSE-3:** Voices ahead. Advise. **COMMAND:** Proceed with caution. //// **VERSE-1:** Hey! Anyone there? //// **VERSE-2:** Is this what you were expecting, command? **COMMAND:** Negative. Behaviour does not match previous specimen. Proceed into one of the buildings. //// **SCP-9343-2-A:** Ma, how long until tea? **SCP-9343-2-B:** It won't be ready for a while. Go play out for a bit. I will shout you when it's ready. //// **VERSE-1:** Was that a kid? **VERSE-2:** I think so. Seems to be a group of them talking out here. **VERSE-3:** Well, besides the voices, this place seems empty. Doesn't look like anyone's lived here for a while. **COMMAND:** Noted. Please head to the structure in the distance. **VERSE-2:** Copy that. //// **SCP-9343-2-C:** I'm sorry! I didn't mean to break it! Please let them come back. Please! **VERSE-1:** No instances inside the church. **VERSE-2:** Didn't the brief say the voices disappeared when the structure broke? **VERSE-1:** Jesus. //// **SCP-9343-2-D:** Boo! **VERSE-3:** Fuck my life! I thought they couldn't- **SCP-9343-2-E:** (//yelping//) I told you to stop doing that! //// **VERSE-2:** Command, advise. VERSE-3 is scared of the dark. **VERSE-3:** Fuck you guys. **COMMAND:** The monument is just ahead. Please proceed. //// **SCP-9343-2-α:** Behold mortal. You stand before our Ódáinsakr. Our eternity. Speak your truth to it. Find what you deserve and snatch it. Feel yourself carried through the world. Your memory infinite. Become immortal. Become always. //// **COMMAND:** Get a closer look at the monument. //// **VERSE-2:** This good? **VERSE-3:** What's with the hole? //// **COMMAND:** Issue up top. Head outside. **VERSE-1:** Copy. //// [[=]] [[collapsible show="Open Attached Document" hide="Close"]] [[/=]] [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #132b52"]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Lead Researcher Campbell, Director Littlewood **From:** Agent McCrary **Subject:** Transfer [[/div]] ------ I'd like to request a transfer. The statue in that place the other day really helped me to realise that I don't need to take this shit from the other two. If you check the logs from that expedition, they were unprofessional and rude to me, laughing at me when I was in distress. I'd like to move over to a different squad, I don't care which one. Maybe to Sigma-88, I've worked with some of those guys in the past. I can't keep dealing with this from them. //Agent McCrary, Zeta-9, "Mole Rats"// [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Director Littlewood **From:** Lead Researcher Campbell **Subject:** Re:Raise [[/div]] ------ This is starting to get ridiculous. This is the third instance of something like this happening to someone after encountering SCP-9343. I understand that the tests for cognitohazards returned negative on both the anomaly and the individuals I flagged but I'm telling you something is wrong. People don't just suddenly make big decisions like this. //Thanks, Campbell.// [[/div]] @@ @@ [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] [[/div]] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[/div]] [[=]] [[size 110%]]**Addendum: SCP-9343-3**[[/size]] [[/=]] [[div class="addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] Further investigation into SCP-9343-1-α has revealed covering the monument inside results in the cessation of all wind within a 50 mile radius of the structure. Additionally, SCP-9343-1-α has proven structural unstable, with buildings inside having had sections damaged from previous explorations. Due to the risks associated, testing on SCP-9343-1-α has been put on hold to preserve the effects of the structure. Testing on SCP-9343-2 instances discovered inside of SCP-9343-1-α has determined they begin to repeat every 24 hours. Following the exploration of SCP-9343-1-α, audio testing revealed instances of SCP-9343-2 present in wind throughout northern Britain. Instances appear to have different words spoken by different voices to produce complete sentences. This phenomenon has been designated SCP-9343-3. An excerpt from a recording of this is attached below. [[div class="addendum" style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-color: #D3D3D3"]] [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] As the sun sets on another kingdom, we remain. As others call this land home, we remain. To live is to fight to persist. To find place in this world. We have found ours. Speaking to those alone with their thoughts. Sharing the joy of us. You did not find us. We were never really gone. Find your eternity. [[/div]] [[/div]] Below is an email released by the former lead researcher on SCP-9343 following the discovery of SCP-9343-3. [[=]] [[collapsible show="Open Attached Document" hide="Close"]] [[/=]] ---- [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** SCP-9343 Team, Director Littlewood **From:** Lead Researcher Campbell **Subject:** Resignation. [[/div]] ------ [[div class="Addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] Hello everybody. You've all read the subject. This email isn't intended to garner sympathy or have you all convince me to stay. I wouldn't try that on you, you're all clever people. My time in this position has made that very clear. I simply felt I should tell you all why. This job has never been my passion. Don't get me wrong, I've enjoyed my time here, but I'm a people person. I want to be able to spend time with the people I love and build a community. You don't really get any of that here. You sit at a desk, write paperwork and figure out if the talking shark knows we understand it (for those not acquainted with that anomaly, it didn't). I was content with this for a while. I'd always told myself this was just a stepping stone, and one day I'd leave and do what I loved. Before I knew it, 15 years had gone by. And what did I have to show for it? A couple commendations and the word senior before my name. I thought I'd blew it. But then SCP-9343 fell onto my desk. I wasn't thrilled, mind you. The last couple projects I'd lead hadn't exactly gone well. But this one was different. Research was progressing, we were making more and more discoveries and it wasn't another hoax by a particularly driven teenager. I still wasn't doing what I loved, but at least it was getting interesting. A whole undocumented people! A whole culture nobody alive knew anything about. Eventually, we found SCP-9343-1-α and discovered SCP-9343-3. Obviously, I'd noticed a few members of the team being affected by the anomaly prior, but that happens with a lot of stuff round here. And we tested it for cognitohazards. I just wrote it off as people being emotional. But, when we were wrapping up the stuff on top of that mountain, I swear to god it spoke to me specifically. And it told me what I needed to hear. I'm going to do what I've always wanted. And that starts with bidding farewell to this place. I'm going to go start fresh. I regret staying as long as I did. Maybe I'll work in a school or run for mayor of a small town, but I need to do something new. Because I think it was right. We all need to find our eternity. Thanks, //Campbell.// [[/div]] [[/div]] [[/div]] [[div class="addendum" style="text-align: left;"]] Following the release of this email, Senior Researcher Campbell was amnesticised and discharged from the Foundation. No signs of cognitohazardous interference were detected. [[/div]] [[/<]] [[/collapsible]] [[=]] [[size 110%]]**Update: 3/9/25**[[/size]] [[/=]] Recent testing suggests the presence of SCP-9343-3 in wind throughout the continent of Europe, with instances discovered in Germany, Serbia and Finland. Investigations are ongoing. Special Containment Procedures: Warwick Castle has been purchased from Merlin Entertainment Limited (its previous owner) by Foundation front companies, and the location closed under the cover story of becoming a private events space.

Bodycam view of an SCP-9350 event's aftermath. Agents only now able to safely access the site due to the sheer scale of the prior night's kegger.

All roads leading to the structure are now private, and additional trees have been planted to prevent the structure being viewable from the River Avon. Both the castle and grounds are to be continuously monitored via audio-visual feed, and the perimeter guarded by agents from Site-44.

Updated Containment Procedures: As of 05/11/22, a detachment of MTF Epsilon-6 (“Village Idiots”) is to be permanently stationed outside of Warwick Castle, within the newly constructed Outpost-1068. Epsilon-6 is to conduct nightly patrols of the castle, and during “revelry events”, guard all exits to prevent egress of partygoers.

During daylight, Epsilon-6 is to clear-away detritus from prior revelry events. Recovered anomalous items are to be shipped to Site-44 for testing and archival.

Description: SCP-9350 refers to a phenomenon affecting Warwick Castle, in Warwick, England. Exclusively during night hours, approximately once per 10-21 days, an SCP-9350 event will occur within the castle and its grounds (hereby dubbed a “revelry event”).

During revelry events, Warwick Castle becomes host to an immense, crowded and chaotic party, facilitated by the spontaneous appearance of ~250-1000+ inebriated, hyperactive party guests (collectively dubbed SCP-9350-1). Extensive genealogy has proved SCP-9350-1 instances to be corporeal manifestations of individuals than inhabited the castle, or Warwick, within the medieval period.

Additionally, during revelry events, Warwick Castle itself appears to possess a memetic property; outsiders spending more than 10-15 minutes within the castle-proper will become compelled to participate in the festivities. Afflicted individuals will not leave the castle voluntarily until sunrise, and will possess limited recollection of the prior night (beyond merely the effects of extreme drunkenness).

Also notable is the general atmosphere of SCP-9350 events, combining features of both modern parties (DJs, drinking games, raving etc) and cultural practices from medieval England. This extends to the clothing of SCP-9350-1 instances, with medieval dress typically supplemented with body paint, glowsticks, shutter-shades, and other party-wear.

Despite this, SCP-9350-1 instances seem unable to recognize the unfamiliar time period they inhabit, never questioning novel phenomena (or rationalizing them according to their original time period, such as referring to an assault rifle as a “breathlessly ornate crossbow of Yorkshire-make”).

Additionally, during SCP-9350 events, the castle itself exhibits anomalous behaviors, including:

  • Deafening music exuding from various points within the structure – most often techno, electronic, rap, or metal remixes of medieval bard-music, hymns, and folk-songs.
  • The stonework of the castle “sweating” high-quality red-wine or hippocras.
  • The River Avon (nearby to the castle) being transmuted into ale or mead.
  • The appearance of modern foods being cooked in medieval styles (e.g. various “Burger King” burgers rotating on a spit).
  • The castle’s portcullis independently “thumping” up and down, in time to music.
  • Cheering and applause sounding from the castle’s dungeons and oubliettes, even if empty.

Discovery: Warwick Castle is not believed to have possessed anomalous properties prior to October 2020. However, on 31/10/20, local police reported to the castle following reports of loud noises, strobe-lighting and smoke from within the structure, during the 2020 COVID-19 lockdown.

An in-progress SCP-9350 event was subsequently discovered, with backup being called once orders to leave the structure were refused, and the first wave of attending officers joined the party. A Foundation asset within the Warwickshire Police service then became aware of the escalating situation, quickly contacting Site-44 regarding the potential anomalous activity.

During the subsequent Foundation response, all officers and witnesses at the scene were amnesticized, and a cover story regarding an illegal rave fabricated to local media organizations.
Following this, provisional containment was established, and subsequent observations quickly identified a potential culprit for the carnage (hereby designated POI-9350-A).

POI-9350-A: POI-9350-A is a middle-aged Caucasian male of unknown origin, most commonly dressed in a stereotypical blue “wizard’s robe”, with an accompanying beard and pointed hat.

According to POI-9350-A, his preferred name is: “Aldathar Aethelwulf, Lord of Cups, Thrice Gelded, Warlock of Warlocks, Friend To All” (or “Aldathar”, for brevity).

Through repeated Foundation observation, Aldathar was quickly discerned as the source, or at least a focal point, of SCP-9350. Subject possesses powers resembling common ideas of magic, able to control the anomalous properties of the castle at-will, end or resume revelry events, and perform a wide variety of other anomalous activities with no known limit.

Aldathar is universally known amongst SCP-9350-1 instances, considered an exceptionally generous host. His hospitality has even been cited as the reason SCP-9350-1 instances have “come all this way”, or “travelled far” to attend the revelry. Notably however, no SCP-9350-1 instances appear to know Aldathar on a personal level, only as a distant benefactor.

Addendum 9350-A
- Close

Addendum 9350-A

On 05/11/22 (Bonfire Night), a revelry event of exceptional intensity took place.

Approximately four hours into the event, Aldathar was seen to vanish from a mosh pit towards the castle’s eastern wall, before emerging, thirty minutes later, riding a dragon (to the great amusement of revelers). The dragon then began a low altitude flyover of Warwick, stunning civilians and singeing multiple houses.

In the aftermath, Foundation disinformation campaigns were able to successfully convince witnesses that the “dragon” was actually part of a nearby drone show, and that the fires throughout the city were the result of unrelated fireworks misuse. Still, the severity of this containment breach prompted the creation of Outpost-1068 and the deployment of MTF Epsilon-6.

Other notable revelry events are as follows:

12/07/21 – several SCP-9350-1 instances, alongside Aldathar, successfully teleport to a nearby “Bargain Booze” store, ostensibly to pick up alcohol. CCTV footage shows the cashier initially assuming the group to be costumed partygoers, but the situation degenerates after several revelers attempt to pay using gold coins, or trade using live chickens and geese. Foundation personnel subsequently collect SCP-9350-1 instances, with Aldathar responding “mead maketh the merriment!” when challenged.

03/02/22 – whilst investigating the memories of SCP-9350-1 instances, Samantha Dubois of the team’s security detail communicates to another member via radio. Dubois’ French accent is immediately noticed, and she receives several “two finger” gestures from nearby revelers, alongside one yelling “Agincourt, wench!” from across the crowd.

Despite Aldathar’s repeated efforts to calm the situation, multiple personnel are struck by thrown beer mugs and rotten vegetables during the ensuing commotion.

21/06/22 - during a revelry event to celebrate 2023’s summer solstice, an abnormally large swan was seen arriving at Warwick Castle, dubbed "our lady of the lake" by Aldathar. Swan was approximately 21x the size of ordinary members of the species, yet was notably docile, offering rides to SCP-9350-1 instances throughout the night.

Upon agents attempting to interact with the creature, however, it reacted in a manner more typical of swans, injuring all involved personnel before escaping into the surrounding forest. Drone imagery reveals the swan did not dematerialize upon sunrise1, persisting within the countryside surrounding Warwick. Recovery efforts are ongoing.

27/03/23 – at approximately 1AM, various "Viking"-style longboats were observed arriving from the River Avon, followed by disembarkation of many SCP-9350-1 instances in traditional Viking dress2. Aldathar initially reassured others that they were their “friends from beyond the sea”, but despite this, 17 separate confrontations occurred within the first 10 minutes of their presence, primarily over ale casks and food.

Subsequent recommendations for a fully British team of personnel were rejected, owing to the xenophobia of many revelers towards even Scottish or Welsh accents, and the impracticality of sourcing a team entirely from the English midlands.

31/12/23 – as this revelry event signifies a new year, Aldathar attempts to give a speech to all SCP-9350-1 instances present. However, this attempt is marred by a general lack of interest and attention from the crowd, and is ceased when a naked reveler leaps forward, shouting: “behold, mead AND meat!”, causing an uproar in the crowd. Throughout this, Aldathar looks noticeably deflated.

13/03/24 - at approximately 2AM, Aldathar conjures a large patch of bioluminescent blue mushrooms, consuming a small handful before lying down. Various SCP-9350-1 instances subsequently follow his example, yet seem reluctant to do so. Recovered samples reveal the mushrooms were chemically identical to Psilocybe cyanescens (a type of “magic mushroom”), however Epsilon-6 members reported feelings of intense melancholy whilst in the vicinity of the mushroom patch.

01/04/24 – at approximately 11PM, Aldathar breaks away from a crowd of revelers and retreats to a nearby battlement. None follow him. Aldathar sits alone for 30 minutes before conjuring a cloud of will-o'-the-wisps, watching them fly away, then slowly walking back towards the fray.

05/04/24 - a record 1535 SCP-9350-1 instances are seen in attendance, including various creatures from English and Welsh mythology. Despite this, Aldathar mostly spends the night alone, partaking of River Avon’s ale.

01/05/24 – revelry event attendance once again breaks records, but Aldathar is not seen at all during the proceedings. During Epsilon-6 patrols the following morning, however, Aldathar is found slumped against the door of the castle’s primary keep, unspeaking. Subject's beard and robes appear unkempt, while his overall demeanor is despondent. This is the first instance of an SCP-9350-1 instance persisting beyond daybreak.

Following repeated questioning from Epsilon-6, Aldathar finally speaks up, requesting a “private audience with your liege”. Following deliberation at Outpost-1068, alongside confirmation that SCP-9350’s memetic properties were no longer active, Head Researcher Henrietta Thorpe was sent to converse with POI-9350-A.

The transcript of this interview is as follows (with Aldathar’s words translated from Middle-English):

Researcher Thorpe: “It’s nice to finally meet, Aldathar Aethelwulf, L-“…

Aldathar: "If it please you, my lady, “Aldathar” is more than enough."

Thorpe appears momentarily surprised, before resuming.

Researcher Thorpe: “So… Aldathar, you said you wanted to chat?”.

Aldathar remains silent, with a look of mild confusion.

Researcher Thorpe: “My apologies, you… “requested an audience” with us? We have questions we’ve wanted to ask you too, Aldathar”.

Aldathar remains silent for another 15 seconds, gazing at the dawn sky.

Aldathar: “Does your work give you purpose, my lady?”.

Researcher Thorpe: “My… work? I’m not sure I understand… If you mean my research, well I’ve always wanted–“.

Aldathar: “So many have toiled in this domain, these fields, for countless years.”

Aldathar shifts in the light, and it becomes clear his eyes are red from tears.

Aldathar: “To ease their worries, their fears, their long wait. To provide a sanctuary, of a sort. That was my goal.”

Researcher Thorpe glances at the grass surrounding the castle keep. Smashed ale casks, chicken bones, and what appears to be several dragon eggs and smoldering fires are still visible.

Researcher Thorpe: “So this… revelry… of yours? It’s a distraction? A reward?"

Aldathar: “A reward indeed. But to my shame, too much of a sweet thing can still poison, my lady. I had shunned my purpose, but after so long, I find myself coveting it once more."

Researcher Thorpe: “Your purpose?… Aldathar… just how old are you? These people you host, they’re centuries old, but we’ve never been able to figure out-“.

Aldathar: “[REDACTED]. I trust there you’ll find the answers you seek, my lady."

Researcher Thorpe appears momentarily stunned by the information.

Aldathar stands, appearing moreso at peace than the start of the interview. He turns to Researcher Thorpe, knowingly smiles, and bows.

Aldathar: “I know not who you are or what you seek, but my lady-“

Researcher Thorpe: “Please… call me Henrietta if you’d like”.

Aldathar chuckles and smiles again.

Aldathar: “I know not who you are or what you seek, Henrietta, but you strike me as a soul most-learned in the ways of science. I leave stewardship of this sanctuary to you”.

Aldathar begins to fade from the castle.

Henrietta: “But Aldathar, I don’t… wait!”.

Five seconds later, Aldathar has completely vanished. The castle is silent and inactive. Henrietta slumps on the grass, defeated, for several minutes.

Henrietta radios Outpost-1068, instructing Epsilon-6 to travel to the nearby location: [REDACTED] and begin excavations.

Excavations at the provided location revealed the skeleton of a male human, tattered robes matching Aldathar's outfit, plus a faded tapestry, depicting him in service to William Maudit, 8th Earl of Warwick.

Since incident 1068-B, SCP-9350 events have continued to occur, albeit more sporadically, with fewer SCP-9350-1 instances in attendance, plus noticeably less anomalous activity.

Aldathar has not been seen in attendance.

Footnotes
1. Due to this, it is believed the beast was most likely a normal swan, transmuted by Aldathar.
2. Dating of their belongings links them to various Viking raids in the region during the 1100s.

2/9365 LEVEL 2/9365
CLASSIFIED
Item #: SCP-9365
Euclid

SCP-9365-A after processing with a cognitofiltering algorithm.

Special Containment Procedures, 2025/05/02: SCP-9365 must be apprehended and contained as soon as possible. Foundation webcrawlers are to continuously monitor major social media platforms for instances of SCP-9365-A. Identified copies or derivatives are to be removed under the guise of DMCA copyright violations or platform-specific 'misinformation' policies.

Description: SCP-9365 is Muhammad 'Babul' Hossain, a 25-year old man of Bangladeshi descent residing in Los Angeles, California. Prior to the onset of the anomalous effects of SCP-9365-A, the subject was employed as a food delivery courier under an Employment Authorization Document (EAD). Subject's immediate family, consisting of his parents, a wife, and two sons, reside in his hometown of Noakhali District, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

Upon finding employment in the United States, SCP-9365 joined a mobile messaging group for delivery couriers titled "Hard Life Polapan"1. The group's discourse focusses on challenges its members experience while working and tips to improve their financial status.

On 2025/04/03 at 15:44 PST, SCP-9365 posted an ironic 'meme' image of himself to the messaging group. In this image, he is wearing sunglasses and a collared shirt with the caption 'BABUL HOSSAIN: America's Newest Billionaire', followed by three emojis. A fellow messaging group member, Sumon Ali, shared this image on the website Facebook. Once posted, it developed an anomalous memetic effect and spread widely on the social media apps Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and TikTok, receiving an estimated 960 million impressions before it could be suppressed by Foundation bots. This image is designated SCP-9365-A.

More than 90% of individuals exposed to SCP-9365-A develop the belief that SCP-9365 was the latest person to achieve a net worth of one billion USD in the United States as of the time the image was posted; this effect is reversible, and can be negated by providing evidence contrary to this belief. Members of the "Hard Life Polapan" messaging group do not appear to have been affected by SCP-9365-A, possibly due to their level of prior knowledge about the subject's lifestyle and finances.

Babul Hossain // The L.A. Insider Exclusive Interview

By Sarah Warsawsky
Staff Writer | 𝕏 | Follow
April 17, 2025 11:01 AM PT

♡ Save🎧 Listen (9 min)➦ Share

In 2021, during the peak of the pandemic housing market that saw L.A. home prices skyrocket, the city of angels' most trusted news outlet, the L.A. Insider, compiled a list of the city's most elusive wealthy figures.

Four years later, a new name has come to the world's attention.

The mysterious Babul Hossain sat down with us at a café in West Hollywood, sporting a platinum Patek Philippe and a Balenciaga jacket. We asked him the big questions to which you've all been waiting to hear the answers.

Warsawsky:
Babul, the world is obsessed by you and your style. It's crazy that no-one had even heard of you until you stormed the internet just two weeks ago. Is it true? Are you really worth a billion dollars?

Hossain:
Sarah, I'm a private man, and I don't like to talk about money.

Warsawsky:
No kidding. We went looking for companies founded in your name and we couldn't find a single one. Are you getting a bit creative with your finances? It's all above board, right?

Hossain:
I've always paid my taxes, even before I came to America. It's the least I can do to give back to the country that gave me this opportunity. But remember, success is a currency. I didn't buy this jacket. A shop owner in Beverly Hills gave it to me after I agreed to a selfie. This watch was a gift from a charitable organisation. Once you've found success, these things just happen to you, whether you want them or not.

Warsawsky:
How has this wealth affected you and your family? You came from poverty, right? Are they as shocked as you are?

Hossain:
(Sighs.) Growth can be painful. I elevated my mindset, but some people want to have everything while staying on the ground floor. I refuse to let anyone pull me down. Don't misunderstand me, Sarah! I've made sure they're taken care of. I love my roots, but I need room to grow.

Warsawsky:
That must have been hard, Babul. I don't think I expected that from you.

Hossain:
America has hardened me. You're either the guy who delivers the food, or the guy who owns him.

Warsawsky:
Wow, that's quite the statement. Now, Mr. Hossain, you've been spotted with designer and businesswoman Sana Hashwani. I have to ask: are you two an item?

Hossain:
Sana and I understand each other. We both know what it's like to have people make assumptions about you, and take you for granted. We don't do that to each other. I'm very glad to know her.

Warsawsky:
Beautifully cryptic. So, is she still paying you for appearances and endorsements?

Hossain:
If me wearing one of her products or showing up at her event helps her, and she wants to show she respects my time, is that so different from what any other celebrity might do? Our relationship works for us. Let's move on to a different subject.

Retrieval Log

Date: 2025/05/03

Several members of the audience begin to follow them, but SCP-9365 waves to security and they form a line between SCP-9365 and the crowd.]

15:01: [SCP-9365 passes out. Miss Hashwani calls for medical assistance. Four Foundation operatives disguised as medical staff approach and check SCP-9365's vitals before placing him on a stretcher and taking him to their vehicle.]

15:04: [SCP-9365 is in a Foundation vehicle en route to Site-15.]

Interview Log

Date: 2025/05/03

Time: 18:09 p.m.

Interviewer: Doctor Mina Jin

Interviewed: SCP-9365

Dr. Jin: Please state your name for the record.

SCP-9365: Everyone knows my name. I'm Babul.

Dr. Jin: We need your full name.

SCP-9365: Look, if you're police, we can sort this out. I'm not happy about being snatched away like this. I have commitments this evening.

Dr. Jin: Full name, please.

SCP-9365: (Sighing) Muhammad Hossain. Babul.

Dr. Jin: Thank you. Now, tell me about the keynote speech you just gave. How much were you paid?

SCP-9365: Six hundred thousand dollars.

Dr. Jin: On the second of April, you had exactly four hundred and twelve dollars, sixty four cents in your bank account.

SCP-9365: What's it to you?

Dr. Jin: How do you feel about the changing way you've been treated, Mr. Hossain?

SCP-9365: I won't deny it's weird. I thought my life was falling apart at first. I managed to get back on my feet, though. I'm happier now. I'm successful. I wouldn't change it back for anything.

Dr. Jin: Do you know why people think you're a billionaire?

SCP-9365: No. It just happened. Sumon posted that picture, and suddenly my life changed. It was a stupid picture, a stupid meme. I still don't understand how people could believe something like that just because they see it online.

Dr. Jin: They wouldn't, usually. The image had an anomalous effect. It shouldn't have done that.

SCP-9365: So it's not my fault? Or Sumon's?

Dr. Jin: Not as far as we can tell. But our job is to neutralise things like this and keep the order of the world.

SCP-9365: But why? I'm not hurting anyone.

Dr. Jin: You cut yourself off from your family, so you may not even know this. Your mother was beaten by a mob looking for treasure hidden inside her house.

SCP-9365: (Startled) I didn't know about that. Is she okay?

Dr. Jin: Yes. We took her in for a debrief, treated her injuries, and resolved the issue.

SCP-9365: That… I should have heard about that. I could have protected them. But I didn't abandon them! They abandoned me. As soon as they saw that picture, I stopped mattering. They only cared about the lie, and they all demanded a share in it. I couldn't stand it.

Dr. Jin: You chose not to know when you walked away. Did you feel entitled to leave them all behind and just walk into a billionaire's lifestyle?

SCP-9365: Yes, no less than anybody else is! I spent twenty five years as a nobody. In my village, I was just a shadow. When I came to America, I was just a ghost on a bike. When I made a delivery, people would often just say 'thanks' and they wouldn't even look at me. I was working hard and making their lives easier, but I was changing my whole self and personality just to try and get a few more tips. I can't live like that any more.

Dr. Jin: The image that started this will be removed. After that, we'll release a counter-narrative that undoes the effect. People will stop seeing Babul the billionaire. All the money, the contracts, and the gifts will be reverted. Your girlfriend will forget you.

SCP-9365: She wasn't my girlfriend.

Dr. Jin: Some of the money you sent to your family will stay. We'll call it compensation for an accident, and we'll construct a paper trail to explain it. You'll be far better off than you ever were before. I hope you can take some comfort in that.

SCP-9365: I'm not the only person who faked their way into wealth. Are you going to hunt down the others, too?

Dr. Jin: We only deal with the anomalous. The rest is beyond our concern.

SCP-9365: That's not justice.

Dr. Jin: I'm sorry, Mr. Hossain.

Object Class: Euclid Neutralised

Special Containment Procedures: Following the treatment of the subject and their family and associates with Class-B amnestics, SCP-9365 is considered neutralised. Foundation webcrawlers are to disseminate countermeme 9365-β to the general population to neutralise the effects of SCP-9365-A. Countermeme 9365-β, described internally as the 'sad delivery guy meme', depicts an exhausted SCP-9365 sitting on a curb in a rainy alleyway and eating a cold paratha roll. It contains an embedded memetic agent designed to ensure that it spreads virally through the same social media websites as SCP-9365-A, and precisely counteracts the effects of the anomaly.

Any identified copies or derivatives of SCP-9365-A are to be removed under the guise of DMCA copyright violations or platform-specific 'misinformation' policies.

SCP-9370 - OUR SIDE HAS TO WIN

▸ More by this Author ◂

{$comments2}

F.A.Q.

{$doesthisfixthebug}

Item Designation: SCP-9370

Classification: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures: Ignore the entity that manifests in Site-93's Containment Cell 45. SCP-9370 must proceed without interruption, once per day. Medics are to be stationed nearby, as participants in SCP-9370 do not exhibit the expected accelerated healing factor that the original inscription detailing SCP-9370 describes.

In the event of interruption, SCP-9370 is to be resumed at the nearest available Site to Site-93. All personnel at Site-93 and potential backup Sites must be trained in the knowledge of SCP-9370.

Personnel that have requested that SCP-9370 be stopped or reclassified as unnecessary are to be moved to other sites. Compliance is required.

SCP-9370 inscription location.

SCP-9370 originally consisted entirely of protocols that were impossible to perform — locations described no longer exist and required biological materials were from extinct sources, among other issues. As such, the current version of SCP-9370 is a modern adaptation.

Description: SCP-9370 is a procedure used to contain an extradimensional threat via the enactment of specific activities in a predetermined order. Occasionally, carrying out SCP-9370 may create auditory and visual hallucinations of a humanoid entity. These persist during the duration of SCP-9370 despite the use of protective measures, yet do not result in lasting harm.

However, SCP-9370 involves steps with occasional complications that are unavoidable if triggered. These steps pose significant risk to individuals and can cause lasting harm.1 It is unknown how the original participants of SCP-9370 prior to Foundation initiation survived these.

The identity, nature, and abilities of the threat contained by SCP-9370 are currently unknown. Certain analyses of SCP-9370's origin suggest it to be capable of large scale reality restructuring.


Discovery

A set of instructions on how to perform SCP-9370 was discovered etched into a wall in a cave near Kondane, Maharashtra, India, in 1897 by early Foundation explorers. Linguistic archaeologists determined it to be most similar to Proto-Dravidian. Due to the technological limitations of the late 19th century, only the visible portions could be preserved with others being obscured by debris from cave-ins. Aside from the instructions for SCP-9370, the following was copied:

DANGER/RISK/CONCERN

THING/ENTITY/UNKNOWN

OUTSIDE/DESTROYED/REMOVED

PLACE/WORLD/HOME

Out of concern, Foundation personnel began performing SCP-9370 in a controlled manner to determine its effects, with the first instance recorded in June 1897. Reduced error rates and improved containment efficacy was recorded for nine months, after which Foundation personnel suggested the cessation of SCP-9370. This was approved. However, the resulting consequences involved major loss of life, and SCP-9370 was reinstated.


Procedure

SCP-9370 requires:

  • An open book turned to page 210.
  • Three participants maximum.
  • A start time no later within a 5 minute window of local sunrise.
  • A room no larger than the largest bathroom in the nearest building.
  • A concrete floor.
  • 45 scalpels, sterile.
  • 346 gallons of pig's (Sus scrofa domesticus) blood, replenished each day.
  • 3 bones of Gorilla gorilla.
  • A toy stuffed monkey.
  • A star chart displaying the night sky as it appeared on the 22nd of December, 4510 BCE. Cygnus must be highlighted.

Common complications are noted below.

Step 3: Move book to the left corner of the room.
Complications: Participant trips, causing minor damage to the book.

Step 12: Participants must close their eyes and cover their ears with their hands while each hums a unique note.
Complications: A black humanoid entity, strongly resembling a human fetus, materializes in Cell 45.

Step 30: Participants must smear the pig’s blood on their hands, then their coats.
Complications: The entity begins to mature.

Step 45: Participants will draw a Class Zeta thaumaturgic sigil with pig’s blood.
Complications: The sigil may activate with minor effects, causing bodily harm.

Step 63: Participants must use Cygnus in the star chart to locate the approximate location of Cassiopeia.
Complications: Holes similar to those created by trepanation, in the shape of Cygnus, appear in participant's skull.

Step 120: Participants must consume two meals’ worth of food in thirty minutes.
Complications: Bloating, acid reflux, and other gastrointestinal issues are common.

Step 181: Participants must perform a dance that involves movement of every limb.
Complications: Participants report immense fatigue, and some are unable to stop dancing until the next day.

Step 290: Participants must assemble a crude weapon from the scalpels. It will be used.
Complications: Cuts are performed on unintended locations.

Step 457: Participants must recite a prayer of supplication.
Complications: A thin layer of dermis covers participants' mouth and must be removed via scalpel.

Step 596: Participants must correctly guess at what point their pencil will touch the ground when thrown across the room, with a 20 centimeter margin of error.
Complications: An eye is struck by a pencil, intentionally.

Step 721: The toy stuffed monkey must be turned towards the participants, and its hands, eyes, nose, and mouth touched by the participants. Usage of both hands is required.
Complications: Participants report unease and request the toy to be removed. Participants have destroyed the monkey and consumed body parts that were touched.

Step 745: Participants must accurately match bones to their own body's counterparts.
Complications: Bones absorbed imperfectly, left exposed.

Step 1214: Three bags of rice must be cut open and twelve grains assembled into a humanoid figure.
Complications: Participants feel compelled to consume the rice raw irrespective of gastrointestinal capacity.

Step 1451: Participants close the book and perform a percussion solo with its cover, utilizing their exposed skull.
Complications: The entity requests information.

Step 1768: One participant must state "they have done nothing wrong" in the local native language.
Complications: The entity requests information, frantically.

Step 2555: Participant fingers must be lined up shortest to longest, unattached.
Complications: The entity produces high pitched vocalizations at nearly 120 decibels, and bends over.

Step 2789: SCP-9370 concludes. Participants kill the entity via cessation, with it demanifesting rapidly.
Complications: No signs of manifestation are found save noospheric readings showing minor elevation in tulpa markers.


Test

Advancements in noospheric containment technology allowed for testing of the entity generated by SCP-9370. Subsequent testing attempts yielded the same results. These are summarized below:

  • Subject appears to all observers, irrespective of participation in SCP-9370.
  • Subject is intangible, and not human.
  • Subject does not react to any stimuli, save those generated by SCP-9370 participants.
  • Further enactment of SCP-9370, especially the belief in SCP-9370's necessity, strengthens subject's manifestation.
  • Subject is birthed as a "new" noospheric presence each day, yet simultaneously dates back to 1897, coinciding with Foundation initiation of SCP-9370.
  • No entity exactly resembles any previous manifestation.
  • Subject scores a "moderate" on a Standardized Thoughtform & Tulpa Scale (13/27).


Further Exploration

To ensure efficacy of SCP-9370, Foundation explorers were dispatched to the original inscription to determine if alterations to procedure were possible. The completed form of the inscription cited earlier was found following erosion of the original rockslide.

DANGER/RISK/CONCERN

THING/ENTITY/UNKNOWN

OUTSIDE/DESTROYED/REMOVED

THIS PLACE/WORLD/HOME

THING/ENTITY/UNKNOWN

IMPOSSIBLE/UNTRUE/CANNOT

RETURN/RUN/COME

JOB/DUTY/REQUIREMENTS

COMPLETED/FINISHED/EATEN

HOME/PLACE/FAMILY

SAFE/HEALTHY/HAPPY.

Independent analysis suggests that the aforementioned benefits of SCP-9370 may have been due to confounding factors, such as technological improvement. These extend to the consequences of cessation being explainable due to other sensitive factors at the time. However, this cannot be said with certainty. As a result, O5 Command has deemed risk of cessation too great.
