SCP-9440.raw_content:
"The End was not due for centuries. What have you done?"

Link To Guide
Item#:9440
Clearance Level 3: Clearance
Containment Class: euclid
Secondary Class: ticonderoga
Disruption Class: #/vlam
Risk Class: #/notice

Special Containment Procedures: SCP-9440 is kept within a standard humanoid containment chamber (6m x 6m x 6m) at Site-17. Because SCP-9440 demonstrates no physical need for food, water, or sleep, furnishings are restricted to a single chair, unless otherwise authorized by Level 3 staff. Continuous monitoring is to be maintained to confirm the entity's body remains physically present within its chamber at all times. Due to the nature of what it is, true "containment" is not feasible. Because of this, personnel are instructed to log any sightings of SCP-9440 they witness outside containment.

Description: SCP-9440 is a localized phenomenon taking the appearance of a vaguely masculine humanoid and claims to be the abstract concept of endings. Foundation regards this as unverified self reporting operationally credible. Beginning at 9 cm away from SCP-9440's skin, light rapidly loses energy across all wavelengths. On contact with the skin, all light energy is terminated, an effect likened to a matte event horizon. Despite this, when interacting with staff, a pair of eyes and a mouth will be faintly visible.

Although SCP-9440 possesses a tangible, measurable body, evidence indicates this form is merely a localized manifestation of awareness rather than an encapsulation of its whole self. While humans have their sense of awareness anchored in their bodies, it appears SCP-9440's consciousness is non-local and it only uses the form in containment for the sole purpose of interacting with Foundation staff.

In the absence of external stimuli, SCP-9440 remains seated and motionless at all times. However, reports of SCP-9440 briefly manifesting at the conclusion of various events have become so frequent a dedicated log has been created and is maintained to document all reported sightings. Security cameras confirm that despite remaining confined, SCP-9440 is able to simultaneously manifest in multiple locations for brief durations.

Discovery: At 06:39 local on 03/11/20██, SCP-9440 manifested in the Site-17 decomissioning chamber during the termination of senior researcher Mallory. The manifestation occurred at the moment of death and was observed by all in attendance. Video recordings confirm subject offered no resistance to security forces. Firsthand reports from the detaining officers additionally suggest the entity deliberately presented itself for detainment. Analysis of security monitors indicate SCP-9440 manifested without an alteration of humes within the local environment.

Interview #1

Interviewer: Dr. LePlante
Date 05/13/20██
Foreword: Initial interview following manifestation during the decommissioning of senior researcher Mallory.

[[Interview Begins]]

Dr. LePlante: For the record, what designation do you normally go by?
SCP-9440: I am called The End. Or you can call me the numbers you’ve given me. They both point to the same conclusion.

Dr. LePlante: You describe yourself as “the end.” The end of what, specifically?
SCP-9440: The end of everything. Every structure falls, all concepts are eventually forgotten, patterns complete themselves…All that begins, ends. I am that.

Dr. LePlante: Then you are not a manifestation of say, Death?
SCP-9440: Death is but a single note in the song. I am the silence that swallows it and everything else.

Dr. LePlante: Why did you manifest at the time and place of researcher Mallory's termination?
SCP-9440: That was not an ending due in its time. It was an egregious threshold being crossed that finally drew me here.

Dr. LePlante: Can you elaborate—what exactly is your purpose here?
SCP-9440: To instruct you on how dangerous your hubris truly is.

Dr. LePlante: Are there other forces like you? Concepts that take form? The Beginning, perhaps?
SCP-9440: Perhaps.

Dr. LePlante: You won’t give a yes or no answer?
SCP-9440: Your lessons will not be learned from those types of questions.

Dr. LePlante: And what should we expect of you, if you are not here to cause endings?
SCP-9440: Expect only the consequences of the endings you have taken out of their proper place.

[[End of Interview]]

Testing Logs

Note: All testing has been suspended for SCP-9440. Interviews are currenly the only approved mode of interaction.

+ Open Testing Log 
- Close 

Test 9440-E1:

Object: Lightbulbs, various, new. Tested functional. (Three LEDs, 3 incandescent, and 3 fluorescent)
Procedure: Sequentially, each bulb was placed into a table lamp. SCP-9440 instructed to 'end' the functionality of the bulbs.
Result: Subject touched the bulb causing luminescence to instantly cease. Post-test analysis discovered that the electrodes, filaments and ballasts within the various bulbs had expired simultaneously upon contact.
Test is repeated with additional bulbs. Outcome is identical in all cases.
Subject refused verbal comment.

Note: During the clean up post-experiment, research assistant Carroway dropped one of the bulbs and lacerated their hand during the attempted clean up. The injury resulted in several stitches placed by medical and being put on limited duty for the remainder of the month

Test 9440-E2

Object: Personal phone belonging to Dr. Johansen, charged to 47%.
Procedure: Device placed before subject. Subject instructed to end the battery life.
Result: Subject hesitated before touching the phone, immediately bringing it to 0%. Analysis confirmed battery requried complete replacement.
The battery was not drained of charge, its function was completely ended. This implies a somewhat rigid finality to whatever we put through testing with SCP-9440.
Caution is advised.

Note: Dr. Johansen missed several calls from their wife who had gone into labor. Since the test, Johansen's work performance has degraded, resulting in workplace counseling. When questioned, Dr. Johansen stated they were dealing with relationship issues, and was now in couples counseling.

Test 9440-D1

Object: One small deskplant from Dr. Soahso's desk; cactus, near dead from over watering.
Procedure: Subject is instructed to delay the death, the ending of the cactus's function as a desk plant. Subject touches the cactus. No immediate reaction was observed.
Result: All moisture from potted plant was removed. Cactus remained unchanged for several days.

Note: Four days after Test 9440-D1 Dr. Soashso tripped while in their office and fell onto the cactus. On site medical removed the cactus and its spines, disposing of them. Medical reports indicate high probability of permanent nerve damage and reduced dexterity in the right hand.

Test 9440-D2

Object: Research Assistant Malcovich self-reported pain levels.(See Incident 33C2)
Procedure: 10 mg IV morphine is pushed via already placed central line. Subject is instructed to delay the ending of self-reported sensation of pain. Pain is reassessed every two minutes for twenty minutes.
Result:

13:00 Routinely scheduled dose off pain medication is delivered. 3/10 reported levels of pain
13:02 Pain level 3/10
13:04 Pain level 5/10
13:06 Pain level 6/10
13:08 Pain level 6/10 - Patient begins asking for test to end.
13:10 7/10 - Patient unable to focus due to pain
13:12 8/10 - Patient crying, vitals rising.
13:14 8/10 - Patient falls into hysterics.
13:16 9/10 - Patient begins falls into incoherent screaming.
13:18 10/10 - Patient unable to answer. Screaming for second dose of medication.
13:20 0/10 - Test concludes. Patient reports immediate and extreme relief.

Live Specimen Tests

Test 9440-A

Object: 1 Lab mouse (mus musculus), caged and healthy.
Procedure: Cage is placed on table and subject is instructed to end its life.
Result: Subject touches mouse with single finger, causing immediate heart failure and brain death. Mouse is immediately removed.
No other changes in the immediate environment are observed.

Incident Reports

+ Open Incident Report Log
- Close 

Incident Report: 9440-09A1

Date of Incident: 03/14/20██

Summary: Dr. Johansen had been using an emergency exit in the west wing to call his wife multiple times a day for several weeks. He had disarmed the alarm system of the door, and created a predictable pattern of vulnerability. On the day of the attack, a small Chaos Insurgent cell managed to breach through this opening, wounding Johansen. Their objective appeared to be the abduction of several humanoid anomalies. The Insurgency managed to successfully launch a neural net overrun of the security systems, flooding the system and polluting the defensive AI with false positives alarms.

The insurgents were able to secure four humanoid anomalies during the ensuing confusion. When they attempted to take SCP-9440 into custody, the computer attack abruptly ended, and all security protocols were restored.

Security responded in force, neutralizing the insurgents and recontaining all anomalies.

Description of Events:
Note: Timeline below has been reconstructed via the security cameras around the facility that were able to capture portions of the events.

1901: First internal error codes.
1903: Internal AI defensive systems compromised. Emergency status initiated.
1904: System is overun with error codes and emergency shutdowns. Dozens of parts of the facility are locked down, delaying response time.
1905: Seven insurgents are spotted in western hallway, near emergency exit.
1911: First humanoid anomaly is taken from containment with no restraints.
1920: Second humanoid anomaly is sedated and carried.
1922: Third humanoid anomaly is breached from containment and taken by force.
1925: Insurgents breach SCP-9440's containment and take them at gunpoint.
1926: As the insurgents enter the primary intersection, the virus abruptly terminated all functions.
1929: On site security forces detain insurgents. All humanoid anomalies recontained, thus ending the raid.
1932: Dr. Johansen is found and stabilized by first responders.
1935: All clear is sounded. Emergency status lifted. Normal functionality is restored.

Security Note: Data analysts confirm that the attack on their system ended only after SCP-9440 was targeted for abduction. Although direct intervention cannot be confirmed, evidence strongly suggests SCP-9440 was responsible for abrupt ending of the raid. It has refused all questions about the matter, or potential consequences of its actions.

Incident Report 33H01

Date of Report: 03/29/20██

Summary of Events: The mouse used in Test 9440-A was immediately transported to feed a viper (Crotalus atrox) in an unrelated herpetology program. Transit time from Test-9440-A to feeding was approximately two minutes. While attempting to initiate feeding, researcher Whylind was bitten on the wrist and invenomated. It is suspected that the heat loss between the time of death and the feeding caused the mistaken bite, as the researcher’s arm was now the warmer target. Researcher Whylind had an unusually severe reaction to the venom, and immediately went into anaphylaxis.
Medical staff administered antivenom and transported them to the medical wing, where they remain in a vegetative state.

Incident Report: 9440-33C2

Date of Incident: 07/21/20██

Summary of Events: At 14:40, a containment drum in Sector D ruptured, releasing 200 liters of HX-21, a highly corrosive compound used in neutralizing biological waste. The liquid rapidly vaporized in the open air, producing a poisonous cloud that triggered a full section lockdown.

Security cameras confirmed Research Assistant Malkovich was escorting SCP-9440 back to its containment chamber when the HX-21 vapors reached the main corridor. The alarm was triggered and the system locked down that portion of the facility, trapping Malcovich, 9440, and several other personnel.

The cloud spread through the hall, causing immediate and severe burns to all staff. Malcovich fell at the feet of 9440 who did not move. The gas around 9440 crystalized and fell out of the air as inert dust.
Security systems engage the ventilation purge, and the gas is quickly flushed out.

First responders find SCP-9440 unmoving standing over the head of Malcovich.
Though 35% of his body received severe chemical burns, he was stabilized and tranferred to on site ICU.
When questioned on why it refused to do anything to stop the events and loss of life, they replied "This is the consequence of previous disruptions. Their ends were rewritten to accomodate your inquiries."

Medical reports that the only reason Malcovich survived was because their lungs had not been exposed to the HX-21 gas. Having fallen within the short 9cm range that causes the electromagnetic breakdown of light around SCP-9440, the same property that 'ends' the light as it reaches the skin also affected the HX-21, rendering it harmless dust. This appears to have allowed them to breath until medical treatment was rendered.

Note: Inspection of containment units of HX-21 was scheduled to be completed by researcher Whylind, but had not yet been reassigned after their hospitalization. Detailed analysis of the residue dust confirms it was identical to control sample aged 21 years.

Incident Report 9440-44A
Date of Incident: 11/03/20██
Location: Site-17

Summary of Events: The morning of an annual administrative inspection, Dr. Soahso completed the vehicle check out form and had prepped the paperwork for a 1400 pickup from nearby airstrip. Due to previous injury (See test 9440-D1) Dr. Soasho's handwriting was misread by staff, resulting in a junior staffer being assigned to pick up the director two hours later than scheduled.

When the Director finally arrived to site-17, the inspection was nearly two hours behind schedule and the director expressed strong dissatisfaction. This led to what was typically a routine and quickly passed inspection instead being escalated into a formal inquiry into site records and administrative processes.

The site passed the inspection but common clerical errors resulted in four temporary suspensions of duty, seven clearance reductions, two transfers, and eighteen formal written reprimands.

Note: This is a clear downstream consequence of Dr. Soahso's hand injury from previous testing, occurring many months after the initial accident. While no loss of life happened in this particular incident, the consequences of removing so many personnel are certain to cause further disruption. Furthermore, the disruption to workflow due to the recent disciplinary actions is almost certain to cause additional manpower issues. Expeditious rassignment of all duties from the suspended personnel remains a priority.

Interview 2
Interviewer: Dr. LePlante
Date: 12/31/20██
Foreword: Conducted following conclusion of the initial test series and subsequent incidents.

[[Interview Begins]]

Dr. LePlante: You were cooperative in the demonstrations. Did you know in advance the consequences that conducting the tests were going to cause?
SCP-9440: Yes. And you've not yet seen the end of them.

Dr. LePlante: Can you be more specific? What should we expect to happen?
SCP-9440: You've seen ripples. The waves have not yet arrived.

Dr. LePlante: Can you warn us before these 'waves' arrive and cause disruption?
SCP-9440: Endings are not meant to be given in advance. You will live them.

Dr. LePlante: Do you have the power to end other anomalies we contain?
SCP-9440: If you are asking that, then you have not learned the lesson.

Dr. LePlante: Is it within your power to delay the end of the world?
SCP-9440: [[Subject pauses for several seconds]] Endings must not be delayed, nor rushed.

Dr. LePlante: Your tests show you are capable of interverning when you wish-
SCP-9440: I do not wish. I simply am. You have not yet learned what those tests were meant to teach you.

Dr. LePlante: Then tell me this: what is the point of these warnings? Why do you care?
SCP-9440: Your continued interference risks the premature ending of every story in existence.

Dr. LePlante: [Sighs] What are we supposed to do, then? Stop containing? Stop neutralizing? Should we sit idle and do nothing while the entire world ends?
SCP-9440: You tear out the last chapters of the story and drag the corpses of long-dead characters across the pages of your book, then wonder why it no longer makes sense.
Let things end in their proper time and place. Stop interfering before things get worse.

[[End of Interview]]

Personal Note: Please remember to interact with SCP-9440 as you would with any being capable of predicting, or potentially ending your life. It is easy to slip into the habit of interacting with SCP-9440 like a person because it speaks like one. However, the repeated sightings around the facility are a reminder that the 'containment' is largely at-will, and, as a concept, is effectively impossible, hence the secondary classification.
-Dr. LePlante

Addenda

External Manifestation Log

Note: Due to the frequency and brevity of appearances, logs have been divided into Eyewitness and Verified manifestations. Verified manifestations must include authentic security footage of the appearance. There is only one record of a manifestation lasting longer than 6 seconds. (See Log 06/20/20██)

+ Verified Manifestations
- Close 

Verified Manifestations

20██- Present: Multiple consistent reports of SCP-9440 manifesting in the area at the moment of death for both D-class and personnel across Site 17.

07/04/20██: During a containment breach, SCP-9440 was recorded simultaneously on several cameras, including the armory, the cafeteria, the medical bay, and its own containment cell. All instances shared the same timestamp.
10/31/20██: Captured in the observation booth during SCP-███ neutralization procedures.
12/31/20██: Appeared during a Site-17 retirement party; corroborated by multiple senior staff.
06/20/20██: Appeared during a reported interpersonal dispute in the Site-17 cafeteria, identified by witnesses as a romantic separation between Dr. ████ and Officer ████.1
03/10/20██: Appeared on camera footage of demolition of Site ██
08/18/20██: Appeared in the medical ward at the exact moment a heart monitor flatlined. Doctors confirmed the patient was already deceased before manifestation.
11/09/20██: Manifested in the archives during the shredding of the last file in a box of declassified documents.
01/12/20██: Captured on several cameras near the Site-17 incinerator as the final item of biological waste was destroyed.
04/29/20██: Appeared in the server room as the last light in a rack of hard drives powered down during decommissioning.
02/10/20██: Recorded during the conclusion of a chess match in the recreation lounge. Appeared directly behind the losing player as checkmate was declared, then vanished.

+ Eye Witness Reports
- Close 

Eye Witness Reports

08/21/20██: Researcher Page stated SCP-9440 was present “right as I zipped up my fly from taking a leak." Report marked as frivolous and flagged for deletion.
12/05/20██: D-class inmate claimed SCP-9440 stood beside their bunk “as I was about to fall asleep.”
12/12/20██: Manifested when Senior Researcher Gallows’s pen ran out of ink.2
01/29/20██: SCP-9440 manifested at farewell party for Dr. Hollowell immediately following closing remarks. Was seen in a corner, clapping silently.
07/22/20██: Security officer Cole claimed to have seen 9440 manifest in the mess hall the moment a vending machine dispensed its last candy bar.
09/01/20██: Junior researcher Johns reported SCP-9440 clapping once at the end of a movie night. Other staff recall hearing a clap but did not see the entity.
01/07/20██: Cafeteria cook reported SCP-9440 standing silently nearby when the last egg in cold storage was cracked for breakfast.
04/03/20██: Security officer Maro reported SCP-9440 stood in a corner humming faintly when his radio broadcast cut out mid-transmission.
05/11/20██: Dr. Tornt reported SCP-9440 appeared in their office doorway as they finished writing the words “The End” in an autobiography draft.

Access SCiPNET Email? One (1) new message!
Re:SUBJECT

To: Overseer Council
From: Dr. LePlante, Maximilian
Subject: 9440 Update

In light of the directly observable downstream consequences associated with SCP-9440’s interventions, I strongly recommend an immediate and formal review of all current procedures involving termination, suspension, or indefinite containment of both personnel and anomalies.

Respectfully,
-Dr. LePlante


To: Dr. LePlante, Maximilian
From: Overseer Council
Subject: Re:9440 Update

Your concerns have been noted and the data reviewed.
Foundation practices will continue as deemed necessary.

-Overseer Council

Footnotes
1. This is the longest verified sighting of SCP-9440 outside its cell. Despite the sighting, security confirms 9440 remained within its cell during this time.
2. This manifestation caused Gallows to experience a myocardial infarction. He was transferred to limited duty under medical care at Site ██.

Pain is reassessed every two minutes for twenty minutes. **Result:** **13:00** Routinely scheduled dose off pain medication is delivered. 3/10 reported levels of pain **13:02**  Pain level 3/10 **13:04** Pain level 5/10 **13:06** Pain level 6/10 **13:08** Pain level  6/10 - Patient begins asking for test to end. **13:10** 7/10 - Patient unable to focus due to pain **13:12** 8/10 - Patient crying, vitals rising. **13:14** 8/10 - Patient falls into hysterics. **13:16** 9/10 - Patient begins falls into incoherent screaming. **13:18** 10/10 - Patient unable to answer. Screaming for second dose of medication. **13:20** 0/10 - Test concludes. Patient reports immediate and extreme relief. [[/div]] **Live Specimen Tests** [[div class="blockquote"]] **Test 9440-A** ----- **Object:** 1 Lab mouse (mus musculus), caged and healthy. **Procedure:** Cage is placed on table and subject is instructed to end its life. **Result:** Subject touches mouse with single finger, causing immediate heart failure and brain death.  Mouse is immediately removed. No other changes in the immediate environment are observed. [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] + **Incident Reports** [[collapsible show="+ Open Incident Report Log"hide="- Close "]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Incident Report: 9440-09A1** ----- **Date of Incident:** 03/14/20██ ----- **Summary:** Dr. Johansen had been using an emergency exit in the west wing to call his wife multiple times a day for several weeks. He had disarmed the alarm system of the door, and created a predictable pattern of vulnerability. On the day of the attack, a small Chaos Insurgent cell managed to breach through this opening, wounding Johansen. Their objective appeared to be the abduction of several humanoid anomalies. The Insurgency managed to successfully launch a neural net overrun of the security systems, flooding the system and polluting the defensive AI with  false positives alarms. The insurgents were able to secure four humanoid anomalies during the ensuing confusion. When they attempted to take SCP-9440 into custody, the computer attack abruptly ended, and all security protocols were restored. Security responded in force, neutralizing the insurgents and recontaining all anomalies. ----- **Description of Events:** //Note: Timeline below has been reconstructed via the security cameras around the facility that were able to capture portions of the events.// **1901:** First internal error codes. **1903:** Internal AI defensive systems compromised. Emergency status initiated. **1904:** System is overun with error codes and emergency shutdowns. Dozens of parts of the facility are locked down, delaying response time. **1905:** Seven insurgents are spotted in western hallway, near emergency exit. **1911:** First humanoid anomaly is taken from containment with no restraints. **1920:** Second humanoid anomaly is sedated and carried. **1922:** Third humanoid anomaly is breached from containment and taken by force. **1925:** Insurgents breach SCP-9440's containment and take them at gunpoint. **1926:** As the insurgents enter the primary intersection, the virus abruptly terminated all functions. **1929:** On site security forces detain insurgents. All humanoid anomalies recontained, thus ending the raid. **1932:** Dr. Johansen is found and stabilized by first responders. **1935:** All clear is sounded. Emergency status lifted. Normal functionality is restored. //Security Note: Data analysts confirm that the attack on their system ended only after SCP-9440 was targeted for abduction. Although direct intervention cannot be confirmed, evidence strongly suggests SCP-9440 was responsible for abrupt ending of the raid.  It has refused all questions about the matter, or potential consequences of its actions.// [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Incident Report 33H01** Date of Report: 03/29/20██ ----- **Summary of Events:** The mouse used in Test 9440-A was immediately transported to feed a viper (Crotalus atrox) in an unrelated herpetology program. Transit time from Test-9440-A to feeding was approximately two minutes. While attempting to initiate feeding, researcher Whylind was bitten on the wrist and invenomated. It is suspected that the heat loss between the time of death and the feeding caused the mistaken bite, as the researcher’s arm was now the warmer target. Researcher Whylind had an unusually severe reaction to the venom, and immediately went into anaphylaxis. Medical staff administered antivenom and transported them to the medical wing, where they remain in a vegetative state. [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Incident Report: 9440-33C2** **Date of Incident:** 07/21/20██ ----- **Summary of Events:** At 14:40, a containment drum in Sector D ruptured, releasing 200 liters of HX-21, a highly corrosive compound used in neutralizing biological waste. The liquid rapidly vaporized in the open air, producing a poisonous cloud that triggered a full section lockdown. Security cameras confirmed  Research Assistant Malkovich was escorting SCP-9440 back to its containment chamber when the HX-21 vapors reached the main corridor. The alarm was triggered and the system locked down that portion of the facility, trapping Malcovich, 9440, and several other personnel. The cloud spread through the hall, causing immediate and severe burns to all staff. Malcovich fell at the feet of 9440 who did not move. The gas around 9440 crystalized and fell out of the air as inert dust. Security systems engage the ventilation purge, and the gas is quickly flushed out.   First responders find SCP-9440 unmoving standing over the head of Malcovich. Though 35% of his body received severe chemical burns, he was stabilized and tranferred to on site ICU. When questioned on why it refused to do anything to stop the events and loss of life, they replied "This is the consequence of previous disruptions. Their ends were rewritten to accomodate your inquiries." Medical reports that the only reason Malcovich survived was because their lungs had not been exposed to the HX-21 gas. Having fallen within the short  9cm range that causes the electromagnetic breakdown of light around SCP-9440, the same property that 'ends' the light as it reaches the skin also affected the HX-21, rendering it harmless dust. This appears to have allowed them to breath until medical treatment was rendered. //Note: Inspection of containment units of HX-21 was scheduled to be completed by researcher Whylind, but had not yet been reassigned after their hospitalization. Detailed analysis of the residue dust confirms it was identical to control sample aged 21 years.// [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Incident Report 9440-44A** **Date of Incident: 11/03/20██** **Location: Site-17** ----- **Summary of Events:** The morning of an annual administrative inspection, Dr. Soahso completed the vehicle check out form and had prepped the paperwork for a 1400 pickup from nearby airstrip. Due to previous injury ^^(See test 9440-D1)^^ Dr. Soasho's handwriting was misread by staff, resulting in a junior staffer being assigned to pick up the director two hours later than scheduled. When the Director finally arrived to site-17, the inspection was nearly two hours behind schedule and the director expressed strong dissatisfaction.  This led to what was typically a routine and quickly passed inspection instead being escalated into a formal inquiry into site records and administrative processes. The site passed the inspection but common clerical errors resulted in four temporary suspensions of duty, seven clearance reductions, two transfers, and eighteen formal written reprimands. //Note:  This is a clear downstream consequence of Dr. Soahso's hand injury from previous testing, occurring many months after the initial accident. While no loss of life happened in this particular incident, the consequences of removing so many personnel are certain to cause further disruption. Furthermore, the disruption to workflow due to the recent disciplinary actions is almost certain to cause additional manpower issues. Expeditious rassignment of all duties from the suspended personnel remains a priority.// [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Interview 2** **Interviewer:** Dr. LePlante **Date:** 12/31/20██ **Foreword:** Conducted following conclusion of the initial test series and subsequent incidents. ----- [[include :scp-wiki:component:audio-player-woed-source |unique-name=secretparty |audio-file=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/contest-sandbox/The%20End%202.mp3 |background-color=rgb(252, 252, 252) |border-color=rgb(215, 215, 215) |border-radius=0.313rem |dropshadow-color=rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.15) |text-color=rgb(80, 0, 2) |icons-color=rgb(171, 0, 5) |player-color=rgb(215, 215, 215) |progress-color=rgb(80, 0, 2) ]] **[[Interview Begins]]** **Dr. LePlante:** You were cooperative in the demonstrations. Did you know in advance the consequences that conducting the tests were going to cause? **SCP-9440:** Yes. And you've not yet seen the end of them. **Dr. LePlante:** Can you be more specific? What should we expect to happen? **SCP-9440:** You've seen ripples. The waves have not yet arrived. **Dr. LePlante:** Can you warn us before these 'waves' arrive and cause disruption? **SCP-9440:** Endings are not meant to be given in advance. You will live them. **Dr. LePlante:** Do you have the power to end other anomalies we contain? **SCP-9440:** If you are asking that, then you have not learned the lesson. **Dr. LePlante:** Is it within your power to delay the end of the world? **SCP-9440:** [[Subject pauses for several seconds]] Endings //must not// be delayed, nor rushed. **Dr. LePlante:** Your tests show you are capable of interverning when you wish- **SCP-9440:** I do not //wish.// I simply am. You have not yet learned what those tests were meant to teach you. **Dr. LePlante:** Then tell me this: what is the point of these warnings? Why do you care? **SCP-9440:** Your continued interference risks the premature ending of every story in existence.   **Dr. LePlante:** [Sighs] What are we supposed to do, then? Stop containing? Stop neutralizing? Should we sit idle and do nothing while the entire world ends? **SCP-9440:** You tear out the last chapters of the story and drag the corpses of long-dead characters across the pages of your book, then wonder why it no longer makes sense. //Let things end in their **proper** time and place. Stop interfering before things get worse.// **[[End of Interview]]** //Personal Note: Please remember to interact with SCP-9440 as you would with any being capable of predicting, or potentially ending your life. It is easy to slip into the habit of interacting with  SCP-9440 like a person because it speaks like one. However, the repeated sightings around the facility are a reminder that the 'containment' is largely at-will, and, as a **concept,** is effectively impossible, hence the secondary classification.// //-Dr. LePlante// [[/div]]  **Addenda** + **External Manifestation Log** //Note: Due to the frequency and brevity of appearances, logs have been divided into Eyewitness and Verified manifestations. Verified manifestations must include authentic security footage of the appearance. There is only one record of a manifestation lasting longer than 6 seconds. (See  Log 06/20/20██)// [[collapsible show="+ Verified Manifestations"hide="- Close "]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Verified Manifestations** 20██- Present: Multiple consistent reports of SCP-9440 manifesting in the area at the moment of death for both D-class and personnel across Site 17. 07/04/20██: During a containment breach, SCP-9440 was recorded simultaneously on several cameras, including the armory, the cafeteria, the medical bay, and its own containment cell. All instances shared the same timestamp. 10/31/20██: Captured in the observation booth during SCP-███ neutralization procedures. 12/31/20██: Appeared during a Site-17 retirement party; corroborated by multiple senior staff. 06/20/20██: Appeared during a reported interpersonal dispute in the Site-17 cafeteria, identified by witnesses as a romantic separation between Dr. ████ and Officer ████. [[footnote]] This is the longest verified sighting of SCP-9440 outside its cell. Despite the sighting, security confirms 9440 remained within its cell during this time.[[/footnote]] 03/10/20██: Appeared on camera footage of demolition of Site ██ 08/18/20██: Appeared in the medical ward at the exact moment a heart monitor flatlined. Doctors confirmed the patient was already deceased before manifestation. 11/09/20██: Manifested in the archives during the shredding of the last file in a box of declassified documents. 01/12/20██: Captured on several cameras near the Site-17 incinerator as the final item of biological waste was destroyed. 04/29/20██: Appeared in the server room as the last light in a rack of hard drives powered down during decommissioning. 02/10/20██: Recorded during the conclusion of a chess match in the recreation lounge. Appeared directly behind the losing player as checkmate was declared, then vanished. [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] [[collapsible show="+ Eye Witness Reports"hide="- Close "]] [[div class="blockquote"]] **Eye Witness Reports** 08/21/20██: Researcher Page stated SCP-9440 was present “right as I zipped up my fly from taking a leak." ^^Report marked as frivolous and flagged for deletion.^^ 12/05/20██: D-class inmate claimed SCP-9440 stood beside their bunk “as I was about to fall asleep.” 12/12/20██: Manifested when Senior Researcher Gallows’s pen ran out of ink. [[footnote]] This manifestation caused Gallows to experience a myocardial infarction. He was transferred to limited duty under medical care at Site ██. [[/footnote]] 01/29/20██: SCP-9440 manifested at farewell party for Dr. Hollowell immediately following closing remarks. Was seen in a corner, clapping silently. 07/22/20██: Security officer Cole claimed to have seen 9440 manifest in the mess hall the moment a vending machine dispensed its last candy bar. 09/01/20██: Junior researcher Johns reported SCP-9440 clapping once at the end of a movie night. Other staff recall hearing a clap but did not see the entity. 01/07/20██: Cafeteria cook reported SCP-9440 standing silently nearby when the last egg in cold storage was cracked for breakfast. 04/03/20██: Security officer Maro reported SCP-9440 stood in a corner humming faintly when his radio broadcast cut out mid-transmission. 05/11/20██: Dr. Tornt reported SCP-9440 appeared in their office doorway as they finished writing the words “The End” in an autobiography draft. [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] ------ @@ @@ [[div class="email-example"]] [[=]] ------ [[collapsible show="Access SCiPNET Email? One (1) new message!" hide="Re:SUBJECT"]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Overseer Council **From:** Dr. LePlante, Maximilian **Subject:** 9440 Update [[/div]] ------ In light of the directly observable downstream consequences associated with SCP-9440’s interventions, I strongly recommend an immediate and formal review of all current procedures involving termination, suspension, or indefinite containment of both personnel and anomalies. Respectfully, -Dr. LePlante   [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** Dr. LePlante, Maximilian **From:** Overseer Council **Subject:** Re:9440 Update [[/div]] ------ Your concerns have been noted and the data reviewed. X-ray image of SCP-9444 in containment.

Special Containment Procedures: SCP-9444 is kept in High Security Containment Chamber 7A at Site-47 in a constant, specialised medically induced coma, known as Procedure Lumet.1 IV, catheter, and colostomy bags are to be refilled/replaced daily, and enhanced liquid rapamycin injections are to be administered weekly. SCP-9444 must be remotely monitored at all times in case of sudden re-gaining of consciousness.2 In this scenario, the immediate vicinity will be evacuated and anaesthetic gas will flush SCP-9444's containment chamber until loss of consciousness is confirmed.

Accumulated currency produced by Procedure Lumet is to be retrieved daily from Site-47, and allocated use by the Accounting and Budget Departments.

00:17:02 You, son of God, have been born with incredible powers beyond your comprehension—but you have squandered your blessing, and subverted the natural order. For this, you have become one with it. A heavenly cog in our machine.

Description: SCP-9444 is Amir Hariri, a 23-year-old human male with the ability to manifest any physical denomination of the United States dollar, including coins, banknotes, and collector coins, via mental concentration and focus—the size, amount, and distance of manifested items correlating with the amount of concentration needed. Manifested currency is otherwise non-anomalous and indistinguishable from its mundane counterparts, and can not be de-manifested.

SCP-9444 is hostile, dangerous, and will terminate Foundation personnel if given the chance. It is estimated that it takes at least 0.4 seconds for it to terminate targets via manifestation of currency within their vital organs, nervous system, and/or brain. It is capable of manifesting currency to locations up to 70 kilometres away from its current position, and only requires an approximate location and knowledge of a target's appearance to successfully complete a precise manifestation within their body.

Incident Log: SCP-9444 is responsible for at least six incidents in which it used manifested currency to terminate political and corporate figures. These assassinations, known as Incidents 9444/1-6, have caused threats to normalcy, the economy, the Foundation, and the United States Government, needing correction via government and Foundation resources.

Date Victim Cause Of Death Aftermath Correction
12/25/24 Keith McCoy (Senior Director of Federal Relations for Exxon Mobil) Half dollar coin manifested within brainstem during sleep. SCP-9444 was 25 kilometres away from McCoy at time of manifestation. Brief loss of contact between Exxon Mobil and the United States Senate for lobbying purposes. Estimated damages of $120,000. Position quickly refilled and losses recuperated. Medical staff who witnessed anomaly amnesticised. Sudden stroke cover story disseminated.
1/08/25 Brett M. Kavanaugh (Associate Justice of the United States Supreme Court) Half dollar coin manifested within brainstem during televised Supreme Court hearing. SCP-9444 was 66 kilometres away from Kavanaugh at time of manifestation. Brief public scrutiny and shock. Supreme Court proceedings suspended for 5 days. Approved Senator nominated as new Associate Justice. Medical staff who witnessed anomaly amnesticised. Sudden stroke cover story disseminated.
1/19/25 Chet Thompson (President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Fuel and Petrochemical Manufacturers) Half dollar coin manifested within brainstem during sleep. SCP-9444 was 65 kilometres away from Thompson at time of manifestation. Media coverage. Brief weakening of total national petroleum and natural gas lobbying efforts. Estimated damages of $200 million. Position quickly refilled and losses recuperated. Medical staff who witnessed anomaly amnesticised. Sudden stroke cover story disseminated.
2/04/25 Alexander Meyer (Director of the White House Office of Intergovernmental Affairs)3 Half dollar coin manifested within major artery during the televised National Association of Counties Conference. SCP-9444 was 63 kilometres away from Meyer at time of manifestation. Public shock and media coverage. Brief loss of contact between Foundation and the Executive Office of the President. New Foundation liaison appointed. Medical staff who witnessed anomaly amnesticised. Sudden heart attack cover story disseminated.
2/12/25 Michael K. Wirth (Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Chevron Corporation) 23 one hundred dollar banknotes manifested within stomach and intestines during exercise at home gym. Subject died in hospital 45 minutes later. SCP-9444 was 37 kilometres away from Wirth at time of manifestation. Heavy news coverage of death. Strong condonation of incident expressed by members of public. Chevron stock fell by 7%. Estimated damages of $23 billion. SCP-9444 identified. Medical staff who witnessed anomaly amnesticised. Home intruder stabbing cover story disseminated. E-7563 falsely implicated, and detained by mundane authorities. New Chief Executive Officer appointed and losses recuperated.

00:43:55 You could have been the best of us, the most powerful of us, the most charitable of us. Instead you chose frivolous acts of terror that were fixed in an instant. Didn't those book clubs teach you anything?

Discovery: The Foundation was first alerted to SCP-9444 on 2024/12/25, after staff at Washington Memorial Hospital reported finding a half dollar coin embedded within a deceased patient's brainstem.4 Over the proceeding months, similar incidents continued to occur, focussed on individuals involved in the petroleum and natural gas industry, and Republican lawmakers.

In late February 2025, Foundation agents, aided by clairvoyant and energy-sensitive personnel, determined the approximate location of the responsible party was Baltimore, Maryland. MTF Kappa-79 ("Radars of the Lost Ark")5 were dispatched to determine their exact location, succeeding after Incident 9444/6. SCP-9444 was identified as Amir Hariri, a 23-year-old male of Lebanese-American heritage. Hariri was studying political science at the University of Baltimore, and was found to be a member of multiple subversive groups in the area, including SG-55986 and SG-5823.7

Further investigation revealed that SCP-9444 had realised its anomalous ability at the age of seven, wherein it mainly used it for minor financial gain until the age of nineteen. After enrolling at University of Baltimore, the anomaly gained radical beliefs fuelled by its classmates and various subversive groups on-campus. SCP-9444 then began manifesting currency to aid these groups and their activities, before transitioning to committing acts of violence. It is currently believed that fellow members of these groups were unaware of SCP-9444's anomalous abilities and actions.

After SCP-9444's residence was identified, the SCP Foundation and Unusual Incidents Unit8 launched a joint tactical effort to detain the anomaly. On 2025/2/15, SCP-9444 was anaesthetised while it slept, detained, and transferred to Site-47. It has not been allowed to regain consciousness since. Containment procedures were then established, and Procedure Lumet was developed to exploit SCP-9444's anomalous abilities.

02:07:45 You are God's lamb offered to us, as we are his chosen people. We are the blessed peacekeepers. The ones who hold the ruler. The ones who draw the lines. The ones who enforce his holy law—the one true law.

Addendum: The following is a transcript of the original document written by Senior Researcher Dr. Warren Lumet detailing Procedure Lumet:

Comatose is to be induced via a mix of pentobarbital and propofol administered intravenously. Standard mechanical ventilation, IV feeding, and fluid pushing procedures are to be installed.

Two coiled leads attached to electrodes are to be guided into the brain via a 14 mm hole drilled through the subject's skull. These wires are to be connected to and powered by a battery pack placed in the subject's chest wall. The electrodes are to be attached to either side of the temporal lobe—one will administer a constant electrical charge of 0.47 volts, and the other will administer an electrical charge of 0.15 volts every 0.5 seconds. This will allow SCP-9444 to constantly manifest currency in the desired denomination and amount, even while unconscious.

The following should also be installed/administered to guarantee constant revenue generation:

  • Thick blindfold to prevent light entering through eyelids;
  • Headphones constantly playing white noise and/or looped, pre-recorded audio at a loud volume to prevent mental clarity and demoralise the subject;9
  • Weekly injections of enhanced liquid rapamycin to reduce cell-aging and aid longevity;
  • Pedestal placed directly behind subject's head for holding manifested items.

Calculations estimate that this procedure will generate roughly $100 per minute, or $144,000 per day. Revenue generated annually will be roughly $52,600,000.

05:27:58 This is the way the world works.

Footnotes
1. See Addendum for more details.
2. Minor twitching and brief vocalisation does not constitute re-gaining of consciousness. This is believed to be caused by Procedure Lumet.
3. Meyer served as the primary liaison for expressing Foundation interests within the Executive Office of the President. It is unlikely SCP-9444 was aware of this fact when choosing Meyer as its target.
4. Incident 9444/1.
5. A specialised team of individuals sensitive to strong mental energy.
6. UOB Student Action
7. Revolutionary Marxists of Baltimore
8. Due to SCP-9444's termination of a high-ranking government official, the UIU specifically requested to take part in the anomaly's detainment.
9. SCP-9444 is able to hear and feel pain within its coma.

Special Containment Procedures: Currently there is no known way of fully containing SCP-9445. Its progress can only be impeded through maintained but steady use of SCP-9445-1. High mitigation opportunities are to be considered top priorities, however actions and/or events that result in low or medium amounts of mitigation are to be pursued as well. Foundation fronts posing as relevant governmental and non-governmental organizations are to be maintained at all times in order to ensure mitigation levels remain consistent.

Memetic, infohazardous, and cognitohazardous triggers are to be disseminated throughout both Foundation personnel unaware of SCP-9445's existence, and the general civilian populace. Additionally, Foundation personnel posing as public or political figures are to attempt to spread the influence of SCP-9445-1 and are permitted to utilize anomalous methods in order to gain more attention and/or supporters.

Description: SCP-9445 is the current designation for a violent noospheric phenomenon existing within approximately 60% of the collective human consciousness. Although projections indicate that if SCP-9445 were to be left uncontained, that number could increase to 80%.

SCP-9445 is a persistent desire, often unknown to the subject, to accelerate human extinction. Actions taken by affected individuals are typically banal, although still harmful. These can include anything from acts of verbal abuse, to physically harming other individuals, which typically, although not always, spreads the effects of SCP-9445.

Analysis conducted by the Department Regulating Engrams and Amnestic Management in 2023 determined that early humans did not actually suffer from any characteristic associated with SCP-9445. It was also determined that initially, humanity was found to almost exclusively cooperate or otherwise take actions that did not hinder each other. The first known appearance of SCP-9445 did not occur until somewhere around 2700 BCE. Although the origins of SCP-9445 are as of yet it unknown, it is currently believed that SCP-9445 does not typically manifest until an individual is around five years of age.

Furthermore, an approximated 30% of all affected individuals will commit more severe actions, such as advocating for, or actually attempting to carry out, the termination of large numbers of people, typically through means such as, mass murder, ideological warfare, or by attempts to convince the general populace of perceived threats. It is currently believed that individuals are more susceptible to developing the phenomena by living in high population density areas, interacting, either digitally or physically, with other humans, and by following common social practices regardless of if they harm the collective population or not.

Due to the prevalence of both the anomaly, and the actions taken by the population, it is currently believed that humanity will cease to exist within 50 to 100 years.

All previous attempts to contain SCP-9445 can be found below:


By the grace of God, Divinely Appointed Lord of the Spiritual Cleanliness Protectorate, protector of the English Empire and all her territories. The following edict, scribed in the year of Lord, 1300, is only to be observed by those a part of the Spiritual Cleanliness Protectorate: Those who read this edict without express consent of any current member of our sacred Foundation are to be executed. Amen.

Although we predicted success of our endeavor within the last century, we did not fully comprehend its magnitude. Nevertheless, not only have we been able to prevent a widespread panic, but due to the success of our agent, Aquinas, we have managed to successfully liberate the minds of the educated from this curse. The educated in turn, have spread their teachings to the serfs, who in turn spread these throughout the land. The reduction in overall violence and panic has led our scryers to believe that we may have pushed back our judgement by a number of years.

Now, there are two factors that remain constant: our own faith, and the nature of all wars. Should a war soon occur, it is extremely likely that what progress we have made shall be lost. What panic was prevented shall return. Our rinascita1, a contingency to attempt to rectify this, is still at least a few hundred years away. Should Man fall victim to sin, it is unlikely that any plans laid will be carried out. We perish in the darkness so that we might serve His light. This our foundation we hold dear.

1860

Society for Cruelty Prevention memo. Those who view, reproduce, or read this memo without the express permission of their superior are to be subject to trepanation and/or nullification.

It has come to light that certain members of our congress are unhappy with changes being made to our constitution and way of life. Although this would not usually be a cause for concern, the belligerents have threatened to leave our fragile union.

While we cannot abide by their values of allowing human beings to become property, we cannot risk them leaving our country either. Our scholars have theorized that such an action would result in a conflict that would delay our attempts prolonging the inevitable by such a period that the event would instead accelerate.

This is not the most optimal outcome, nor is it one we can easily recover from. Due to this we have drafted a proposal to maintain what order we have. We did not make this decision lightly, and it sickens us to protect the status quo, but we have come to the conclusion that Lincoln is a threat to our peace. It has been determined that the most efficient method of preventing him from gaining authority is by usurping his seat in the upcoming election.

Actions are to be taken to ensure the victory of either Douglas, Breckenridge, or Bell. In order to slow the spread of our demise, we are not to pursue violent measures in our venture. Such attempts would likely result in the hastening of our own misery. Additionally propaganda that discredits Lincoln is to be disseminated among the masses.

Our actions, though extreme, are for the good of all man. We let ourselves die in the dark so that they may live in all light.

1919: - interview excerpt.2

Dr. Cathcart: Can you describe experiencing the effects of mustard gas for the first time?

PVC Bratton: I-I was in a trench with around two-dozen other men, I was only on the fringe so I didn't get burned too bad, but I saw the worst of it. People were… coughing up blood, and phlegm, and I think bits of their own guts. I saw a man, his skin was sloughing off his face like wax melting down the side of a candle, crying out with lungs filled with blood.

There was a boy, maybe only seventeen years, his skin was covered in these awful boils and sores. I seen a man be gangrenous once, but this was so much worse. He cried out for his mama until he could do nothing but cough. Some put their masks on in time, but that didn't help too much, but it did keep it out of their lungs long enough for them to place their guns under their chins.

When it touched me, my skin was on fire. I had a jacket on, a heavy sort made of canvas, it ate through that like it was paper. I tried to put on my mask but my fingers couldn't hold it. One of my hands still doesn't work right when it gets cold.

I only survived because someone dragged me away, and took me into a tunnel underneath where the gas wasn't. Even then I could see the other men shambling, bodies decaying before my eyes, barely coherently begging to be killed.

Dr. Cathcart: And yet you lobbed a canister of mustard gas into a Bolshevik trench? Why?

End Log

1939.

One recovered film reel found in the basement of a destroyed east German synagogue.

Film possesses the minor anomalous effects of causing the subject to cry profusely upon completion of the viewing.

Film Length: 40 minutes.

Film Contents: The film opens with a man identified only as Proloff, who is seen chatting with the owner of a small bookstore. Proloff purchases a book but does not read it immediately, nor does he remove the ribbon binding it closed. After exiting the bookstore, a man dressed in brown approaches Proloff and offers him a flyer with a Nordic rune on it before scoffing at the bookshop. The man, although brusque, is friendly to Proloff and offers him a second flyer. Throughout the rest of the film, Proloff visits the bookstore somewhat frequently, and has encounters with similarly dressed men, until one them eventually manages to convince him to attend a meeting with him.

At the meeting, a tall handsome man in brown explains several concepts to the members, and when he sees that Proloff has not visited before, he invites him onto the stage and offers him a leather-bound book with the same Nordic rune on its cover. Proloff accepts, although his body language suggests that he is uncomfortable with the interaction.

Proloff later begins to read the book somewhat sporadically, while the book he purchased earlier remains untouched. Soon, he begins attending more meetings while visiting the bookstore less often. His body language throughout these scenes suggest he is becoming increasingly at ease with the interactions. Eventually Proloff stops visiting the bookstore completely, and attends the meetings frequently.

A posse of the men in brown, including Proloff, organize at night and begin to throw bricks through the windows of several shops and residencies throughout the city. Proloff, is shown to be hesitant about this action and initially refuses to take part in it. This is until the posse reaches the bookstore, Proloff is handed a brick and instructed to throw it. He once again hesitates and is struck across the face. Proloff raises the brick and aims it at the man who struck him, before the camera focuses on the Nordic rune on the man's jacket, which Proloff is now wearing on his clothing. Proloff grips the brick tighter, but instead of striking his attacker with it, he throws it through the window of the bookstore.

The final scene of the film is of the posse and several additional men throwing books into a large fire. Proloff is holding the book he bought at the start of the film and immediately throws it into the fire. The final shot of the film is the book beginning to burn before the camera centers on Proloff. Proloff is grinning.

1966

Recovered diary entry from US Marine. Name unknown.

We found them hiding in a straw hut, the kind you might see in a Nat Geo film. They were scared, young. Fuck, I think one of them was barely out of his teens. They begged in a language I didn't understand. I didn't want to do it, but I marched them out of the hut and lined them in the village center. Me and everyone else.

My commander, real sonnuva bitch named Walther, he asked them if they were pink? Their response was to sob profusely. I had as much idea of what they were saying, as I do of what the surface of Mars looks like. But I knew from their tone, the way they clasped their hands together, and those awful ragged sobs that they were praying. For my mercy? Walther's? God's? I guess it doesn't matter now.

Walther looked at all of us and then told us to "do it." O'Hannigan was first, scrawny kid from the Bronx with glasses pushed up to his nose. Last night he was showing me a Superman comic his folks sent him. At the time I thought he was a likable sort if not a bit spacey. Now, he was pressing the barrel of his rifle against an old man's head and making eye contact as he fired.

Noakes was next. This Black man who shared a bunk with me, nice guy honestly, shares his smokes. He had this tattoo on his arm, kept it hidden but I saw it in the showers, three arrows in a circle in a weird sort of triangle shape, I asked him about and he said it was just a fraternity from college, and he got defensive when I pushed it further. Still he's a pretty groovy man, he taught me his "unbreakable" poker strategy. Now he was breaking a young woman's skull open like a ripe pumpkin.

The two other men, I didn't know their names, that doesn't matter. One seemed distant, like he didn't want to do it, but did it anyway. The other? I think the bastard might've been grinning.

When it was my turn, I put my rifle down and closed my eyes. I felt Walther grip my shoulder, not in a fatherly way either, he barked in my face that either I put a bullet between the commie's eyes or he would do it to me. I looked at O'Hannigan but he pretended to not see me. Noakes tried to say something, but Walther barked at him that if he didn't have to listen to him in the States, he didn't have to listen to him here. Walther turned to me, he said, "You have one chance before I do it for you."

I pressed my rifle against the young man's head, he wasn't much older than me, maybe a couple years… he didn't scream. He didn't beg. He didn't yell that I was gonna burn for this. That was the worst part, he didn't say anything. He just looked down at the ground and let his tears run down his face. Walther shouted at me to fire. I'm so sorry mama, your little boy is going to Hell.

1988

Diary page found in the ruins of a house.

Text has been translated from Arabic.

It was Aaliyah's idea, of course it was her idea, it's always her idea.

She woke me up early this morning and said she wanted candy. She showed me the money she had hidden in her purse, lots of coins that she found around the house, or by running errands for the neighbors.

I told her to go back to bed and Father or Uncle could take us to the market when they wake up. She shook her head and told me that she didn't want to go to the market, she wanted to go to the city.

I called her a fool and said that we weren't allowed in the city, at least not without Father. She told me that she was not a fool, and that if I didn't go with her then she would go alone and tell Father that I let her go alone. I asked her what if we got caught or encountered the oppressors? She said she had a plan for the oppressors but wouldn't tell me what she meant.

That did it, I said I would go with her. It was stupid, but I didn't know what else to do. We made it out of the village easy enough, Naeem gave us a ride out in his car. We told him that we needed to run an errand in the city for our parents. He told us that to be very careful and that soldiers that worked for "them" were patrolling earlier.

We walked through the city but most people paid us no mind, it was easy, at first. We made it to the candy store, and the owner scoffed at us and asked if we had money. Aaliyah said that we did. He said fine, but to keep our hands out of our pockets and that if we stole even one piece he'd tell the authorities.

Aaliyah wanted to call him a name, but I told her to be quiet, we were close to getting our candy, the one thing we left the village for. She agreed and picked out what she wanted, a couple of lollipops, some boiled sweets, and a chocolate bar. She poured her coins out on the counter, and the man told her she didn't have enough for the chocolate bar, and that she needed one more coin. She said that she heard children say that they didn't need to pay full price, he said that those children followed different rules because they weren't… "dirty".

Aaliyah got that look on her face that she wanted to do something, but I squeezed her arm and she sighed and paid for what candy she could afford instead. We left, and walked through the streets, Aaliyah's purse now filled with the candy she bought, yet she struggled with it as if it weighed more than a car. I didn't know why at the time.

We walked to the city center where I still had a coin so that we could use the phone to call Naeem. As I was about to enter the phone booth, a hand grabbed my shoulder and turned me around. I saw three men wearing green uniforms, with their flag on the arms. Two were around Uncle's age, but the other couldn't have been older than Cousin Rashid was when he left for university. That one smiled at us, and tried to look reassuring.

The soldiers led us away from the phone booth and into an alley. They started by asking our names, and Aaliyah was too scared to answer, but I answered for her. They asked how old we were? I said that I was 10, and that Aaliyah was 7. They asked what we were doing alone? Aaliyah mumbled something, and one of the men told her to speak up. I answered for her that we were buying candy. They laughed at this, but the younger one said that he believed us.

They asked us if anyone knew we were here alone? I lied and said that Father, Uncle, and Naeem did. One of them jabbed the younger man in the side, and he asked us what Father, Uncle, and Naeem did as jobs? I said that Father is a builder, Uncle is also a builder, and Naeem is a driver. They asked if anyone told us to deliver any packages anywhere and I said no. The younger man said that we were okay, and told the other two that they should leave.

I thought we were clear… until the lead one asked to see in Aaliyah's purse. She didn't want to hand it over, but I told her to give it to them. There was nothing in there but her school supplies, and her candy.

The man reached in and rustled around in there before he removed an object that I had only seen a couple times at home: Father's gun.

I looked to the younger man but he now had an expression of disgust and looked away from me, mumbling about how we were all rotten.

The man with the purse asked Aaliyah what she intended to do with it? I tried to answer for her, to tell him that I didn't know that it was in there, that Father never even keeps it loaded, but he barked at me to be quiet before I could say anything, and scowled at me when I tried to speak again. He asked her again what she was going to do with it? Aaliyah said that she was going to use it on "bad men." The man's face grew dark, and he asked her what a bad man was? She said that Father said that the bad men were the men who would always take, and beat people, and murder. Oppressors. People like him.

He started by taking the gun from her. Then he started beating her. She cried for me, and I tried to run to her, but the man behind me held me back and threatened to beat me too. She screamed, but nobody came. I tried to look away, but they pushed my head forward. I looked past her instead, past the crowd that didn't care, and into the building across the street. From one the windows, I saw two people watching. They were wearing the white coats of doctors, but the coats had this strange shape on them, these three arrows in a circle all pointing inwards. All they did was watch.

It felt like hours before the man stopped, then they left, and didn't even stop to look at us. I was terrified, but still I ran to her. She was bleeding everywhere, and wasn't moving. She didn't make any noise, but I could still see her breathing. I picked her up, my knees straining, she was so heavy, so limp.

I called Naeem to take us home, and told him what happened. He looked so sick. He told us we did nothing wrong, we couldn't have known this would happen. He put Aaliyah in the back, and let her lie down as he drove us home. She was still by the time we reached our house. I have never seen Father cry before.

1997

Note Found on Foundation Junior Researcher's Desk.

Oslo was a mess.

What made us think we could solve the issue?

What made us think it could solve any issue?

Don't know when it's gonna happen.

Drown my sorrows before it drowns me.

I did my best, Aaliyah, I'm sorry.

2010 - O5-4's suicide note.

New York, 2001.

Moscow, 2002.

Morocco, 2003.

London, 2005.

Mumbai, 2008.

Nigeria, 2009.

We are beasts, and we are fucked.

Addendum:

On 10/12/24, following projections of SCP-9445's current model, both the O5-Council and Ethics Committee voted to institute the Rousseau Protocol, henceforth designated SCP-9445-1, which is intended to slow the spread of SCP-9445 and possibly even neutralize it, should the overall situation permit it. SCP-9445-1 has currently gone into effect both throughout Foundation facilities, and the civilian populace. As per the protocol's mandate, memetic triggers and images have been implanted into various pieces of media, popular culture, and advertisements. Additionally, several Foundation created fictional works and/or characters have been subconsciously implanted in key members of the populace in order to maintain levels congruent with SCP-9445-1 projections. A brief excerpt from SCP-9445-1's mandate can be found below.

Rousseau Protocol: Page 16/40

Additionally cognitohazardous phrases and triggers that encourage reciprocity and actions in opposition to animus are to be implanted naturally within civilian populations in excess of 50,000 individuals. To this end, mitigation percentages gained from this that range between 5-8% are to be considered both valid and successful.

Measures to prevent small to medium scale conflicts are detailed more extensively on page 17, however, personnel should note that conflicts of this nature are not to be avoided, and memetic messages which are in line with the Jus In Bello theory, in addition to the Geneva Protocol, are to be propagated throughout both non-Foundation civilian and military personnel.

Although armed conflicts involving anomalous means are still a concern, negotiations involving the Serpent's Hand, the Horizon Initiative, and the Global Occult Coalition are on-going in order to prevent and/or mitigate this. Full descriptions of this can be found on page 18.

NOTICE: All actions taken by Foundation personnel in line with the Rousseau Protocol are to be conducted with genuine intent. Performative actions and/or actions intended to generate discussion without sufficient societal alternations, are not to be attempted as they do not result in mitigation, and are thus a misuse of time and resources.

Primary Writer: Nicholas Klaus, Ethics Committee Member. Foundation Site: 029. Date: January 5th, 2025.

Addendum II: It is currently believed that at the current rate of mitigation SCP-9445's effects will be delayed by approximately one year. However projections indicate that with continued success of the Rousseau Protocol, SCP-9445's effects could be delayed by up to 100 years. In order to achieve this, personnel are instructed to continue to act with forbearance and benignity. Liberal projections from the Rousseau Protocol indicate that should this appear as a global pattern, SCP-9445's effects could be delayed by at least 1000 years.
